Own marketing at an AI legal research company that already has 1,900+ firms as customers.

Nylon is an AI-native tax and legal research platform used by 1,900+ accountancy and law firms across the UK, Australia and New Zealand. We were the first product accredited by ICAEW in the Legal Information and Research Software category, and we hold an ACCA affiliation. The UK business has been built almost entirely on outbound sales. It works, and it has taken us a long way. Now we want a second engine, and you would be the person who builds it.

This is our first dedicated marketing hire in the UK. There is no team beneath you yet and no playbook to inherit. There is a working sales motion, a product accountants and lawyers actually use, strong accreditation credentials, and a founder-led company that moves quickly. You will set the marketing strategy and then do most of the work yourself.

What you'll own

  • Pipeline. SEO and content, paid search and LinkedIn, email nurture, webinars and free-trial campaigns. Your number is qualified pipeline handed to our SDR and AE team, and you will be measured on it.

  • Brand and content. Sharpen how Nylon shows up in the UK accountancy and legal market: website, thought leadership, case studies, PR and awards, and the marketing side of our ICAEW and ACCA relationships.

  • Product marketing. Own the messaging. Turn what the product does into language that lands with a tax partner or a managing partner, keep our positioning against incumbent research providers sharp, and equip the sales team with battlecards, decks and one-pagers.

  • Events and community. Get us in front of the right people: ICAEW and ACCA events, industry conferences, our own roundtables and customer community. Some travel within the UK.

  • Measurement. Set up attribution and reporting in our CRM (Attio) so we know what is working, and kill what is not.

What we're looking for

  • 5–8 years in B2B marketing, with at least a few of those in SaaS or a subscription product, ideally selling to professional services (accountancy, legal, financial services).

  • You have built something from little or nothing before: a demand-gen function, a content programme, a launch. You are comfortable being the strategist and the person executing at 4pm on a Thursday.

  • Fluent in the tools: SEO and analytics, paid search and paid social, marketing automation and CRM, and the AI tools that make a small team punch above its weight.

  • You write well. Clearly, quickly, without fluff. Most of what marketing produces is words, and ours need to be credible to accountants and lawyers.

  • Commercially minded. You care about pipeline and revenue, not vanity metrics, and you enjoy working shoulder to shoulder with a sales team.

  • Curious about AI and about how professional services firms are changing. You do not need a legal or tax background, but you need to be able to learn the market fast.

Nice to have: experience marketing to accountants or lawyers; familiarity with ICAEW, ACCA or Law Society ecosystems; hands-on experience with webinar programmes or partnership marketing.

What we offer

  • £55,000–£70,000 base, depending on experience

  • Real ownership: you set the strategy, you get the budget, you build the team as we grow

  • A product customers rely on daily and a market that is being reshaped by AI right now

  • A small, fast, international team across the UK, Australia and New Zealand

Please send a CV and, instead of a cover letter, one page on how you would generate qualified pipeline for Nylon in your first 90 days.

Nylon is the trading name of Law Cyborg Limited. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from everyone. You must have the right to work in the UK.

A little about us

incident.io is the AI software reliability platform trusted by engineering teams at Netflix, Etsy, and 2,000+ companies who can't afford downtime.

The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile, and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for, all while having fun and never taking ourselves too seriously.

We've raised $96 million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join.

A little about us

incident.io is the leading AI incident response platform, relied on by some of the best engineering teams in the world when things go wrong.

Since launching in 2021, we've helped over 2,000 companies, including OpenAI, Netflix, and Airbnb, run more than 1 million incidents.

The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for.

We like to have fun and we never take ourselves too seriously. We've raised $96 million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join.

The role in one line

As an Enterprise AE at incident, you sell to the engineering leaders who cannot afford to get incidents wrong, and every deal you close is one more company that handles its worst day better.

What that looks like day to day

As an Enterprise AE at incident, you're selling into the biggest and most complex accounts we go after, the ones where an incident going badly becomes a board-level problem. Intercom, Etsy, Miro, HashiCorp and StubHub are already customers, so you're not cold-starting a story nobody believes. The product has real market fit and it is nowhere near fully capitalised. That gap is the whole opportunity.

The team you're joining are seasoned sellers who are as much strategic partners and product evangelists as they are closers. Enterprise cycles here mean six or seven decision-makers, technical buyers who will test you properly, and C-level conversations where you need to be credible immediately. You'll run demos alongside SE's, and the feedback you bring back goes to a product team that ships in hours and days, not quarters.

Sales isn't a function bolted onto the side of this business, it's central to how we win. You'll work with leadership on building sales process rather than inheriting a finished one, and challenging how we do things is the job itself, not something you get credit for on top.

We're AI-forward, founded by engineers, and everyone here has unlimited Claude access. We expect you to use it properly: researching accounts, prepping deals, and moving faster than the rep across the table at a legacy vendor.

Who you are

  • You've closed $100k+ new business at the top end of enterprise, and you can talk me through how you actually did it, not just what the number was.

  • You're comfortable in a room full of engineers and CTOs. Technical buyers don't faze you, and you know the difference between selling to them and selling at them.

  • You're a proper hunter. You've got more than one way into an account, and a run of rejection doesn't take the wind out of you.

  • You build the case with evidence. Data, the right customer story, real product knowledge, whatever it takes to move that particular stakeholder.

  • Multi-threading is instinct, not technique. You assume there are six people on the other side of the deal and you'd rather know all of them.

  • You've got opinions about the product and you share them. The best reps here are the ones product actually listens to.

  • Startup ambiguity suits you. The playbook is half-written, nobody is going to hand you a process, and you'd rather help build one.

  • You're good to work with. You'll be close to leadership, SEs and CSMs, and you care about being someone people want in the room.

Supporting you

We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. Our benefits pack is built to support both.

  • Private medical insurance. Seriously good cover - we want you and the people you love to be looked after.

  • Competitive annual leave. Showing up at your best requires switching off, and we make sure you have time to do that.

  • First Friday of every month off. Yes, seriously.

  • Enhanced pension. We put real money in, because future-you deserves better than an afterthought.

  • Meaningful equity. We're rapidly scaling, and everyone who helps shape the outcome should share in it.

  • Unlimited AI spend. For everyone, not just engineers. We're all-in on AI across the company, and we expect you to be too.

  • Generous parental leave. The early days with a new baby matter more than anything we're doing here, and we want you to be present for them.

  • Two budgets that have your back. £1000 to invest in your setup, £500 a year to invest in yourself.

jobs.title: Kontaktperson barnevernstjenesten
jobs.description:
Barnevernstjenesten er en lovpålagt kommunal tjeneste, og gir hjelpetjenester til barn og unge i alderen 0 - 25 år som bor i Haugesund og Utsira kommuner. 

Tjenesten er organisert i 4 avdelinger:

  • to avdelinger med ansvar for melding, undersøkelse og tiltak 
  • avdeling omsorg med ansvar for barn som bor i fosterhjem og institusjon  
  • avdeling familieveiledning, som gir spesialisert veiledning og oppfølging.

Enheten har 54 ansatte, og har gode og funksjonelle lokaler i Haugesund sentrum.

Barnevernstjenestens hovedformål er å sikre at barn og unge som lever under forhold som kan skade deres helse og utvikling, får nødvendig hjelp og omsorg til rett tid. Vi kan tilby meningsfulle og utfordrende arbeidsoppgaver i et arbeidsmiljø som gir rom for initiativ og kreativitet. Vårt mål er å gi best mulig tjenester til barn, unge og deres familier - basert på kunnskap og med stort engasjement. 

Vår fagutviklingsplan sikrer faglig oppdatering og utvikling for alle ansatte.  Vi tilbyr strukturert opplæring og vedlikeholdsveiledning når det gjelder barnevernets kjernekunnskap. Våre ansatte får tilbud om å delta i den nasjonale satsingen på barnevernsfaglige videreutdanninger. Barnevernstjenesten i Haugesund er aktivt deltakende i viktig utviklingsarbeid på barnevernsfeltet knyttet til utvikling av grunnmodell for hjelpetiltak (Bufdir), samt utvikling og implementering av systematisk oppfølging i fosterbarnsomsorgen (læringsnettverk - Statsforvalteren) 

Vi har nå ledig stilling som kontaktperson i avdeling melding, undersøkelse og tiltak.


Arbeidsoppgaver

Som kontaktperson i barnevernstjenesten vil du få ansvar for oppfølging av barn og unge i alderen 0 - 25 år:

  • Samarbeid med barnet/ungdommen selv, samt deres foreldre/foresatte
  • Samarbeid med ulike instanser som er involvert i barnet/ungdommen, som barnehage/skole, helsesykepleier, PPT, BUP, andre helseforetak i forhold til somatiske lidelser og lignende
  • Kartlegge behov, for så å iverksette og koordinere de tiltak som barnet og deres omsorgspersoner er i behov av
  • Saksbehandling i form av journalføring, annen dokumentasjon, vedtaksskriving, saksfremlegg for barneverns- og helsenemnd og utarbeidelse av planer knyttet til barnet/ungdommen
  • En må påregne noe arbeid på ettermiddag og  kveld.
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Barnevernspedagog, sosionom (bachelor, master) 
  • Annen relevant høgskoleutdanning kan vurderes, dersom relevant arbeidserfaring innenfor saksbehandling/forvaltning og/eller veiledning/systematisk endringsarbeid knyttet til barn og familier. 
  • Relevant barnevernfaglig videreutdanning er ønskelig
  • Erfaring fra/kjennskap til kommunalt barnevernsarbeid eller annet sosialt arbeid er ønskelig
  • Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt.
  • Det er krav om tilfredsstillende politiattest for tilsetting i stillingen. 
  • Søkere må ha ordinært gyldig førerkort.
Personlige egenskaper

Som kontaktperson i barnevernstjenesten er det viktig at du er:

  • I stand til å etablere gode samarbeidsrelasjoner med mennesker i ulik alder og livssituasjoner
  • Initiativrik og motivert for faglig og personlig utvikling
  • Interessert i å sette deg inn i og reflektere rundt sammensatte problemstillinger
  • I stand til å formidle informasjon og faglige vurderinger på en tydelig måte både muntlig og skriftlig
  • Motivert til å arbeide selvstendig, systematisk, under press og etter gitte frister
  • Fleksibel og samarbeidsorientert 

Stillingen krever norskferdigheter tilsvarende nivå B2 både muntlig og skriftlig.

  • Faglig oppdatering og strukturert veiledning
  • Et fagmiljø som satser på kvalitet og systematisk forbedringsarbeid
  • Rom for kreativitet og eget initiativ
  • Et arbeidsmiljø som du selv kan bidra til å gi kvalitet og meningsfullt innhold

jobs.title: PhD Position – AI-Driven Multimodal Analysis and Predictive Modelling of Biomaterials
jobs.description:
About the position

Biomaterial Science (BIOMAT) / Institute of Clinical Dentistry, Faculty of Dentistry, is offering a PhD position focused on AI-driven quantitative analysis and predictive modelling of biomaterials, tissues, and regenerative constructs.

The project combines advanced 2D and 3D bioimaging, including micro/nanoCT, confocal microscopy and SEM, with computational image analysis, computer vision and machine learning. The aim is to develop robust and standardized methods to link structural, mechanical and biological properties to biomaterial performance and tissue reconstruction.

The PhD candidate will work with multimodal datasets from biological tissues and engineered biomaterials and contribute to research on:

  • quantitative 2D and 3D analysis of biological tissues using nanoCT;
  • characterization of fibrous biomaterial scaffolds, including porosity, fiber architecture and structural stability;
  • standardization and computational analysis of biomedical imaging data;
  • AI-based prediction of cell and exosome distribution in regenerative biomaterials.

The candidate will receive interdisciplinary training in biomaterials research, advanced imaging, quantitative image analysis, data processing and machine-learning-based modelling.

More about the position

The main purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. The appointment is for 3 years and the place of work is Oslo, Norway.

The research will primarily be carried out at the Oral Research Laboratory, which provides infrastructure for biomaterial production and characterization, cell culture, SEM, confocal microscopy, micro/nanoCT and histology.

The project has a strong focus on regenerative medicine and dental applications, including hard- and soft-tissue reconstruction.

The three-year project is expected to produce three scientific papers and a doctoral thesis.

Your areas of responsibility will be
  • Perform quantitative 2D/3D analysis of biological tissues and biomaterials using micro/nanoCT, confocal microscopy and SEM
  • Characterize fibrous scaffold architecture, porosity and structural stability
  • Develop computer vision and machine learning methods for multimodal bioimaging data
  • Build AI models predicting cell and exosome distribution in regenerative biomaterials
More about the fellowship

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. The appointment is for three years and is devoted to the doctoral project and required research training.

Admission to the PhD programme at the Faculty of Dentistry is a prerequisite for taking up the position. The candidate is expected to complete the project within the fellowship period. A final plan for the research training must be approved and formalised no later than three months after the start of the position.

The main supervisor will be Associate Professor Athina Samara.

Qualification requirements

Mandatory requirements

  • MSc and BSc in Biomaterials, Biomedical Engineering, Biotechnology, Bioinformatics, Biology, Computer Science, Medical Technology, or a closely related field.
  • Relevant experience with biomedical imaging, quantitative data analysis, image processing, machine learning, biomaterials, or related methods.
  • Documented interest in interdisciplinary research combining biological and computational approaches.
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English.

Desirable qualifications

  • Documented Experience with Python and/or another scientific programming language.
  • Documented Experience with image processing, computer vision or machine learning or
  • Documented Experience with 2D or 3D biomedical imaging, quantitative or multimodal biological datasets.
  • Familiarity with biomaterials, tissue engineering, scaffolds, hydrogels or 3D biological models.
What are we looking for in you?
  • You work independently, precisely and systematically, while asking for input when appropriate.
  • You have strong practical and analytical skills
  • You are scientifically curious, critical and willing to revise methods when the data do not support initial assumptions.
  • You communicate clearly and contribute constructively to interdisciplinary teamwork.
  • You demonstrate research integrity, realistic planning and the persistence required to complete a three-year PhD project.
  • Employment in the position will be based on a comprehensive assessment of the qualification requirements, the relevance and quality of previous academic and practical experience, motivation for the project, scientific potential and personal suitability.

We need different perspectives in our work

  • UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that aims to provide an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. We fulfil our mission most effectively when we draw on different experiences, backgrounds and perspectives.
  • We will do our best to accommodate individual needs. Relevant adjustments may include adaptations to working hours, tasks, digital or physical tools, or other practical measures. Applicants with an immigrant background, a disability or gaps in their CV are encouraged to indicate this in the application portal. UiO invites at least one qualified applicant from each of these groups to interview in accordance with applicable state-sector procedures.
Why should you choose us?
  • A clearly defined and fully funded three-year PhD project with established core infrastructure.
  • Dedicated supervision and research training in dental biomaterials, development of wear-testing methods, crown-material processing, mechanical characterisation, surface characterisation, micro-CT and quantitative image analysis.
  • An interdisciplinary and internationally connected research environment at the Faculty of Dentistry.
  • Access to modern laboratories and opportunities for collaboration with clinical and engineering research groups.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities, good welfare schemes and up to 1.5 hours of exercise during working hours.(Good welfare schemes)
  • Membership in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (Statens Pensjonskasse), with beneficial pension, mortgage and insurance arrangements.
  • Oslo’s family-friendly environment, with extensive cultural and outdoor opportunities.
  • Dedicated mentoring and a professionally stimulating working environment.
  • Salary in position as Doctoral Research Fellow, position code 1017 in salary range NOK from 551000 - to 605000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.

How to apply

Your application must include:

  • A cover letter of no more than two pages describing your motivation for the position, your relevant academic and practical experience, and how your background matches the project.
  • A CV summarising education, work experience, research experience and other qualifying activities.
  • Copies of diplomas, academic transcripts and certificates. Applicants should retrieve available results from Vitnemålsportalen; where this is not possible, copies must be uploaded.
  • Documentation of English proficiency where required under the Faculty’s supplementary admission rules.
  • A complete list of publications and other academic work, if applicable, together with the work the applicant wishes the evaluation committee to consider.
  • Contact information for two to three references, including name, position, relationship to the applicant, e-mail address and telephone number.
  • The application and all attachments must be submitted through UiO’s electronic recruitment system, Jobbnorge, by clicking “Apply for the position”. All documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language. Applicants with education from outside Scandinavia should include an explanation of their university’s grading system and a Diploma Supplement where available. A recognition statement from the Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), if already obtained, may also be attached.
  • Particular emphasis will be placed on documented academic qualifications, relevant experimental competence, motivation and personal suitability. The best-qualified candidates will be invited to interview and may be asked to give a brief presentation of previous research or technical work.
General information

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian),  Guidelines concerning appointment to post doctoral and research posts at UiO and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees that is intended to secure the rights to all research results etc.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology, and services).

Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 28 000 students and 7000 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Faculty of Dentistry is one of the leading odontological research and educational institutions in Europe. The faculty's research groups contribute top research within several odontological fields.

In addition to educating dentists and dental hygienists, the Faculty has Ph.D program and professional-oriented specialist education. The Faculty holds significant competence in the various research and clinical disciplines, with good interdisciplinary collaboration. It is a modern faculty with approximately 420 students and approximately 420 employees. The faculty is also Norway's largest dental clinic with approximately 50,000 patient visits a year. The Faculty of Dentistry has two departments: Institute of Clinical Dentistry and Department of Oral Biology.

jobs.title: Waitors needed
jobs.description:
Are you looking for an exciting full-time job where you can grow and learn new things?

Then we have the perfect opportunity for you! We are looking for several enthusiastic full-time employees , preferably experienced waiters/waitresses, to join our wonderful team in the heart of Tromsø.

Who are we looking for?

We are looking for someone who:

  • Is over 18 years old (due to serving alcohol).

  • Learns quickly and enjoys new challenges.

  • Thrives in a fast-paced environment where the guest is always the main focus.

  • Speaks Norwegian and English fluently.

  • Is not afraid to step in and help when needed.

  • Is passionate about providing guests with a great experience.

  • Has an interest in food and wine and is curious to learn more.

  • Is flexible and able to work evenings, weekends, and holidays.

Personal qualities we value:

  • Service-minded with a big smile.

  • Cheerful, positive, and sociable.

  • Responsible and reliable.

  • Comfortable working both independently and as part of a team.

  • Organized, tidy, and detail-oriented in your work.

It's a plus if you:

  • Have knowledge of Asian cuisine.

  • Have experience from the service industry (experienced waiters/waitresses are preferred).

Training will be provided, but prior experience is highly valued. The most important thing is having the right attitude and a strong commitment to quality service.

Why work with us?

At Suvi, you'll be part of an inclusive work environment with friendly colleagues, varied workdays, and opportunities to develop both professionally and personally. We are proud of our exciting menu featuring sushi, Vietnamese dishes, and other flavors from Asian cuisine.

Interested?

Send us an email to suvi.tromso@gmail.com, telling us a bit about yourself and why you would like to work with us. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so don't wait too long!

NB: Please note that accommodation is not provided, and unfortunately we are not able to assist with housing.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Vi er en koselig restaurant midt i hjertet av Tromsø. Menyen vår byr på sushi, vietnamesisk mat og andre spennende retter fra det asiatiske kjøkken. Bli med på reisen og skap fantastiske matopplevelser sammen med oss!

jobs.title: Machine Control Specialist - Internationale technische groep
jobs.description:
Onze klant is een internationale technische organisatie actief in geavanceerde oplossingen voor de bouw- en infrastructuursector. Om de verdere groei van haar digitale dienstverlening te ondersteunen, zoekt zij een Machine Control Specialist. In deze functie combineer je technische expertise, probleemoplossend vermogen en klantencontact om machinegeleidings- en GPS-oplossingen succesvol te implementeren en te ondersteunen.


Jobomschrijving

  • Installeer en configureer 2D- en 3D-machinegeleidingssystemen.
  • Kalibreer en activeer GPS- en machinecontroloplossingen.
  • Voer technische interventies en storingsanalyses uit op locatie.
  • Ondersteun klanten bij het gebruik van digitale bouwtechnologieën.
  • Geef opleidingen aan operatoren en eindgebruikers.
  • Lever technische ondersteuning zowel onsite als remote.
  • Stel rapportages en technische documentatie op.
  • Adviseer klanten over optimalisaties en efficiëntere werkprocessen.

  • Bachelor Elektromechanica, Topografie, Landmeetkunde of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
  • Minimaal 3 tot 5 jaar ervaring binnen machine control, machine guidance of bouwtechnologie.
  • Kennis van systemen zoals Topcon, Leica, Trimble, IMC of vergelijkbare oplossingen.
  • Ervaring met GPS Machine Control, 2D/3D-geleiding en digitale bouwoplossingen.
  • Affiniteit met bouwmachines zoals graafmachines, bulldozers en graders.
  • Sterk technisch inzicht gecombineerd met een klantgerichte aanpak.
  • Zelfstandig, proactief en oplossingsgericht.
  • Uitstekende kennis van het Nederlands; kennis van het Frans is een plus.

jobs.title: Field service technieker professionele toestellen
jobs.description:
FunctieOver onze klant

Onze klant is al meer dan 50 jaar een gevestigde en gerespecteerde waarde binnen de elektrobranche, met meerdere succesvolle filialen in West-Vlaanderen. Zij zijn gespecialiseerd in het leveren, installeren en onderhouden van zowel hoogwaardige huishoudelijke apparatuur als professionele witgoedoplossingen. Denk hierbij aan bedrijfskritische installaties voor hotels, de horecasector, zorginstellingen en diverse ondernemingen. Het succes van dit dynamische familiebedrijf is gebouwd op een uitzonderlijke service, puur vakmanschap en een zeer hoge klantentevredenheid.

Jouw rol

Als Field Service Technieker Professionele Toestellen ben jij het professionele gezicht van de organisatie bij de zakelijke klanten. Jij zorgt ervoor dat hun apparatuur en installaties altijd optimaal en efficiënt blijven presteren.

Wat je doet
  • Vakkundig installeren en operationeel in gebruik nemen van professionele witgoedapparaten.
  • Zelfstandig uitvoeren van periodiek onderhoud en acute, dringende herstellingen ter plaatse.
  • Systematisch opsporen, analyseren en oplossen van zowel elektrische als mechanische storingen.
  • Proactief adviseren van klanten over een correct gebruik, optimaal onderhoud en energie-efficiëntie.
  • Nauwkeurig administratief rapporteren van de uitgevoerde interventies en het opvolgen van onderdelenbestellingen.
ProfielWie zoeken we?
  • Je hebt een gedegen technische opleiding genoten (elektromechanica, elektronica) of bent gelijkwaardig door relevante praktijkervaring.
  • Ervaring met witgoedtechnieken of professionele/industriële installaties vormt een sterke troef.
  • Je bent in staat om volledig zelfstandig te werken op verplaatsing, maar functioneert tevens als een betrouwbare teamspeler.
  • Je bent communicatief vaardig, klantgericht en denkt altijd in oplossingen.
  • Je bent in het bezit van een geldig rijbewijs B en bent flexibel ingesteld wat betreft verplaatsingen binnen de regio.
Wat je van ons krijgtWat bieden wij jou?
  • Een uiterst gevarieerde en uitdagende buitendienstfunctie met veel autonomie en verantwoordelijkheid.
  • Een aantrekkelijk en competitief salarispakket, passend bij jouw ervaring, aangevuld met mooie extralegale voordelen.
  • Een volledig uitgeruste, professionele servicewagen en hoogwaardig werkmateriaal.
  • Permanente ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden via zowel interne als externe technische opleidingen.
  • Werken binnen een gezonde, dynamische familiale onderneming met een ijzersterke marktpositie en een collegiale sfeer.
  • Een vlot interimtraject met een reële en snelle optie op een vast contract bij een positieve evaluatie.

Klaar om als technisch expert het verschil te maken bij professionele klanten?

.

jobs.title: Customer Service Medewerker

FunctieVivaldis Office is looking for a Customer Service Officer for our client in Hasselt. Our client is specialised in incident management and roadside assistance.
Feel free to take a look at the vacancy! If you have any questions, you can reach us by phone on +3211 94 81 56.

Your duties as a customer service officer will include:

  • You'll provide the needed technical support and communicate with the workshops;
  • You'll update all the involved parties;

Profiel

As a customer service officer you can recognise yourself in the criteria below:

  • Preferably you have gained a first experience in customer service;
  • You can easily work with the computer, especially with MS Office;
  • You're a social person with strong communication skills;
  • You have attention to detail and are stress-resistant;
  • You work organised and have great organizational and time management skills;
  • You must speak fluently Dutch/Polish/English OR Polish/ German/ English OR Dutch/ French/ English OR Dutch/German/Italian/French/English.
  • You work the weekend + Friday shift OR during the week. You work 40 hours/ week between 07.00-22.00h.
Wat je van ons krijgt

What's in it for you as the new customer service officer:

  • You'll end up in a leading company in an international environment;
  • You'll work in a full-time position with a strong emphasis on work-life balance;
  • You'll receive a competitive salary including meal vouchers worth €7 and eco-vouchers;
  • The company hosts various social events to boost the team spirit;
  • Hard work pays off! After a successful interim period you'll receive a permanent contract.

We look forward to your application if you're convinced of this vacancy.

jobs.title: AJUDANTE FAMILIAR
jobs.description:
O Ajudante de Ação Direta é um colaborador da Fundação AFID com intervenção direta junto dos Clientes das Respostas Sociais, atuando sob orientação do Diretor Técnico. A sua missão central é assegurar a execução dos planos individuais (PIC), garantindo o bem-estar, autonomia e qualidade de vida dos Clientes e suas famílias.
Competências Técnicas
Presta cuidados de higiene, conforto e alimentação, colabora na administração de medicação e apoia cuidados de saúde e reabilitação sob supervisão qualificada. Realiza registos diários,  assegura a manutenção e limpeza dos espaços residenciais e domiciliários.
Competências Relacionais e Sociais
Estabelece relação empática e de confiança com os Clientes, promovendo a sua integração progressiva nos serviços. Acompanha-os em atividades culturais, recreativas e externas (consultas, compras, saídas), informando-os sobre recursos comunitários disponíveis.
Competências Organizacionais
Articula com o Diretor, encarregada e restante equipa multidisciplinar, participando em reuniões e reportando ocorrências relevantes. Zela pelo património dos Clientes e da Fundação, gere artigos de higiene e conduz viaturas institucionais com responsabilidade.
Perfil Pessoal
Sentido de responsabilidade, discrição, respeito pela privacidade e proteção de dados, capacidade de trabalho em equipa e orientação para o serviço ao próximo são características essenciais para o desempenho desta função.

jobs.description:
Team Lead Sales Development

Festanstellung, Vollzeit · Berlin (HQ)

Deine Mission

Die Energiekosten in Europa sind doppelt so hoch wie in den USA und China. Gleichzeitig wird sich die Stromnachfrage bis 2050 voraussichtlich verdoppeln. Marktpreisvolatilität und zunehmende Komplexität werden uns erhalten bleiben. Damit steht das Rückgrat der europäischen Industrie unter Druck – und Unternehmen müssen jetzt handeln.

trawa entwickelt die Lösung: die erste integrierte B2B-Energieplattform, die Energiebeschaffung, Energiemanagement und die Steuerung von Flexibilitäten in einem Produkt vereint. Supply, Manage, Flex – kombiniert. Diese Integration ermöglicht Einsparungen von bis zu 30 % bei den wiederkehrenden Stromkosten und unterstützt Unternehmen gleichzeitig dabei, auf erneuerbare Energien umzusteigen.

Wir sind Europas am schnellsten wachsende B2B-Energieplattform. Aktuell sind wir in Deutschland und Österreich aktiv und planen, unsere Aktivitäten 2027 auf einen dritten Markt auszuweiten. Unser Ziel ist die europaweite Skalierung. Wir bewegen uns schnell – das Marktfenster ist offen, und wir wollen es nutzen.

Über trawa

trawa ist ein Scale-up mit Sitz in Berlin und rund 100 Mitarbeitenden, davon etwa 30 in Product & Tech. Bis heute haben wir mehr als 35 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, darunter eine Series-A-Finanzierungsrunde über 24 Millionen Euro im Mai 2025. Zu unseren Investoren zählen Balderton, Headline, Speedinvest, AENU, Magnetic und Tiny VC. Alle drei Gründer sind weiterhin aktiv dabei und zu 100 % committed, das Energieversorgungsunternehmen der Zukunft aufzubauen.

Wir suchen eine:n Team Lead Sales Development (SDR), um gemeinsam die nächste Wachstumsstufe zu erreichen. Du berichtest direkt an unseren Head of Sales und arbeitest eng mit unseren Commercial-Teams zusammen. Du gestaltest das Produkt mit, das die europäische Industrie wieder wettbewerbsfähiger macht – und setzt deine Ideen mit hohem Tempo um.

Die Position ist in Berlin angesiedelt. trawa ist ein Office-First-Unternehmen: In der Regel arbeitest du an fünf Tagen pro Woche aus unserem Büro.

Das Team

Das trawa SDR-Team ist ein zentraler Wachstumstreiber des Unternehmens und einer unserer wichtigsten Kanäle zur Generierung neuer Kundenbeziehungen. Das derzeit sechsköpfige Team vereint vielseitige Erfahrungen im Vertrieb und schafft dadurch ein dynamisches Umfeld. Nach einer Phase starken Wachstums liegt der Fokus nun darauf, diesen Erfolg weiter auszubauen und gemeinsam den nächsten Wachstumsschritt zu gestalten.

Wen wir suchen

  • Als Player-Coach übernimmst du die Verantwortung für den Erfolg des SDR-Teams und bist gleichzeitig selbst operativ aktiv. Du verbringst den überwiegenden Teil deiner Zeit mit Cold Calling und gehst mit deiner eigenen Performance als gutes Beispiel voran.

  • Du verantwortest die Team-Performance ganzheitlich, steuerst die Zielerreichung und entwickelst das Team kontinuierlich weiter.

  • Du identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale in Prozessen und Strukturen, bringst die Perspektive des Teams aktiv ein und setzt gemeinsam mit den relevanten Stakeholdern im Unternehmen Verbesserungen um.

  • Du bist ein zentraler Bestandteil des Recruiting-Prozesses für neue SDRs und sorgst gemeinsam mit dem Team für ein strukturiertes und erfolgreiches Onboarding neuer Teammitglieder.

Deine Ziele in den ersten 90 Tagen

  • Du hast ein fundiertes Verständnis für unsere Produkte und den Energiemarkt aufgebaut.

  • Du hast dich als feste Ansprechperson für alle Themen rund um das SDR-Team etabliert.

  • Deine eigene Performance im Cold Calling setzt erste neue Maßstäbe.

  • Du hast erste Optimierungspotenziale zur Steigerung der Team-Performance identifiziert und daraus konkrete Maßnahmen abgeleitet.

Was dir zum Erfolg verhilft

  • Kommunikationsstärke, Überzeugungskraft und hohes Durchsetzungsvermögen zeichnen dich aus.

  • Du kommst leicht mit Menschen ins Gespräch, verstehst Bedürfnisse und stellst passende Lösungen überzeugend vor.

  • Du gehst Aufgaben mit Eigeninitiative und klarer Zielorientierung an.

  • Du denkst analytisch und strukturiert: Komplexe Prozesse zerlegst du gerne in einzelne Schritte, erkennst Optimierungspotenziale und triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis von Zahlen und Metriken.

  • Du hast umfangreiche Erfahrungen rund um vertrieblichen Methoden und Techniken.

  • Erfahrung in der Energiewirtschaft ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.

Warum trawa?

Wirkung: Europäische KMU geben jährlich zwischen 150.000 und 10 Millionen Euro für Strom aus – viele davon zahlen zu viel und sind an veraltete Beschaffungsmodelle gebunden. Mit unserem Produkt veränderst du unmittelbar, wie Tausende Unternehmen Energie einkaufen, managen und nutzen. Die Wirkung ist messbar, der Markt ist riesig und der Zeitpunkt ist jetzt.

Verantwortung: Bei uns übernimmst du Verantwortung für deine Themen und treibst Ergebnisse voran – unabhängig von deinem Hintergrund oder deiner bisherigen Berufserfahrung.

Lernen und Entwicklung: Wir stellen dir ein jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget und feste Zeit für deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung zur Verfügung. Dich erwarten Mentoring, vielfältige Lernmöglichkeiten und echte Perspektiven für deinen nächsten Karriereschritt.

Vielfalt und Inklusion: Wir sind ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit lebt, und unser Team spiegelt das wider. Menschen aus mehr als 15 Nationen bringen unterschiedliche Sprachen, Erfahrungen und Perspektiven zusammen. Bei trawa ist Familienfreundlichkeit auf allen Ebenen selbstverständlich – in unserem Team und in der Führung arbeiten Eltern. Vergütung und Benefits: Wir bieten ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket mit Gehalt und Stock Options, 30 Urlaubstagen sowie zahlreichen Benefits. Bei trawa bauen wir einen vielfältigen, inklusiven und authentischen Arbeitsplatz auf. jobs.title: Accounts Receivable Accountant
jobs.description:
Accounts Receivable Accountant

Permanent employee · Full-time · Berlin (HQ)

Our Mission For You

Own the process that turns invoices into cash, and shape how trawa's Finance function scales with our customer base.

trawa enables mid-sized industrial and commercial companies to access green, intelligent energy. We're in a hyper-growth phase in one of the most complex markets in Germany. It's a rare moment to join: the foundations are being built right now, the problems are real, and the room to shape how Finance runs at scale is wide open.

This is one of the most critical roles in the company. Cash is what enables trawa's growth, and you own the process that protects it. Every reconciliation you close, every overdue account you resolve, every dispute you clean up feeds directly into how fast we can move.

As our Accounts Receivable Accountant, you'll own the end-to-end AR and collections process. You'll be the person customers talk to when something on an invoice isn't clear, and the person internally who makes sure open items don't stay open. You'll work closely with Customer Success, Business Operations, and our Finance team.

If you're excited by ownership, an AI-first way of working, and building something that actually matters, this is your role.


What You'll Own

Collections and Dunning

  • Own the collections cadence end-to-end: monitor AR aging, prioritise the highest-impact accounts, and drive them to resolution via email and phone.

  • Reduce DSO measurably. You set the pace, we give you the tools and the mandate.

  • Manage our dunning process reliably and with the right tone: firm on cash, respectful of the customer relationshipDebitorenbuchhaltung und operative Prozesse.

Reconciliation and Cash Application

  • Reconcile incoming payments against open invoices, investigate and resolve unapplied cash, short-pays, and discrepancies.

  • Run structured reconciliations reliably, and independently drive ad-hoc analyses for complex payments or edge cases.

  • Support month-end close with AR reconciliations and clean aging reports.

Ticket Ownership and Customer Interaction

  • Take ownership of our AR ticket queue, which is currently high-volume and one of the most visible pain points across the company. You get on top of it, categorise what's coming in, and resolve the majority of tickets directly.

  • Be the go-to Finance contact for customers on all relevant topics: invoicing, payments, and account requests.

  • Work closely with Customer Success and BizOps to resolve customer issues end-to-end and make sure Finance topics don't get stuck between teams.


Who You Are

Must-haves

  • 3+ years of experience in Accounts Receivable, Collections, or Credit Control, or a comparable Finance role. Ideally in a high-volume and complex B2B environment

  • Solid understanding of AR processes: dunning, cash application, reconciliations, and month-end AR work.

  • Confident with customers in writing and on the phone. You can be firm on cash without damaging the relationship.

  • Strong ownership mindset. You don't wait for someone to flag a problem. You spot it, dig into the root cause, and drive it to resolution across stakeholders.

  • Structured, analytical, and detail-oriented. You keep complex open items straight without losing the bigger picture.

  • Business fluent in English and solid written German (customer correspondence in German needs to work reliably). Spoken German is a strong plus but not required.

  • Comfortable in the standard office and analytics toolset (Excel or Google Sheets) and able to navigate independently.

Nice-to-haves

  • A degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a comparable field, or a solid vocational qualification (e.g. Bilanzbuchhalter:in IHK, Steuerfachangestellte:r, kaufmännische Ausbildung). We care about what you can do, not the badge on your CV.

  • Experience with AI-powered reconciliation tools or modern ticketing systems.

  • Genuine curiosity for AI and automation. Bonus if you've already used Langdock, Claude, or similar tools to speed up your own work.

  • Experience in a fast-growing start-up or scale-up environment.


Your First 90 Days

Month 1: Understand

  • Understand trawa's business model, customer base, and billing logic, including what makes energy billing genuinely complex

  • Map our AR process end-to-end (invoicing, collections, cash application, close) and get to know your key counterparts in Customer Success, BizOps, and Accounting

  • Take over recurring work: ticket triage, aging analysis, dunning follow-ups

Month 2: Take Ownership

  • Run the AR cycle largely independently: aging monitored proactively, customer follow-ups sent on time, accounts reconciled cleanly

  • Contribute to your first month-end close reliably and on time

  • Identify one concrete process gap in collections, reconciliation, or ticket handling, and come with a plan to fix it

Month 3: Build and Improve

  • You're the reliable Finance point of contact for customer-facing AR topics. The ticket backlog is under control and issues get resolved before they escalate

  • DSO is trending in the right direction and month-end contributions are delivered without follow-up

  • You've shipped at least one meaningful process improvement and can point to its impact

  • You're actively shaping how our AR processes scale as trawa's customer base grows


Why trawa?

  • Direct collaboration with Finance leadership and cross-functional leaders from day one. Short paths, real decisions, real ownership

  • A uniquely complex business at the intersection of energy, software, and B2B operations. You'll learn a lot, fast

  • An AI-first and automation-first Finance team. You'll set up scalable processes and drive them forward through process automation and larger tool implementations.

  • Real room to grow as trawa scales, your scope grows with the company.

  • Flexible working, 30 vacation days, L&D budget, competitive compensation, VSOPs (share package), meal vouchers, Urban Sports Club membership, and a vibrant office culture in Berlin

Diversity at trawa

Everyone is welcome here. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace that values diversity, and we encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of origin, gender, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, physical or neurodiverse background.

Don't worry if you don't tick every box. We value ownership, learning speed, and aren't hunger over a perfect CV.

We're looking for an ambitious PM ready to build Nelly's Growth function from scratch - owning the full journey from sign-up to habit across our software, AI, and fintech surfaces, with direct impact on NRR. If you want real ownership and zero hand-holding, this is it.

 

About Nelly

We are building the AI-Driven Financial Operating System for European healthcare, solving the biggest challenges for patients and practices. We create what no bank or software platform can handle. Our all-in-one platform transforms chaotic administrative processes into intelligent, automated workflows, from patient care to billing to next-generation payments. Because we truly believe: healthcare should be less about paperwork and more about people.

Why? Because Europe is facing a massive shortage of medical professionals. And if we don't rethink the way practices work, the system won't be able to keep up. With our Series B funding of over €50 million from world-class investors, we are turning our vision into reality.

What sets us apart: We work with the best team, which is why we give everything together every day. We believe in Talent Density, because exceptional people make everyone around them better. At Nelly, we move fast and expect everyone to keep up. Stagnation isn’t an option, which is why we invest heavily in growth. AI isn't a nice-to-have at Nelly. We expect you to use it every day and give you everything you need to do so. You get trust and ownership and we expect you to speak up, even when it's uncomfortable.

Joining us, you will:

  • Translate Nelly's company vision into specific, prioritized bets across acquisition, activation, and monetisation, informed by data, experimentation, and customer behavior

  • Own the end-to-end user journey: from partial sign-up through setup, first value, and habit formation - across Nelly's software, AI, and fintech products, and continuously sharpen each stage

  • Build platform-level growth capabilities that compound across surfaces , not features that live in one place

  • Design and run a rigorous experimentation and measurement program. Form hypotheses, define metrics, ship A/B tests at high velocity, learn fast, and ship what moves the numbers

  • Collaborate deeply with Design, Engineering, Marketing, and Product Leadership on both strategy and execution

  • Inform pricing, packaging, and self-serve strategy in partnership with GTM and finance leadership - including how we package across software, AI, and fintech to drive expansion (vertical & geo)

What you'll bring:

Note: If you don't meet all the criteria, we still encourage you to apply and make the case for why you'd be a great fit. If you're exceptional talent, we're happy to adapt.

  • Shipped exceptional B2B/prosumer growth products in high-velocity environments - you care deeply about user outcomes and winning with the product

  • 3+ years in product management with hands-on PLG (and ideally PLS) experience: you've built and owned elaborated growth motions on complex B2B workflow products

  • High agency and high learning velocity: you run a high volume of hypothesis-driven bets, move fast in ambiguity, say "no" when needed, and are comfortable building from zero

  • Strong analytical skills and data mindset around A/B testing, optimization, and defining growth metrics

  • Strong data mindset: you create data acquisition and evaluation strategies, track product and agent metrics (utilization rates, precision & recall), understand online vs. offline eval trade-offs, and use insights to drive better customer outcomes

  • Passion for AI technology and its potential to reshape product-led growth

  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration across Engineering, Design, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success

Even better if you have:

  • German or Italian proficiency - you can discuss real work with dentists, ZFAs/ZMVs, and billing partners

  • Experience growing products for SMB customers in less-digital European verticals (healthcare, construction, legal, architecture, or similar) where adoption is hard-won and not a given

  • Experience with self-serve, freemium, or PQL-driven growth motions

  • Experience with high-growth SaaS products using usage or outcome-based pricing, where you owned strategies to drive net revenue retention (NRR) growth

What we offer:

  • Deutschlandticket (public transport pass covering all of Germany) or a Swapfiets membership to cruise through the city

  • Urban Sports membership to sweat, stretch, or sauna your way through the week

  • Top of the line working equipment

  • Flexible hours and a hybrid setup in the heart of Berlin

  • Enjoy up to 4 weeks of workation wherever inspiration hits

  • A cozy, dog-friendly office where good vibes are basically mandatory

  • A fridge full of cold drinks and snacks waiting to be claimed

jobs.description:

Want real hands-on experience in B2B SaaS marketing — running webinars, shaping demand gen campaigns, and building the AI-powered systems that run our marketing team? Then it's an exciting time to join Luminovo!

We help electronics manufacturers and OEMs manage one of the most complex supply chains in the world by bringing sourcing, quoting, and procurement into a single, modern platform. As we scale, our marketing team needs more hands to keep webinars, campaigns, and content moving — and that's where you come in.

Here's what makes this opportunity different: we run "AI by default", and we're one of the first marketing teams making tools like Claude a daily habit, not a nice-to-have. You'll spend real time watching how the team works, spotting the recurring manual tasks, and building the automations and workflows that remove them. Nowhere else will you get this kind of head start on how AI is about to reshape marketing work.

We're hiring for this role in two flavors — pick whichever matches your situation:

  • Working student: 20h/week, ongoing

  • Intern: 3–6 months, full-time (with the option to convert to a permanent role)

Both cover the same scope and both start 01 September 2026, based hybrid out of our Munich office.

You won't be doing busywork. You'll cut the webinar clips that actually get watched, build the campaign assets that go live, help ship the case studies our sales team uses to close deals, and build the AI workflows that free up the whole team's time. You'll work directly with 7 people across the whole marketing team — so in a few months you'll have touched more of B2B SaaS marketing (and modern AI tooling) than most internships give you in a year.

If you're hungry, a fast learner, and want real mentorship instead of coffee runs, we'd love to hear from you!

Fluency in German and English is a must. Our webinar program tilts US/UK, so your English needs to be excellent — German is needed for the DACH content stream and recap posts.

💡 SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE, AND EXPERTISE

We purposefully did not create a standard list of minimum qualifications for this role. What matters most: you're currently studying (or recently graduated), curious about B2B/SaaS marketing, tech, and AI, and organized enough to juggle small recurring tasks across different stakeholders. Luminovo is the first electronics supply chain platform that unites all data, processes, and stakeholders in the trillion-dollar electronics industry.

We fundamentally believe that technology is the best tool that humankind has developed to tackle the biggest challenges we face as a society today. And we want to do our share in accelerating technological progress.

To date, over 300 active customers worldwide are working with us towards this shared goal. Supported by leading investors such as Cherry Ventures, General Catalyst/LaFamiglia, Chalfen Ventures, and others, we have raised more than €20 million.

Die Rolle

Diese Rolle ist für erfahrene Audit-Professionals, die keine Checklisten mehr abarbeiten wollen sondern Systeme entwickeln möchten, die sie überflüssig machen.

Du bringst tiefes Praxiswissen darüber mit, wie Prüfungen wirklich funktionieren, und übersetzt dieses Wissen in strukturierte Logik, die unsere Software skalierbar ausführen kann. Du musst kein:e Entwickler:in sein.   • Nahtlose Umsetzung: Wir arbeiten fokussiert, schnell und mit hohem Anspruch an regulatorische Exzellenz. Sorgfalt ist für uns kein Hindernis, sondern die Grundlage für verlässlichen Fortschritt.

jobs.description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

Basic knowledge of server hardware, storage technologies, RAID configurations, and infrastructure monitoring.
Experience working with ticketing systems, monitoring platforms, log management, or remote administration tools.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple issues simultaneously.
English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate (B2) level or above.

Zodpovednosť za pravidelnú údržbu prevádzky a opravy (voda, elektrika, výmena žiaroviek, opravy svietidiel, klimatizácia, vzduchotechnika). Hlavná činnosť je zameraná na fyzický výkon práce. Všetky údržbárske práce v areáli prevádzky. Bezodkladné riešenie vzniknutých problémov a nedostatkov a ich následné hlásenie kompetentným osobám. Znalosť technických parametrov a špecifikácie používaných prístrojov a zariadení. Zapisovanie hodnôt z plynomerov, vodomerov. Výpomoc pri kosení areálu, vysádzaní kvetináčov a udržiavaní poriadku v areáli prevádzky, odpratávanie snehu, výkopové práce. V rámci dosiahnutého vzdelania a kvalifikácie (získané osvedčenia) prevádza všetky pridelené údržbárske práce.
Výhody:Stravovanie zabezpečené zamestnávateľom za symbolickú úhradu. Po uplynutí skúšobnej doby nárok na: - možnosť výmenných rekreácii v našich zariadeniach, - príspevok na III.pilier DDS, - multisport karta, - nepravidelné odmeny. Jedná sa o prácu na 12-hodinové zmeny podľa harmonogramu od pondelka do nedele.

jobs.title: Čalúnnici a podobní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Náplň práce Pracovná náplň nie je obmedzená len na nižšie uvedené činnosti a zamestnanec môže byť podľa prevádzkových potrieb zamestnávateľa poverený aj ďalšími súvisiacimi pracovnými úlohami. Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.
Výhody:Hradené, vlastná doprava zamestnávateľa

Lujzy de Marillac a pridaj sa k nám do tímu opatrovateľov! Ako opatrovateľ, opatrovateľka budeš mať možnosť: ​ • prispievať k zlepšeniu zdravotného stavu klienta formou starostlivosti o osobnú hygienu klienta, či pomoci pri presune na lôžko či invalidný vozík • zabezpečovať výdaj stravy, ako aj nevyhnutného ošatenia a obuvi • asistovať pri sprevádzaní klienta k lekárovi a bežných denných aktivitách • podporovať klienta pri každodenných činnostiach • vykonávať administratívne činnosti spojené s poskytovaním služieb klientom • podieľať sa na tímových poradách a skupinových supervíziach Láka Ťa práca opatrovateľa, ale máš obavu, či to zvládneš? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude sprevádzať šikovný kolega a neskôr budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať certifikovaný opatrovateľský kurz hradený organizáciou. Okrem toho Ťa počas roka čakajú vzdelávacie programy, ktoré Ti pomôžu pri práci s klientom Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce, ktorí by radi počas štúdia pretavili svoje doterajšie vedomosti pri priamej práci s klientom v praxi Týždenný pracovný čas je 37,5h (za mesiac to je 13-14 pracovných zmien). Práca je rozložená na denné a nočné zmeny (v priemere 5-6 nočných zmien mesačne). Denná služba v čase 7:45 - 20:15h a nočná služba v čase 19:45 - 8:15h. ☝️Čo je Útulok a ZOS sv. Lujzy de Marillac a aký Ťa čaká pracovný tím? V zariadení sociálnych služieb sa už 15 rokov venujeme pomoci ľuďom ohrozeným stratou bývania alebo skúsenosťou so životom na ulici, ktorí majú zdravotné ťažkosti a častokrát nemajú dostupné možnosti k doliečeniu svojho stavu. Práve u nás im poskytujeme celodennú starostlivosť s víziou zlepšenia či stabilizovania ich zdravia. V zariadení máme kapacitu 35 klientov, väčšinou v staršom veku. Aj napriek ťažkým životným skúsenostiam našich klientov neopúšťa radosť a snaha o riešenie svojho stavu. Počas týždňa sa klienti zapájajú do rôznych aktivít, ako ranné rozcvičky, prechádzky, návšteva galérie, trhov, spoločné varenie, výroba bezodpadových podpaľovačov a iné. Náš tím opatrovateľov aktuálne tvorí osem kolegov a kolegýň spolu s vedúcou opatrovateľkou, počas dňa sa stretneš aj s vedúcim a zástupkyňou zariadenia, ako aj so sociálnymi pracovníkmi, zdravotnou sestrou a koordinátorkou aktivít. jobs.title: Terénni sociálni a zdravotní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá má zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Depaul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! ​Len v Bratislave žije odhadom viac ako 5 000 ľudí bez domova. Mnohí z nich navštevujú naše zariadenia, no ešte väčšia skupina sa ukrýva priamo v uliciach, vlastnoručne postavených príbytkoch či opustených chatrčiach. Ako najväčší terénny tím v Bratislave navštevujeme Karlovu Ves, Dúbravku, Lamač a Devínsku Novú Ves, aby sme pomáhali i tým, ktorí za nami prísť nedokážu. Našim cieľom je vyhľadávať a oslovovať ľudí bez domova v ich prirodzenom prostredí, poskytovať im sociálne a psychologické poradenstvo, základné zdravotné ošetrenie, materiálnu pomoc, sprevádzanie v kríze a prepájať ich na dostupné služby a bývanie. Veríme, že solidarita a spoločná práca môže ľuďom v núdzi darovať nádej a silu na nový začiatok. Ako terénny sociálny pracovník/sociálna pracovníčka budeš: - aktívne vyhľadávať a kontaktovať osoby a rodiny so sociálnymi problémami v rámci lokality a cieľovej skupiny (osoby z marginalizovaných rómskych komunít, ľudia bez domova), - posudzovať životné situácie človeka v spoločenskom, ekonomickom, politickom kontexte lokality/regiónu/spoločnosti, - identifikovať zdroje možností a schopností klienta a jeho sociálneho prostredia potrebných pre dosiahnutie stanovených cieľov klientom, - posky­tovať podporu v krízových situáciách osobám z cieľovej skupiny a sprístupnenie ostatných foriem pomoci, - poskytovať sociálne poradenstvo na úrovni základného a špecializovaného sociálneho poradenstva v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, - poskytovať pomoc pri uplatňovaní práv a právom chránených záujmov jednotlivca v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, príp. znevýhodnených skupín obyvateľov na lokálnej/regionálnej úrovni, - vykonávať preventívne aktivity v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách s cieľom predchádzať sociálnemu vylúčeniu alebo jeho prehlbovaniu, zmierňovanie negatívnych dopadov a zvyšovanie kvality života ľudí žijúci v podmienkach sociálneho vylúčenia a generačnej chudoby, - vykonávať aktivity, ktoré prispievajú k zmierňovaniu napätia a latentných konfliktov v lokalite, - spolupracovať s inštitúciami a organizáciami pôsobiacimi v lokalite/regióne a koordinovať ich v záujme klienta/skupiny/komunity, - sprostredkovávať kontakt, prípadne distribuovať a sprevádzať klienta k odborníkovi, do nadväzných služieb (napr. sociálne, psychologické, pedagogické, zdravotné služby a pod.) s ohľadom na potrebu klienta, - vykonávať technicko-administratívne úkony v rámci evidencie terénnej sociálnej práce, - priebežný rozvoj odborných a sociálnych kompetencií, účasť na vzdelávaní a supervíziách, - vykonávať činností prevažne v prirodzenom prostredí klienta (v domácnosti, komunite, vo voľnom priestranstve), - dodržiavať Štandardy terénnej sociálnej práce a terénnej práce vo vylúčení a Etického kódexu sociálneho pracovníka a asistenta sociálne práce Slovenskej republiky.

Pre činnosť našej organizácie sú najdôležitejší naši zamestnanci – Depaul ľudia – profesionáli s veľkým srdcom, trpezlivosťou a empatiou. Pracujeme v priateľskom kolektíve, podporujme vzdelávanie, supervízie a teambulidingové aktivity. Láka ťa práca v nocľahárni, ale premýšľaš, či máš dostatok skúseností? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude v práci sprevádzať skúsený tím kolegov. Postupne budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať školenia a supervízie, ktoré ti pomôžu pri práci s klientmi. Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce alebo príbuzných humanitárnych odborov, ktorí by radi svoje doterajšie vedomosti preniesli do praxe. Náš tím tvorí viacero pomáhajúcich pracovníkov a počas dňa stretneš aj skvelých sociálnych pracovníkov, koordinátorky dobrovoľníkov a komunitné organizátorky či vedúcu nocľahárne s jej zástupkyňami. Viac informácií o nocľahárni a útulku nájdeš na našej webovej stránke https://depaul.sk/, v časti Naše služby, alebo vo video vizitke: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9IufpprxiqU Tešíme sa na teba :) !

Dare to lead in steel.

Til jij ons montageteam naar een hoger niveau?

Werken bij Aelterman? Dat is kiezen voor lef! Hier ga je voor verantwoordelijkheid, zoek je de grenzen op en neem je initiatief. Aelterman is een toonaangevende speler in Europese staalbouw en verrast met elk project door innovatie en topkwaliteit. Onze bruggenbouwers gaan altijd tot het uiterste en verbinden mensen en plaatsen op een unieke manier.

Locatie: Gent-Zeehaven

2 ploegen: 6u – 14u en 14u – 22u

Jouw uitdagingen als hoofdmonteur:

  • Aansturen – Je leidt een ploeg van monteurs en stuurt ook lassers en onderaannemers aan. Je geeft richting, volgt de voortgang op en grijpt in waar nodig. Je houdt altijd het totaaloverzicht en zorgt ervoor dat iedereen weet wat, hoe en wanneer iets moet gebeuren.
  • Meewerken – Je bent een voorman die het vak beheerst en zelf de handen vuil maakt. Branden, lassen, monteren: je draait actief mee in de uitvoering en toont het goede voorbeeld in aanpak, tempo en kwaliteit.
  • Plannen en organiseren – Je start elke dag met een kort overleg aan de werktafel. Je bespreekt de dagplanning, legt technische plannen uit en verdeelt het werk over je team. Je plant vooruit, denkt oplossingsgericht en zorgt dat het werk veilig, correct en efficiënt verloopt.
  • Communiceren – Als hoofdmonteur ben je de schakel tussen de vloer en de werkplaatsleiding. Je communiceert duidelijk, respectvol en doelgericht, zowel in je team als in je rapportering. Je bewaakt afspraken, volgt veiligheid en werkuren op, en zorgt voor een sterke teamdynamiek en goede samenwerking.

Wat breng jij mee?

  • Je hebt al flink wat kilometers op de teller in staalconstructie of montage.
  • Je kan technische plannen lezen én deze vertalen naar actie op de vloer.
  • Je volgde een opleiding in mechanica of lassen & constructie, of je bent ondertussen gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
  • Je steekt graag zelf de handen uit de mouwen, en geeft het goede voorbeeld in aanpak en attitude.
  • Je werkt veilig, ordelijk en met respect voor collega’s, materiaal en deadlines.
  • Je communiceert vlot in het Nederlands en Engels.

jobs.title: Capyx - Mainframe - Application Life Cycle Management
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Mainframe Application Life Cycle Management Specialist to join a strategic project with a leading organisation in Belgium.
The role is primarily focused on Mainframe application development, deployment and lifecycle management. The organisation uses Kobee as its Application Life Cycle Management platform, but previous Kobee experience is not required.
We are therefore particularly interested in candidates with a strong background in Mainframe environments, application lifecycle management, JCL, release management, deployment processes and Mainframe development tooling, who are willing to learn Kobee.

Your responsibilities

  • Provide technical support to Mainframe application developers.
  • Analyse and resolve issues related to Mainframe application development and lifecycle management.
  • Support application build, packaging, deployment and release processes.
  • Develop, maintain and troubleshoot JCL used in application lifecycle processes.
  • Support the installation, configuration and upgrade of the Application Life Cycle Management environment.
  • Automate and optimise Mainframe development and deployment processes.
  • Work closely with Mainframe developers, application teams and infrastructure teams.
  • Analyse technical issues across the application lifecycle and identify appropriate solutions.
  • Improve and standardise development, testing and deployment processes.
  • Contribute to the evolution of the Mainframe ALM / DevOps environment.
  • Develop expertise in the organisation's ALM tooling, including Kobee.
We are looking for a hands-on Mainframe professional with solid experience in Mainframe application development and/or Application Life Cycle Management.
Essential experience:
  • Several years of professional experience in a Mainframe environment.
  • Strong understanding of Mainframe application development and deployment processes.
  • Good knowledge of JCL and experience creating, maintaining and troubleshooting JCL scripts.
  • Experience with Mainframe application lifecycle, release or deployment management.
  • Experience working with Mainframe development or change-management tools.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
  • Ability to work closely with developers and technical teams.
  • Comfortable learning new technical tools and environments.
Experience with technologies such as:
  • JCL, Cobol,CICS, DB2, IMS, z/OS, TSO/ISPF
  • Mainframe batch processing
  • Mainframe application deployment and release processes
  • Knowledge of Java and Tomcat is a plus.
  • Previous Kobee experience is not mandatory.

Goesting om aan de slag te gaan als arbeider wegenbouw?

Als grondwerker/wegeniswerker mag je je verwachten aan een gevarieerde en fysieke job. Je dag zal er ongeveer als volgt uitzien:

Profiel

Wat je in huis hebt:

  • Jouw motivatie en enthousiasme doet iedereen met plezier aan de werkdag beginnen 
  • Je hebt een sterke zin voor verantwoordelijkheid

Wat dacht je van dit geweldige bouwpakket?

Je stapt binnen bij een bedrijf dat groeit als een supervrucht en waar je de vrijheid krijgt om je skills te ontplooien. 

En wees gerust, de mogelijkheid om verantwoordelijkheid op te nemen is hier net zo normaal als mortel bij een metser en dakpannen bij een dakwerker.  

De communicatie in ons bedrijf staat centraal, het lijkt wel een op callcenter voor open en directe communicatie. 

Let's talk about money! ?? ??

  • We bieden een voltijdse job in dagdienst, zodat je genoeg tijd hebt om van de zon te genieten. 

Vakantie?

Ja zeker! Zo heb je 32 vakantiedagen (incl.12 ADV-dagen) waar je van kan genieten. 

Bouwverlof inplannen? Dat kan zeker want dit maakt ook deel uit van je voordelen.

Na een geslaagde interimperiode, of wie weet, zelfs eerder, ligt er een vast contract op je te wachten, als een solide fundament voor je toekomst.

Dus waar wacht je nog op? Stuur ons je enthousiasme via ?? kortrijk@vivaldisconstruct.be of bel ons op ?? 056/89.19.09

We kunnen niet wachten om je te ontmoeten! ?????????

jobs.title: Group Controller - Holding in Brussels
jobs.description:
The Group Controller will be responsible for the finances of the holding and the consolidation for the analytic Reporting at Group Level. The role includes a quite operational maintenance of the business controlling, with an eye for details and a strong analytical mind, as well as the opportunity to discuss strategic matters and have a direct impact on the results of the company, driving the financial performance of the Group.


Jobomschrijving

The Group Controller plays a role at the center of the group activities and will manage a wide range of responsibilities. This role is transverse with a global vision and the will to have an impact.

Group consolidation and financial reporting

  • Coordinate group-wide budgets, forecasts, and long-term planning across all entities
  • Contribute to financial reporting for executive management, Board, and Audit Committee
  • Provide financial analysis to support management decision-making



Monitoring of holding costs

  • Coordinate and monitor holding-level costs during budget and forecast cycles
  • Consolidate and analyze intercompany cost data
  • Ensure correct and consistent application of transfer pricing policies



Continuous improvement of financial processes and tools

  • Drive improvements in financial processes, reporting, and tools
  • Collaborate with controlling teams to implement best practices
  • Support standardization and automation initiatives across finance

The Group Controller presents a certain set of hard and soft skills:

  • Master's degree in finance, Business Management, Economics - or equivalent
  • Around 4-5 years of experience in Finance (ideally in a controlling position)
  • Excellent command of French & English - Dutch is a plus
  • Experience with SAP
  • An affinity with process management and IT tools
  • Solution oriented and Proactive
  • Critical mindset
  • Excellent communication skills and partnering approach



The Group Controller - Consolidation will have the unique opportunity to enter a well-established, leader in its market company within a dynamic and new Financial Team. It is the opportunity to be part of a real project and to bring direct added value to the function and the Group.
