jobs.title: Maatwerkcoach Productie - site Eeklo en uitwerk (vervanging)
jobs.description:
Bij Mirto doen we aan eerlijk ondernemen met een gezonde commerciële visie en aandacht voor mens en milieu. Professioneel met een menselijke aanpak. Mirto vzw is gevestigd op twee sites: in Gent en in Eeklo, waar we samen zo’n 300 medewerkers met een afstand tot de reguliere arbeidsmarkt tewerkstellen.

Om ons team te versterken zijn wij op zoek naar een maatwerkcoach / werkbegeleider om met een team van maatwerkers verschillende verpakkingsopdrachten te realiseren. We zijn fier op ons werk en ziet er alles over hier: https://mirto.be/klantencases/

Als maatwerkcoach speel je een dubbele rol: enerzijds in de ontwikkeling van onze maatwerkers, anderzijds in het realiseren van de opdracht van de klant. Hoe dan concreet?

  • Je organiseert de werkpost en verdeelt het werk onder jouw teamleden op basis van de (aan te leren) competenties van onze maatwerkers: jij beslist wie waar staat en zit. Liggen dat doen we niet.
  • Je mindset: laarzen-aan-en-gaan! Je staat samen met de maatwerkers in het werkveld: je bent een meewerkende coach, maar niet zonder het overzicht over de voortgang te verliezen. 15 000 stappen, laat maar komen.
  • Je checkt continu het resultaat van jouw team en hebt oog voor kwaliteit, veiligheid en efficiëntie.
  • Je laat jouw team groeien via feedbackgesprekken, coaching op de werkvloer, het geven van opleidingen, … en verliest jouw eigen ontwikkeling niet uit het oog.
  • Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor onze maatwerkers. Een moeilijke dag voor een maatwerker of een conflict in het team? Dan los jij dit op waar het kan en verwijs je door wanneer het moet.
  • Je neemt eigenaarschap om klantenopdrachten goed te volbrengen en overlegt dagelijks met jouw collega's, klantentolken en leidinggevende.
  • Je bent flexibel en houdt van variatie in opdrachten en in werklocaties. Zo kan je zowel werken in Mirto Eeklo, als op verplaatsing bij specifieke klanten in Gent Zeehaven.

Vanuit jouw betrokkenheid voel je je verbonden met de waarden, missie en visie van Mirto en ga je als maatwerkcoach op een respectvolle manier om met mens en materiaal.

  • Je hebt goesting en power om voltijds aan de slag te zijn.
  • Je hebt een rijbewijs B om met een team van Mirtolisten op uitwerk te gaan. Want sommige productieopdrachten voeren we uit bij de klant ter plaatse.
  • Ervaring in een organiserende of leidinggevende functie is een groot pluspunt, net zoals ervaring in de verpakkingssector, orderpicking of productie.
  • Je bent positief en sociaal ingesteld en je gelooft in de sterktes van onze medewerkers.
  • Je denkt oplossingsgericht en werkt nauwkeurig en ordelijk.
  • Je houdt het hoofd koel wanneer iets niet volgens plan verloopt, je bent flexibel en past je gemakkelijk aan bij veranderingen.
  • Je hebt goede communicatieve vaardigheden, zowel naar je collega’s als naar de maatwerkers.

jobs.title: Nachtverpleegkundige SP Locomotorische revalidatie Beveren (tijdelijk)
jobs.description:
Voor de gespecialiseerde dienst Locomotorische revalidatie op campus Beveren zoeken we een nachtverpleegkundige.
Deze dienst staat in voor de behandeling en revalidatie van patiënten met locomotorische en neurologische aandoeningen. De meest voorkomende pathologieën zijn onder andere CVA, ziekte van Parkinson, rugoperaties, heup- en knieprotheses.

- Je biedt kwaliteitsvolle totaalzorg aan: lichaamsverzorging, medicatiezorg, voeding en verpleegtechnische zorgen. Je hebt daarbij zowel aandacht voor de lichamelijke als psychische en sociale zorgen.
- Als verpleegkundige ontwikkel je een zorgplan voor elke patiënt en pas je dit aan aan de evolutie van de patiënt.
- Gedurende het revalidatieproces treed je op als coach en vertrouwenspersoon van de patiënt.
- Als verpleegkundige op de afdeling SP revalidatie, voel je dat de positiviteit de boventoon voert. Je helpt mensen met het optimaliseren van de zelfredzaamheid. Elke dag is anders, maar het uitgangspunt is 'mensen bevorderen in hun zelfstandigheid'.
- Daarnaast zorg je voor een goede informatiedoorstrooming naar alle betrokken medewerkers (verpleegkundigen, arts, kinesist, logopedist, ergotherapeut,...) om de revalidatie van de patiënten zo goed mogelijk te laten verlopen.

Voor de overige taakinhouden verwijzen we naar de functieomschrijving ' Verpleegkundige Verantwoordelijk voor de Algemene Zorg '. Interne kandidaten kunnen dit terugvinden op NIKOdoc, externe kandidaten kunnen dit bekomen bij de dienst Personeel & Organisatie.

Opmerking: Locatie en uurregeling kunnen wijzigen in functie van de dienstnoodwendigheden.

- Je bent verpleegkundige (bachelor of HBO5).
- Je hebt kennis van of interesse in de afdelingsgebonden verpleegproblemen en basisinzicht in de onderliggende pathologieën.
- Je hebt een goede observatiezin en een klinische blik.
- Je kan zelfstandig en oplossingsgericht werken.
- Je kan samenwerken met verschillende disciplines.
- Je bent enthousiast, gemotiveerd en wil het beste uit jezelf halen.
- Je hebt een luisterend oor en bent sterk in communicatie.

Vacatures Sint-Niklaas: Ook op onze website www.vitaz.be kan jij bij de rubriek 'afdelingsprofielen en werkpostfiches' of 'zorgaanbod' meer specifieke informatie opvragen over deze dienst.

jobs.title: System Engineer
jobs.description:
Met meer dan 30 jaar ervaring en een klantenbestand van ruim 50.000 bedrijven is deze organisatie een sterke speler binnen haar sector. Je komt terecht in een stabiele, groeiende werkomgeving waar ontwikkeling, werkzekerheid en persoonlijke groei centraal staan.

Als System Engineer sta je mee in voor het beheer, de optimalisatie en de verdere uitbouw van de IT-infrastructuur. Je werkt nauw samen met collega's en externe partners binnen een innovatieve omgeving waar verbetering en vernieuwing centraal staan.

Jouw taken:

• Je staat in voor het beheer, onderhoud en de verdere uitbouw van de server-, netwerk- en cloudomgeving.
• Je bewaakt de performantie van systemen en netwerken en zorgt voor een snelle oplossing van technische storingen.
• Je installeert, configureert en onderhoudt hardware, software en IT-systemen.
• Je biedt ondersteuning aan collega's en zorgt voor een professionele en klantgerichte IT-service.
• Je werkt mee aan lokale en internationale IT-projecten en draagt bij aan een succesvolle implementatie.
• Je denkt proactief mee over optimalisaties, automatisering en innovatieve oplossingen.
• Je helpt bij het uitwerken en realiseren van de IT-strategie voor de komende jaren.
• Je houdt technische documentatie en procedures up-to-date.
• Je draagt actief bij aan een veilige IT-omgeving en het versterken van de cybersecurity.

 
• Je behaalde een bachelor in IT of beschikt over een gelijkwaardige ervaring binnen een gelijkaardige functie.
• Zowel ervaren professionals als kandidaten met een eerste relevante werkervaring komen in aanmerking.
• Je communiceert vlot in het Nederlands en kan je goed uitdrukken in het Engels.
• Je hebt een sterke interesse in IT-infrastructuur, cloudoplossingen en cybersecurity.
• Je bent leergierig, denkt oplossingsgericht en neemt graag initiatief.
• Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de ICT Manager..

• Kennis van Windows Server-omgevingen
• Ervaring met Microsoft 365 en Azure
• Goede kennis van Active Directory
• Ervaring met Microsoft SQL Server
• Vertrouwd met Microsoft Defender en moderne security-oplossingen
• Kennis van virtualisatietechnologieën
• Ervaring met Veeam Backup & Replication
• Inzicht in netwerkinfrastructuur zoals VLAN's, MPLS, firewalls, routers en switches
• Basiskennis of sterke interesse in cybersecurity en security best practices

jobs.title: Een ondernemerschapsmedewerker (60%) bij Startpunt Ondernemen
jobs.description:
Hier gebeurt het. Met meer dan 2000 medewerkers en meer dan 22.000 studenten is Thomas More de grootste hogeschool van Vlaanderen, een warme, internationale en bruisende community met optimale leerkansen voor elk talent. Om onze visie 'met lef toonaangevend' verder te realiseren zijn wij op zoek naar mensen met Lef, Enthousiasme, Focus en Vertrouwen. Geïnspireerd door deze vier waarden bieden wij je een uitdagende job binnen een dynamische onderwijsomgeving waarin vernieuwing en samenwerking cruciaal zijn, en waarin je als TM-ambassadeur bijdraagt aan een aangename werkomgeving voor iedereen.

Inhoud van de opdracht:

1. Je bent hét aanspreekpunt voor ondernemerschap in Mechelen-Antwerpen

Je bent hét gezicht en eerste aanspreekpunt van Startpunt Ondernemen op de campussen in Mechelen en Antwerpen. Je gaat proactief de campussen en opleidingen op, legt contacten met studenten, docenten en opleidingsverantwoordelijken en bouwt een sterk netwerk uit binnen Thomas More. Zo zorg je ervoor dat studenten en collega’s weten wat Startpunt Ondernemen voor hen kan betekenen en creëer je een groot en vlot bereik rond ondernemerschap.

Je maakt ondernemerschap zichtbaar en brengt studenten en collega’s hierrond in beweging. Je organiseert bijvoorbeeld campustours en andere ondernemende activiteiten en introduceert initiatieven van Startpunt Ondernemen binnen en/of samen met opleidingen. Je werkt daarbij samen met opleidingen en andere interne en externe partners, zodat ideeën ook daadwerkelijk landen en gerealiseerd worden.

Je houdt daarbij steeds de tweeledige opdracht van Startpunt Ondernemen scherp voor ogen. Enerzijds ondersteun je student-ondernemerschap vanuit Manestarters. Anderzijds draag je bij aan het bredere MORE Professional-verhaal van Thomas More, waarin ondernemende competenties centraal staan.

Je bent daarbij niet enkel een doorgeefluik van het bestaande aanbod. Je krijgt de ruimte om vanuit je lokale kennis en netwerk zelf opportuniteiten te detecteren en initiatieven te ontwikkelen die aansluiten bij wat leeft binnen de campussen en opleidingen. Je neemt daarin eigenaarschap en bouwt actief mee aan de verdere verankering van ondernemerschap binnen Mechelen-Antwerpen.

2. Je trekt Manestarters in Mechelen

Manestarters is het ecosysteem van Thomas More voor studenten die ondernemend zijn of een eigen onderneming hebben. Kortom, student-ondernemerschap stimuleren. Als projectleider ben je verantwoordelijk voor de verdere uitbouw ervan in Mechelen. Je coördineert het team binnen dit ecosysteem en rolt daarnaast samen met de teamleden van Startpunt Ondernemen het gedeelte voor Thomas More inhoudelijk uit. Tegelijk bouw je een sterk netwerk uit van ondernemers, organisaties, opleidingen en andere partners die studenten hierin kunnen versterken.

Je zorgt ervoor dat Manestarters zichtbaar is op de campus, dat studenten de weg vinden naar het aanbod en dat nieuwe ideeën en samenwerkingen daadwerkelijk van de grond komen. Je volgt de doelstellingen van het project op en werkt mee aan het behalen van de vooropgestelde resultaten. Je maakt hierbij steeds de reflex om deze te koppelen aan de strategische doelen van Thomas More en Startpunt Ondernemen.

3. Je maakt deel uit van de ondernemerschapswerking van Thomas More: Startpunt Ondernemen

Je bent een volwaardig teamlid van Startpunt Ondernemen en draagt actief bij aan de gezamenlijke werking. Je werkt mee aan werving en promotie, coacht studenten en ondersteunt bij activiteiten die ondernemerschap zichtbaar en beleefbaar maken op de campus, zoals de MORE ICE Awards, NVDOS, Dag van de Ondernemer, Creators Night, gastsessies en andere initiatieven.

Afhankelijk van de activiteit neem je een trekkersrol op in de voorbereiding, organisatie en uitvoering, of ondersteun je een collega die de lead neemt.

Daarnaast geef of organiseer je mee workshops en vormingen rond ondernemerschapsthema’s zoals pitchen, storytelling, Business Model Canvas, ondernemende competenties en innovatie.

Je bent sterk studentgericht: je trekt eropuit, gaat actief in gesprek met studenten en weet hen te enthousiasmeren om ondernemend aan de slag te gaan.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Enterprise Technology and AI

SAP SuccessFactors Consultant (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Deine Aufgaben

Als SAP SuccessFactors Consultant (m/w/d) gestaltest du gemeinsam mit uns die sichere SAP-Welt von morgen. Dich erwarten spannende Prüfungs- und Beratungsprojekte rund um moderne SAP-Technologien wie S/4HANA, SuccessFactors, SAP BTP und innovative Security-Lösungen. Wenn du technologische Neugier, Beratungskompetenz und Begeisterung für KI-gestützte Arbeitsweisen mitbringst, bieten wir dir ein Umfeld, in dem du Verantwortung übernehmen, Kunden begeistern und dich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln kannst.

Vollzeit (39h/Woche) II Hamburg (Hybrid) oder full-remote
 
Du passt perfekt zu uns, wenn Du Spaß hast,...

  • Unsere Kunden in Security- & Berechtigungsfragen innerhalb der SAP-Welt mit Schwerpunkt in den SuccessFactors Modulen, Concur und SAP HCM zu beraten
  • Dich idealerweise mit Security-Tools wie z.B. SAP Access Control, SAP IAG, One Identity Manager, Pathlock SAST, Xiting XAMS etc. zu befassen
  • mit Hilfe von Generativer KI unsere Produkte und deine Arbeitsabläufe zu verbessern
  • in Prüfungsaufträgen und Beratungsprojekten bei unseren Kunden eine leitende Rolle zu übernehmen
  • interne und externe Workshops zu Themen in HR-Prozessen (Security & Berechtigungen) durchzuführen


Dein Profil

  • du ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung mitbringst
  • mehrjährige Kenntnisse im Bereich Human Ressource Cloud Technologien gesammelt hast und dich gut in den SAP SuccessFactors Module Employee Central, Time Management, Recruiting, Onboarding, Learning, Performance & Goals, Succession & Development, Compensation, Analytics auskennst
  • dich idealerweise auch gut mit Concur und externer HR-Software auskennst
  • gerne selbstständig, analytisch und konzeptionell
  • du über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mind. B2) und gute Englischkenntnisse verfügst


Warum wir?

Wir sind für dich der richtige Arbeitgeber, weil:

  • uns ein familiäres Arbeitsklima wichtig ist
  • wir als Pionier im Bereich SAP Security & Berechtigungsanalysen neue Wege gehen
  • du deine Arbeit auch von zu Hause durchführen kannst
  • dir eine flache Hierarchie wichtig ist
  • wir dir die Möglichkeit geben wollen, dich weiterzuentwickeln
  • wir dir einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag anbieten

 Du kannst dich außerdem freuen auf:
  • 30 Tage Urlaub
  • eine 39h/ Woche
  • Zusatzkrankenversicherung
  • betriebliche Altersvorsorge
  • kostenfreier Tiefgaragenstellplatz
  • Kaffee, Wasser und Obst
  • HVV-Fahrkartenzuschuss oder
  • Edenred-Gutschein oder
  • Leasingbike oder
  • EGYM-Wellpass (Sportabo)

jobs.title: Customer Support Executive
jobs.description:
About The Alliance

When it comes to building world-class professional communities, The Alliance is leading the way. From Product Marketing and Sales Enablement to Product-Led Growth, AI, Customer Success, and CMOs, we're home to some of the most engaged and influential communities in the industry.

With 160,000+ professionals across our communities and a constant stream of content, courses, events, and memberships, we help our members learn, connect, and grow. Our executive events are a key part of that mission—bringing together senior leaders to share insights, tackle industry challenges, and build meaningful relationships.

Every year, we engage attendees, speakers, partners, and members from some of the world's leading organisations and fastest-growing start-ups, including TikTok, Microsoft, Peloton, and Uber.

 

The Role

We are on look out for a detail-driven, proactive Customer Support Executive to join our vibrant Customer Success team. In this role, you will serve as the primary point of contact across our support channels, elevating the overall member experience by resolving queries and ensuring our users maximize the value of our platform.
Beyond day-to-day support, you will spearhead forward-looking initiatives designed to preemptively address customer needs, such as optimizing our AI support agent, analyzing key pain points, and building expertise in customer operations within a fast-growing, collaborative environment.

Responsibilities

  • Customer Support Champion: Be the first line of contact for our members via email and our ticketing system, providing timely, friendly, and helpful responses every day.

  • Escalation Pro: Spot the difference between a quick fix and something that needs a deeper dive, escalating where appropriate to keep things moving smoothly.

  • Priority Pro: Keep a clear head and a clean inbox, staying organised across multiple tickets, deadlines, and internal priorities.

  • AI Agent Champion: Support the ongoing maintenance, development, and continuous improvement of our AI agent, helping to refine its responses, identify opportunities for improvement, and ensure it continues to deliver a great experience for our members when we’re not around.

  • Internal Collaborator: Work closely with Customer Success, Education, Product and other departments to resolve member issues quickly and efficiently.

  • Process Improver: Contribute to FAQs, support documentation, and internal feedback loops to make us even better, every day.

  • Platform Power User: Use Intercom to manage tickets and feed back customer experience improvements to the wider team.

Compensation: £32,000-34,000 base Salary (depending on experience)

Location: this role can be Remote from wherever in the UK or hybrid in our London office.

This role is for you if you:

  • Have excellent written communication skills and a calm, customer-first approach.

  • Have experience with Intercom, Zendesk or similar support platforms (ideally including experience working with AI agents)

  • Are forward thinking, detail-oriented and take pride in getting the small things right.

  • Know when to escalate, and when to troubleshoot.

  • Strong communicator - from our customers to your colleagues, you’ll be working very closely with lots of people.

  • Team player - success doesn’t happen in a vacuum, we need everyone in the org to be rallied around the same goals and helping each other out to achieve them.

  • Creative problem-solver - we know that processes can always be improved. We’re looking for someone who can think on their feet, solve problems, and identify opportunities.

  • Tech-savvy - we lean on lots of different apps and while we’ll obviously onboard you on each, we’re looking for a quick learner who can show us a thing or two. We’re especially interested in your experience with Customer Support AI and Knowledge Database management.

 

Benefits: We believe exceptional people deserve exceptional support.

Time Off:

  • 34 days' annual leave, including UK Bank Holidays.

  • Your birthday is off every year.

 

Health & Wellbeing:

  • Enhanced family policies.

  • Private Medical Insurance.

  • Life Insurance (4x salary).

  • On-demand therapy, coaching, and mental fitness support through Oliva.

  • Heavily subsidised gym membership via Wellness Hub.

  • Cycle to Work and Workplace Nursery schemes.

 

Flexibility:

  • Flexible working hours, allowing you to work when you are most productive.

  • Monthly allowance via ThanksBen (£600 annually in year one, increasing with tenure).

 

Learning & Development:

  • Personal L&D budget (£500 annually in year one, increasing with tenure).

  • Four paid Learning & Development or Volunteer Days each year.

  • Team training and development opportunities.

 

Equipment & Culture

  • New tech setup including laptop, screen, mouse, and keyboard.

  • Company social events.

  • A collaborative, ambitious, and supportive working environment.

 

Community & Inclusion

At The Alliance, we're committed to creating a workplace that is free from discrimination and bias, where everyone has equal opportunities to succeed and contribute.

We know our work here is never done, and we continue to strive for a more inclusive environment every day.

 

If you're worried you don't meet every requirement listed, don't let that stop you from applying. Unique backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives are essential to our ability to innovate and grow, so if you think you'd be a great fit, we'd love to hear from you.

 

We are The Alliance—in more ways than one.

jobs.title: Skötare till Rättspsykiatriska regionkliniken
jobs.description:
I Region Kronoberg arbetar vi för att människor i länet ska kunna leva ett tryggt och hållbart liv. Varje dag möter vi kronobergarna i vården, i kollektivtrafiken och i arbetet med länets utveckling. Här tas idéer tillvara, det finns stora möjligheter till utveckling och ett arbetsklimat som är välkomnande, öppet och präglat av vänlighet.

Rättspsykiatriska regionkliniken i Växjö är en specialistenhet med uppdrag att vårda patienter som av domstol har överlämnats till rättspsykiatrisk vård. Vi tar även emot patienter från Kriminalvården som är i behov av psykiatrisk omvårdnad och behandling.

Kliniken består av 12 slutenvårdsavdelningar med 145 vårdplatser samt en särskild öppenvårdsenhet. Vi bedriver vård inom samtliga tre säkerhetsklasser och erbjuder högkvalificerad rättspsykiatrisk vård som bygger på vetenskap och beprövad erfarenhet.

3 plats(er).

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Som skötare ansvarar du för att skapa och upprätthålla en trygg och professionell relation med patienterna. Det innebär att bygga en god vårdrelation, uppmärksamma individuella behov och vara lyhörd för förändringar i både psykiskt och fysiskt mående. I rollen bidrar du aktivt till det dagliga arbetet på avdelningen.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter är att:

    • Skapa och upprätthålla en professionell och stabil vårdrelation
    • Bidra till en säker och trygg vårdmiljö
    • Observera, stödja och bedöma patienternas psykiska och fysiska mående
    • Motivera och stödja patienter i vardagen samt i att följa vårdplaner
    • Delta i teammöten, vårdplaneringar och den gemensamma behandlingsprocessen
    • Säkerställa att verksamhetens rutiner, riktlinjer och säkerhetsföreskrifter följs
    • Dokumentera och bidra till utvecklingsarbete

Här blir du en viktig del av patienternas rehabilitering och väg mot ökad självständighet.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Vi söker dig som:

    • Har formell utbildning för att arbeta som skötare inom psykiatrin
    • Har gärna erfarenhet av arbete inom psykiatrin
    • Utbildning eller erfarenhet inom KBT, ESL, MI, behandlingsarbete eller missbruksvård är meriterande
    • Är trygg, prestigelös och flexibel
    • Trivs med teamarbete och har god förmåga att samarbeta med olika yrkesgrupper
    • Kan se helheten och bidra till en strukturerad och säker vårdmiljö

Stor vikt läggs vid personlig lämplighet.

Intervjuer sker löpande, så skicka gärna in din ansökan och ditt CV redan idag.

Som en del av rekryteringsprocessen begär vi utdrag ur belastnings- och misstankeregister samt ett utökat registerutdrag för att säkerställa personsäkerhet. Vi ser därför gärna att du anger ditt fullständiga personnummer i ansökan.

Alkohol- och drogtest genomförs via företagshälsovården.

Löneform: Månadslön.
Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.
Varaktighet: Tillsvidare, tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse.
Arbetstid: Schema.

Frågor om specifika jobb besvaras av den rekryterare eller kontaktperson som anges i annonsen. För att skicka in din ansökan, klicka på ansökningslänken i annonsen.

Informationen du anger kan komma att lämnas ut avseende regler för allmän handling enligt offentlighetsprincipen och dina uppgifter behandlas enligt Dataskyddsförordningen (GDPR).

Kontakta ansvarig rekryterare hos Region Kronoberg vid skyddad identitet för vidare information om hur du ansöker och hantering av dina personuppgifter.

Vi undanber oss vänligt men bestämt erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringstjänster i samband med den här annonsen.

Vill du vara med och skapa en äldreomsorg där individens behov står i centrum och där samverkan och kvalitet går hand i hand? Nu söker vi en engagerad socialsekreterare inom omsorg (tidigare kallat biståndshandläggare) till vår myndighetsavdelning.

Individ- och familjeomsorgens myndighetsavdelning består av cirka 35 medarbetare och ansvarar för myndighetsutövning inom områdena barn och unga, LSS, socialpsykiatri, ekonomiskt bistånd, skadligt bruk – och beroende, våld i nära relation, äldre samt uppdragstagare.

Enheten är organiserad i tre grupper; Barn – och unga/familjehem/LSS, Omsorg samt Vuxen. Varje grupp har en 1:e socialsekreterare som ger nära stöd i det dagliga arbetet.

Vi som jobbar här är en kompetent och sammansvetsad grupp som har nära samarbete både internt och med våra externa samverkansparter. Vi arbetar för att skapa goda förutsättningar för våra invånare att kunna leva självständigt, med rätt stöd i rätt tid.

I Svenljunga kommun har vi den lilla kommunens fördelar: korta beslutsvägar, närhet till kollegor och en stor möjlighet att påverka ditt arbete.

Hos oss är vi stolta över vår kommun och vårt arbete. Svenljunga kommun - vi erbjuder det godaste livet!

1 plats(er).

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Som socialsekreterare inom omsorg arbetar du med att utreda, bedöma, fatta beslut och följa upp insatser enligt socialtjänstlagen (SoL). I centrum för ditt arbete står alltid individens behov, med målet att skapa trygghet, delaktighet och rätt stöd i rätt tid.

Du arbetar både självständigt och tillsammans med kollegor i ett team, där samverkan är en central del av uppdraget. Du har regelbunden kontakt och samarbete med såväl interna utförare som externa aktörer såsom sjukvård, anhöriga och andra verksamhetsområden.

En viktig del av rollen är att vara ett stöd och en vägledare för brukare och deras närstående, där du möter människor i olika livssituationer med respekt, lyhördhet och ett professionellt förhållningssätt.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Vi söker dig som:

Har en socionomexamen eller annan likvärdig högskoleutbildning som bedöms relevant.

Har god kännedom om SoL och gärna erfarenhet av handläggning inom äldreomsorg eller annat område inom socialtjänstens myndighetsutövning.

Är trygg i att fatta beslut, strukturera ditt arbete och dokumentera på ett rättssäkert sätt.

Har en god samarbetsförmåga och är lyhörd i mötet med människor.

Du är van vid att arbeta i en vardag som kan skifta snabbt och har ett professionellt förhållningssätt även i utmanande situationer. Det är meriterande om du har utbildning inom IBIC samt om du har tidigare erfarenhet av verksamhetssystemet Combine.

Körkort är ett krav.

Löneform: Månadslön.
Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.
Varaktighet: Tillsvidare, tillträde: 2026-10-05  Eller enligt överenskommelse.
Arbetstid: Dagtid.

Dina personuppgifter kommer att användas inom Svenljunga kommun och av personer som arbetar med rekrytering. Det är den nämnd som står för rekryteringen som är personuppgiftsansvarig och ansvarar för behandlingen av personuppgifter. Vill du veta vem det är som är personuppgiftsansvarig för dina uppgifter kan du kontakta oss via kommun@svenljunga.se eller 0325-180 00.

Syftet med behandlingen av personuppgifter är för att de ska användas för rekryteringsändamål. Den rättsliga grunden är samtycke för att kunna administrera och dokumentera rekryteringsprocessen. De uppgifter som kommer att lagras och sparas med anledning av överklagande förfarandet är uppgifter du själv angett, ditt CV, ditt personliga brev samt eventuell övrig information som du anger till oss. Vi gallrar dina uppgifter efter 2 år.

Har du synpunkter på hur vi behandlar dina personuppgifter eller om du anser att de står i strid med dataskyddsregelverken bör du informera oss snarast. Detta kan du göra genom att ta kontakt med oss via kommun@svenljunga.se eller 0325-180 00 eller vårt dataskyddsombud. Du kan också lämna in ett klagomål till Integritetsskyddsmyndigheten (imy@imy.se).

Information om löneintervall för aktuell tjänst hittar du på Svenljunga kommuns hemsida  https://www.svenljunga.se/naringsliv--arbete/att-jobba-hos-oss

Enligt lag så är det krav att begära ut belastningsregister vid anställning inom skola/förskola och funktionshinder. Inför anställning är vi skyldiga att begära in ett aktuellt utdrag ur belastningsregistret.

Om du vill läsa mer om dina rättigheter eller hur vi behandlar dina personuppgifter kan du läsa det på vår webbplats. https://svenljunga.se/ovrigt/om-personuppgifter

jobs.title: Senior Tax Accountant
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion’s Tax team is growing, and we’re looking for a Senior Tax Accountant to support our global tax operations. In this role, you’ll run global indirect tax operations and strengthen the systems behind them. As Notion scales across products and jurisdictions, this role exists to make compliance, close, audits, and tax data more accurate, scalable, and audit-ready. You’ll own recurring sales and use tax, VAT/GST, business tax, registrations, notices, reconciliations, and related controls, while building exposure to income tax compliance and reporting. The work is hands-on and cross-functional: you’ll trace differences across billing, tax engines, filings, payments, and the general ledger with Accounting, Revenue, Billing, Product, Engineering, Data, and Customer Experience partners.

 

This role is based in San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Take ownership of recurring U.S. and global indirect-tax filings, calendars, data packages, notices, registrations, and close support—with accurate, review-ready work.

 - Establish a reliable reconciliation and exception workflow across billing, tax engines, filings, payments, and the general ledger, escalating issues clearly and early.

 - Use AI-enabled workflows and data tools to investigate variances, quality-check work papers, and improve documentation while preserving human review and controls.

 - Make tax operations more scalable and audit-ready by strengthening controls, process documentation, evidence, handoffs, audit support, and SOX walkthrough readiness.

 - Become a trusted partner to Accounting, Revenue, Billing, Product, Engineering, Data, and Customer Experience—and contribute to income tax compliance and reporting with guidance from experienced teammates.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 - At least 3 years of public accounting and/or industry tax experience, with a primary focus on indirect tax compliance and operations.

 - Hands-on experience with indirect tax compliance or operations, especially U.S. sales and use tax, VAT/GST, business taxes, or other non-income-based taxes; this is the foundation for owning Notion’s recurring global work.

 - Experience preparing accurate reconciliations, journal entries, filings, payments, and audit-ready work papers, with the ability to connect activity across source systems and the general ledger.

 - Strong operational judgment: you manage recurring deadlines, investigate exceptions, keep documentation organized, escalate issues promptly, and drive assigned work through completion.

 - Clear written and verbal communication, with a collaborative approach to working across Finance, Accounting, business teams, and external advisors.

 - Curiosity and learning agility, including willingness to build income-tax capability and demonstrated AI fluency—using AI to analyze data, investigate variances, improve documentation, perform quality checks, or automate repeatable workflows while validating outputs and protecting sensitive information.




Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $135,000 - $155,000 per year.

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. jobs.description:
Senior Program Manager, Secure Network Design, WWOS Global Solution
Job ID: 10530871 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

The Program Manager, Secure Network Design support the End-to-End Secure Network (E2ESN) organization within World Wide Operations Security WWOS, driving programs that create Earth's most reliably secure supply chain through prevention, intervention, and investigation. This role combines Amazon's core program management competencies with domain-specific expertise to architect, plan, and secure Amazon's global transportation network across supply chain miles – Global Mile, First Mile and Middle Mile OTR. Team apply the "Shift-Left" principle to engineer resilience into the network design architecture itself, building a capability that prevents incidents by design rather than chasing them after the fact.

Key job responsibilities

Program Planning & Execution

- Owns the lifecycle of complex cross-functional programs with considerable impact across organizations or geographies
- Define program scope, goals, success criteria, and inputs/outputs metrics in collaboration with stakeholders
- Develop and maintain program roadmaps, glidepaths, and work-back schedules aligned to OP planning cycles
- Drive mechanisms (WBRs, MBRs, portfolio reviews) to track progress vs. plan and surface risks early
- Accountable for overall program strategy and tactically driving teams inside and outside the organization to deliver

Secure Network Design

- Architect a Secure-by-Design Transportation Network, embed security principles into network design decisions where security becomes a primary design variable alongside cost, speed, and service level.
- Defines secured network path strategies that ensure that theft and loss are structurally designed out through preventive architecture before they materialize
- Enable actionable intelligence that drives systematic improvements across the network
- Measure adoption rates and alignment metrics for deployed solutions
- Leverage AI-driven decision support and ensure investments are focused on the most at-risk vulnerabilities for maximum impact

Stakeholder Management & Influence

- Partner cross-functionally with Operations, Finance, Tech, Legal, and WWOS teams - Field Loss Prevention, Investigation teams.
- Facilitate alignment across AMER and INTL regional teams to ensure consistent solution deployment and best practices adoption
- Represent program status and strategic direction in leadership reviews
- Serve as the bridge between E2ESN Solutions teams and partner teams
- Build and maintain relationships with partner organizations

Delivery & Operational Excellence

- Identify and mitigate risks, resolve blockers, and escalate appropriately through WWOS governance
- Manage dependencies across multiple concurrent initiatives and workstreams
- Makes appropriate trade-offs to optimize timelines and deliverables in consultation with stakeholders
- Drive continuous improvement through retrospectives, lessons learned, and mechanism design
- Establish and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) for program operations

Data & Analytics Stewardship

- Own program-level data quality, ensuring accurate $ loss / entitlement attribution by supply chain segment
- Partner with Data Services teams for dashboard development and automated network coverage tracking
- Parter with Finance team to drive theft/loss estimates using statistical models
- Support AI/ML integration into security solutions to reduce manual investigative burden

Basic Qualifications

- Experience in program management, logistics, operations, supply chain, transportation, or a related field
- Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal
- Ability to collaborate and lead in a flexible, detail-oriented, fast-paced team environment
- Demonstrated ability to independently use AI tools in daily work, integrating them into program workflows to drive better outcomes, and guiding others on effective adoption

Preferred Qualifications

- Project Management Professional (PMP) certification
- Six-Sigma or equivalent certification
- Certified Protection Professional (CPP)
- ISO 28000 (Supply Chain Security Management System) or TAPA (Transported Asset Protection Association) certification
- Experience with supply chain security frameworks (ASIS, AIBM-CSCRM)

À propos de WISAG
WISAG Luxembourg fait partie du groupe WISAG, un acteur majeur des services aux entreprises en Europe. Présente au Luxembourg depuis de nombreuses années, l'entreprise offre des prestations complètes en facility management, services techniques, propreté, sécurité et support logistique. Grâce à son expertise et son approche centrée sur le client, WISAG accompagne aussi bien les entreprises privées que les institutions publiques dans la gestion et l'optimisation de leurs infrastructures. Afin de renforcer son département Finance, WISAG recherche un Office & Procurement Manager motivé et rigoureux, capable de piloter la gestion des achats, du parc automobile et des projets transverses de l'entreprise.

Vos tâches chez nous
Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le pilotage des achats, la gestion du parc automobile et des assurances, ainsi que dans le suivi des projets transverses de l'entreprise. Vos missions principales incluent :
• Gestion du parc automobile : commandes, livraisons, restitutions, leasing, assurances, réparations, contrôles techniques et suivi des accidents/contraventions.
• Pilotage de l'électrification du parc automobile et coordination avec les différents prestataires.

• Gestion des assurances et des sinistres, en coordination avec les assureurs et les interlocuteurs internes.
• Suivi budgétaire et reporting des achats et de la flotte automobile, analyse des coûts et identification des pistes d'optimisation.
• Gestion de projets transverses, notamment le projet de déménagement 2027, avec coordination des services, fournisseurs, budgets, échéances et prestataires.

Vous attirez notre attention avec
• Diplôme d'études supérieures en gestion, achats, logistique ou domaine similaire.

• Excellent relationnel, diplomatie et discrétion dans les échanges avec fournisseurs et équipes internes.
• Autonomie, esprit critique et curiosité pour la veille du marché fournisseurs ; bonne maîtrise de Pack Office 365 et connaissance de la démarche ISO 9001, 14001, 45001.
• Bon niveau rédactionnel en français et en allemand (niveau C2) ; l'anglais, le portugais et/ou le luxembourgeois sont un atout.

    • Development of related documentation (Algorithm baseline, functional analysis)

    • Writing engineering documentation and technical reports in English.
    • Participation to the Bids and proposals.

Must Have Requirements

La maîtrise du luxembourgeois et de tout autre langue est un atout.

This is a fixed-term position of 24 months, created to meet a sustained increase in architecture work across our EU project portfolio.

We are looking for a Solution Architect to help design and deliver secure, large-scale data infrastructure, working alongside our senior architects.
You will consolidate functional and non-functional requirements from data providers and partner organisations and translate them into architecture documentation.
You will contribute to the specification, configuration, integration, and technical validation of the components behind our data services.
Working with community frameworks such as Gaia-X, IDSA and DSSC, you will help build the data solutions our partners across Europe depend on.


What you will do

Architecture design and documentation

Learn and deliver the core architecture artefacts, starting from established LNDS patterns and templates, and taking on more of the design work as your experience grows.
Maintain the architecture documentation set across assigned projects — keeping it current, internally consistent and ready for formal review. Several projects require successive versioned releases approved at fixed milestones.

Requirements and analysis

Support senior architects in gathering and documenting functional and non-functional requirements from data providers, partner organisations and internal stakeholders.
Analyse and document business constraints.

Implementation support

Work with engineering and operations colleagues to turn architecture into working systems.
Support the specification, configuration, and integration of components.
Support technical validation and acceptance activities, including preparing test scenarios and evidence.

Standards, compliance and quality

Learn, adopt and apply LNDS architectural standards, patterns and review practices consistently, and flag where they do not fit.
Support the implementation of technical and organisational measures under Data Protection by Design and Default, working with Legal and data governance colleagues.

Project and consortium contribution

Contribute to project deliverables and milestones, tracking your own commitments and raising slippage early.
Support proposal preparation with technical input and effort estimation.


Who you are

BSc or MSc in a scientific, technological or engineering discipline related to computer science, information technology or computing.
1-2 years working explicitly as a solution or enterprise architect on large-scale or federated data systems.
Working knowledge of distributed systems, APIs and integration patterns, databases, and data modelling.
Exposure with cloud or container platforms, infrastructure-as-code, and CI/CD pipelines.
Foundational understanding of information security, authentication and authorisation, encryption, and network segmentation.
Able to write clear technical documentation and produce readable diagrams.
Awareness of GDPR and the broader EU data regulatory landscape.
Familiarity with agile delivery practices.
Excellent communication skills in English.
Working knowledge of one of Luxembourg's official languages (French, German or Luxembourgish) is a plus.
Curious, methodical, and comfortable speaking when you do not understand something.
Willingness to learn architectural concepts and methods, and to develop your information security and regulatory knowledge seriously.
Collaborative, adaptable, and able to work effectively in a cross-functional and multicultural environment.
Interest in health data, genomics, data spaces or public sector data infrastructure.
Prior experience in EU-funded projects is a plus.


About us

What we offer

Dynamic and innovative work environment
Collaboration with diverse stakeholders
Inclusive and diverse culture
European recognition and impactful projects
Shape the future of the data revolution


What sets us apart

The Luxembourg National Data Service is a modern and dynamic undertaking.
We embrace a Lean and Agile mindset, combining the entrepreneurial spirit of a startup with the responsibility of a public body on a national mission.
We will be a partner of society and industry, collaborating with a hugely diverse group of stakeholders in public research, public authorities, European institutions, academic and private institutions, and small, medium and large companies.
Therefore, we have an international and multilingual character.
Even in this rather ambitious context, we preserve a warm and personal atmosphere.
Inclusion and diversity are some of our key values.
We ensure that everyone has employment and career opportunities in accordance with their skills and aspirations, respecting and being mindful of their individual characteristics.
Join LNDS and revolutionise the data economy!

Collaborate on cutting-edge projects, gaining European recognition in the prestigious European Data Spaces initiative.
Shape a transformative future in the data revolution.

jobs.title: Senior Risk Officer (m/f)
jobs.description:
Senior Risk Officer

Responsibilities (how we will measure success)

As a Senior Risk Officer, you work in autonomy with the clients and funds that have been allocated to you and you supervise the deliveries of Junior Risk Officers and Risk Officers. That means:

- You master the risk management framework: policies, procedures obligations of the risk management function;
- You know when and how any potential breaches, conflicts, complains shall be escalated to your line manager.

Tasks (what does the role do on a day-to-day basis)

• Implement, maintain and improve the policies and procedures pertaining to the risk management function, covering all types of risks the managed funds are exposed to.

• Support the development, monitoring, and updating of risk profiles for all AIFs under management, ensuring alignment with investment strategies and regulatory standards.
• Perform pre-trade investment compliance controls.
• Monitor and regularly review the adequacy of risk indicators.
• Prepare and review quarterly risk management reports for the AIFs. Report material risk issues, breaches, and emerging risks to senior management, risk committees, and governing bodies, and ensure appropriate remediation actions are taken.
• Collaborate with the onboarding team to assess risks of new products and projects, ensuring business growth aligns with the firm's risk appetite.
• Review Annex IV (AIFMD) reporting and ensure timely filing.
• Advise internal and external stakeholders on complex risk management matters and regulatory developments affecting Luxembourg investment funds.

Key behaviours we expect to see

In addition to demonstrating our Group Values (Authentic, Bold, and Collaborative), the role holder will be expected to demonstrate the following:

• Team spirit
• Communication skills
• Action oriented
• Customer focus

Requirements

• Master/Bachelor in Finance or an equivalent degree
• 3+ years professional experience in a Risk Management related function
• Profound knowledge in Annex IV Reporting will be considered as a plus
• Entrepreneurial mindset
• Good communication skills
• Writing and analytical skills
• Understanding of the Luxembourg fund industry and regulations
• Strong understanding of various illiquid investment strategies (Private Equity, Real Estate, Infrastructure and Private debt)
• Good knowledge of an IT language considered as an asset (VBA, SQL, Python, …)

jobs.title: Assistant Manager – Fund Accounting (m/f)
jobs.description:
Assistant Manager – Fund Accounting

Role Overview

Within the Fund Administration department, the Assistant Manager is responsible for overseeing a portfolio of complex and high‑profile fund structures, ensuring high‑quality service delivery, regulatory compliance, and timely reporting.

The role combines technical expertise, team leadership, and client ownership. The Assistant Manager acts as a key escalation point for both clients and internal teams and supports the Manager in driving operational excellence, risk management, and process improvement.

Tasks

Client & Delivery Ownership

• Act as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of sophisticated clients (Private Equity, Private Debt, Evergreen structures, Hybrid structures, Open-ended structures).
• Assume end‑to‑end responsibility for service delivery, ensuring compliance with SLAs, fund documentation, and regulatory requirements.
• Manage client expectations proactively and handle escalations independently before involving the Manager where required.
Build and maintain trusted, long‑term client relationships, participating in client meetings, onboarding calls, and post‑audit reviews.

Onboarding

During client onboarding, the Assistant Manager undertakes several crucial tasks to ensure a smooth transition and establish a productive relationship with the new client. Hereunder are some key responsibilities:

• Lead or actively support client onboardings, restructurings, migrations, and system set‑ups.
• Validate fund structures, valuation methodologies, fee models, and reporting frameworks in line with legal documents.
• Coordinate across internal teams (FA, TA, back office, Corporate, AIFM, Risk & Compliance, IT etc) to ensure seamless implementation.
• Review and sign‑off data migration and initial NAVs.

NAV Oversight & Technical Review

During Net Asset Value (NAV) oversight, the Assistant Manager play a critical role in ensuring accuracy, compliance, and smooth operations. Hereunder are some key responsibilities:

• Assume overall accountability for the NAV oversight framework across the assigned client portfolio, ensuring accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and compliance with fund documentation, accounting standards, and regulatory requirements.
• Oversee the end‑to‑end NAV production cycle, including capital activity, income recognition, valuation inputs, investor allocations, and fee calculations.
• Perform in‑depth technical reviews and approvals of complex NAVs, including:

o Private equity, private debt, evergreen funds, and multi‑compartment structures
o Complex instruments (loans, profit‑participating notes, derivatives, look‑through investments)
o FX treatments, waterfalls, and performance fee mechanisms
• Act as a technical reference point on Lux GAAP, IFRS, consolidation and structure‑specific treatments.

• Ensure all NAV‑related deliverables meet agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and internal quality standards.
• Maintain strong documentation standards, including working papers, reconciliation files, and management review evidence, to support both internal controls and external audit requirements.
• Support the preparation of financial statements inputs by ensuring consistency between NAVs, accounting records, and statutory reporting.

Risk Management, Controls & Audit

• Act as a key control owner for the assigned client portfolio, ensuring that fund accounting activities are performed in line with internal policies, ISAE requirements, regulatory obligations, and client documentation.
• Ensure that appropriate preventive and detective controls are in place, operating effectively, and evidenced.
• Review and challenge unusual transactions, valuation judgments, late data, or deviations from standard processes.
• Act as the primary escalation point for NAV issues, breaches, or errors, ensuring timely resolution, root‑cause analysis, and clear documentation.
• Act as the primary liaison for external auditors, managing audit queries and timelines.
• Support the Manager in maintaining a strong control culture across the team and client portfolio.

Team Leadership & People Management

• Provide day‑to‑day supervision of Senior Fund Accountants and Fund Accountants within the team.
• Allocate work effectively, taking into account complexity, risk and deadlines.
• Review deliverables prepared by the team and provide structured feedback.
• Support training, development, and performance management of team members.
• Promote a culture of accountability, ownership, collaboration, and quality.
• Escalate capacity, performance, or quality concerns to the Manager with proposed solutions.

Process Improvement & Operational Excellence

• Continuously assess existing fund accounting and reporting processes to identify inefficiencies, risks, and improvement opportunities.
• Actively contribute to system enhancements, automation, and standardisation.
• Support the Manager in implementing new operating models, tools, and best practices.
• Encourage a culture of continuous improvement and risk awareness

Required Experience / Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Economics
• ACCA (or equivalent) – qualified or advanced stage preferred
• Strong knowledge of Lux GAAP and IFRS (including consolidation)
• 8+ years of experience in fund administration, primarily for closed-ended funds, open-ended funds and evergreen/hybrid funds, with experience in various asset classes (private equity, private debt, listed loans)
• Prior experience reviewing NAVs and supervising team members is essential.
• Experience in capital hedging and portfolio management.
• Added value for candidates familiar with public loans managed through Allvue or WSO platforms.
• Languages: English fluent; French and/or German is an advantage.
• Additional advantage for candidates with experience using Paxus.

Skills/Behavior

In addition to demonstrating IQEQ's Group Values (Authentic, Bold, Collaborative), the Assistant Manager is expected to:

• Take ownership and accountability
• Demonstrate sound judgement and risk awareness
• Lead and develop others
• Communicate clearly with senior stakeholders
• Navigate complexity and ambiguity
• Balance client service with internal control discipline
• Plan, prioritise, and delegate effectively
• Continuously develop technical and leadership skills

jobs.title: Assistant Manager –  Data analyst AML and FATCA/CRS (m/f)
jobs.description:
Role purpose

This role provides management reporting, business insights, regulatory reporting support and process improvement solutions for the Luxembourg AML/KYC, FATCA and CRS function. The Assistant Manager helps maintain a consolidated Luxembourg-wide view of risks across the client, investor and beneficial ownership population, supporting planning, performance monitoring, capacity management, local regulatory accountability and decision-making.

Working closely with operational teams and stakeholders, the role identifies opportunities to automate repetitive processes, improve data quality, strengthen controls and enhance reporting efficiency. It supports the production of regulatory information required by the CSSF, the Luxembourg tax authorities (AED) and, increasingly, AMLA, with AMLA-related requests already being received and processed by the function.
A significant portion of the information used by the role relates to highly confidential client, investor and beneficial ownership data. The role therefore requires direct Luxembourg access to the full data population, including clients and investors who have refused outsourcing arrangements or whose contractual confidentiality undertakings restrict data transfers outside Luxembourg, in addition to Luxembourg professional secrecy and GDPR requirements.

The role sits at the intersection of AML/KYC operations, governance, data analytics, AI and automation, ensuring that transformation initiatives remain aligned with Luxembourg regulatory requirements, client expectations and operational realities. Its primary purpose is oversight, data consolidation, quality challenge, management intelligence, regulatory reporting support and automation, rather than operational processing.

The role suits someone analytical and process-driven, who can turn complex data into clear business recommendations and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Responsibilities (how we will measure success)

• Timely and accurate delivery of management reporting, dashboards and KPI packs to agreed deadlines;
• Reporting outputs that stakeholders actively use to monitor performance, capacity and workload;
• Measurable efficiency gains from automating manual and repetitive reporting processes;
• Improved data quality and stronger reporting controls, with issues identified and resolved at source;
• Solving problems by providing innovative ideas in improving/developing internal systems to meet set objectives & maximise the team efficiency;
• Clear, actionable insights and recommendations that support planning and management decision-making.
• Effective consolidated Luxembourg-wide oversight of AML/KYC, FATCA and CRS risks, including the full client and investor population relevant to local regulatory accountability;
• Reliable management information, data analytics and regulatory reporting support for Luxembourg management, RCs and Conducting Officers;

Tasks (what does the role do on a day-to-day basis)

• Designing & implementing automated reporting processes and KPIs, using Excel (including VBA), Microsoft Power BI and Power Platform;
• Building and maintaining dashboards, management reporting packs, forecasts and capacity models for operational teams and senior management;
• Ability to create reports/presentations (data visualisation) to be delivered to internal stakeholders as well as to clients;
• Handling data management of the team and leading projects on data cleansing, data quality and reconciliation;
• Translating business requirements into scalable solutions across Excel, SharePoint, Power Platform and other business applications;
• Identifying and delivering process improvement and automation opportunities, including support for AI and automation initiatives;
• Analysing performance, capacity and workload trends, and turning the findings into clear recommendations for management;
• Documenting reporting processes, data sources and controls so that outputs are accurate, repeatable and auditable;
• Maintaining a consolidated Luxembourg-wide view of AML/KYC, FATCA and CRS risks across the client, investor and beneficial ownership population and supporting the production of CSSF, AED and AMLA-related regulatory information;
• Providing Luxembourg management with a 360-degree view of relevant AML/KYC, FATCA and CRS risks through consolidated reporting, data analytics, quality challenge and management information;
• Challenging data gaps, inconsistencies and reporting issues at source, including through direct interaction with Luxembourg teams, clients, auditors, RCs, Conducting Officers and senior management;
• Ensuring that AI, automation and data transformation initiatives remain embedded within the business, close to Luxembourg decision-makers and aligned with regulatory requirements, client expectations and operational realities;
• Representing IQ-EQ Luxembourg and the AML/KYC function at AI-focused forums, industry roundtables and strategic discussions with key partners , including EY, PwC, law firms and other market stakeholders, to strengthen market presence, foster innovation, share industry insights and identify emerging opportunities;
• You will be required to respond to queries from our stakeholders (clients, colleagues, management), whether by telephone or in writing, in a timely and courteous manner;

Key competencies for position and level (see Group Competency model)

• Advanced Excel, including VBA
• Microsoft Power BI
• Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps) and SharePoint
• Data analysis and business insight
• Proficient use of AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot and Claude AI to support analysis, automation, drafting and productivity improvements
• Process improvement and automation mindset
• Understanding of AML/KYC, FATCA and CRS regulatory reporting, Luxembourg professional secrecy, data confidentiality and outsourcing considerations;
• Action oriented
• Critical thinker
• Collaborates
• Drives result (time management, prioritise tasks & consistent in meeting deadlines)

Key behaviours we expect to see

In addition to demonstrating our Group Values (Authentic, Bold, and Collaborative), the role holder will be expected to demonstrate the following:

• Have excellent communications skills, verbal and written, including the ability to explain data and technical concepts to a non-technical audience;
• Attention to detail and good organisational skills;
• Have the ability to work under pressure, manage multiple priorities and develop the right attitude;
• Curiosity about new tools and ways of working, including automation and AI.
• Ability to operate with sound judgement when handling highly confidential information and when balancing regulatory, client, operational and transformation priorities;

Requirements

• Degree Holder in /Finance/Data Analytics/Business Administration or a related discipline,
• Minimum 3/4 years relevant working experience in management reporting, data analytics or business intelligence (preferably in financial services or fund administration);
• Demonstrable experience in dashboard development, reporting automation, process improvement and operational transformation;
• Strong IT skills (advanced Excel and VBA, Microsoft Power BI, Power Platform, SharePoint and any other relevant qualification/knowledge);
• Experience with SQL or other data query tools would be considered as an advantage;
• Fluent in English, and French would be considered as an advantage.

jobs.title: Junior AML/KYC Officer (m/f)
jobs.description:
Junior AML/KYC Officer

Company Description

We're a leading Investor Services group offering end-to-end services in administration, accounting, reporting, regulatory and compliance needs of the investment sector worldwide. We employ a global workforce of 6,500+ people across 24 jurisdictions and have assets under administration (AUA) exceeding US$857 billion. We work with 13 of the world's top-15 private equity firms.

Our services are underpinned by a Group-wide commitment to ESG and best-in-class technology including a global data platform and innovative proprietary tools supported by in-house experts.

Above all, what makes us different is our people. Operating as trusted partners to our clients, we deliver intelligent solutions through a combination of technical expertise and strong relationships based on deep client understanding. 

We're driven by our Group purpose, to power people and possibilities.

Job Description

What You'll Do:

• You'll conduct AML/KYC reviews and prepare investor files for various entity types, including Individuals, Companies, Trusts, Foundations, and Regulated Entities.
• You'll ensure compliance with internal policies, regulatory requirements, and risk management standards throughout the onboarding process.
• You'll liaise with auditors, AIFMs, depositaries, compliance teams, and management to collect, review, and follow up on KYC documentation.
• You'll perform screening, filing, and verification of KYC records, while managing and responding to queries from internal and external stakeholders.
• You'll build strong client relationships, identify process improvement opportunities, and contribute to an efficient and customer-focused onboarding experience.

What we offer

• Comprehensive remuneration and pension: motivating financial packages based upon market rates for your role and is proportionate to your qualifications, level of experiences and skills profile
• Wellbeing: additional social benefits
• Flexible working: we recognise the value of working flexibly and want to ensure all employees enjoy an excellent work-life blend. As such, we are open to conversations with employees related to setting up flexible working arrangements.

Qualifications

About you:

• You hold a Bachelor's or master's degree in economics, Finance, or a related field, with recent graduation preferred.
• You bring 0-1 year of experience in AML/KYC, compliance, or a related function, a valuable asset to your success in this role.
• You are fluent in English, with proficiency in French or German considered an additional advantage.
• You demonstrate self-motivation and thrive as a collaborative team player who takes ownership of your work.

Additional information

OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU AND THE ENVIRONMENT

Sustainability is integral to our strategy and operations. Our sustainability depends on us building and maintaining long-term relationships with all our stakeholders – including our employees, clients, and local communities – while also reducing our impact on our natural environment.
There is always more we can, and should do, to improve – whether in relation to our people, our clients, our planet, or our governance. Our ongoing success as a business depends on our sustainability and agility in a changing and challenging global landscape. We're committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable and diverse culture for our people, led by our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion steering committee.

Our learning and development programmes and systems (including PowerU and MyCampus) enable us to invest in growing our employees' careers, while our hybrid working approach supports our employees in achieving balance and flexibility while remaining connected to their colleagues. We want to empower our 6,500+ employees - from 94 nationalities, across 24 countries - to each achieve their potential.  Through IQ-EQ Launchpad we support women managers launching their first fund, in an environment where only 15% of all private equity and venture capital firms are gender balanced.

We're committed to growing relationships with our clients and supporting them in achieving their objectives. We understand that our clients' sustainability and success lead to our sustainability and success. We're emotionally invested in our clients right from the beginning.

jobs.title: Senior Fund Accounting Officer (m/f)
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

The Senior Fund Accountant is responsible for the oversight and delivery of fund accounting services for a portfolio of closed‑ended Private Equity structures domiciled in Luxembourg. The role focuses on technical fund accounting, NAV oversight, review of complex transactions and financial statements, and close interaction with clients, auditors, and internal teams.

The position requires strong technical expertise in Luxembourg GAAP, a solid understanding of Luxembourg fund laws and structures (RAIF, SIF, SICAV‑SCA, SCSp, SARLs holding structures), and hands‑on experience with closed‑ended private equity fund mechanics.

Tasks

Fund Accounting & NAV Oversight

• Act as the primary reviewer and controller for NAV calculations across a portfolio of closed‑ended funds, including feeder/master and SPV structures.
• Review complex accounting areas, including excused investors, distribution waterfall mechanisms, carried interest, equalisation amongst others
• Ensure NAVs are prepared in accordance with applicable accounting standard (Luxembourg GAAP/IFRS), fund documentation, and agreed accounting policies.
• Review, challenge and approve NAVs, investor reporting, and supporting workpapers.

Financial Statements & Audit Coordination

• Review annual and interim financial statements under Lux GAAP and IFRS where applicable.
• Ensure consistency between NAVs, financial statements, and underlying accounting records.
• Act as the main point of contact for external auditors during interim and year‑end audits.
• Prepare and review responses to audit queries, including technical accounting positions and judgmental areas.
• Contribute to drafting and reviewing accounting policies and disclosure notes.

Client & Stakeholder Management

• Serve as a key contact for clients, investment managers, and other stakeholders.
• Explain complex accounting topics (unrealised FX movements, reinvestment mechanics, NAV drivers, equalisation etc) in a clear and pragmatic manner.
• Participate in client onboarding, including review of legal documentation from an accounting perspective and definition of fund‑specific accounting treatments.

Fund Onboarding & System Set‑Up

• Oversee fund onboarding activities from an accounting perspective, including: Review of fund documentation (LPA, PPM, side letters)
• Validation of chart of accounts and accounting models
• Review of data migration and opening balances
• Ensure correct setup of funds in accounting systems

Risk Management, Controls & Process Improvement

• Identify accounting and operational risks across the client portfolio and ensure appropriate controls are in place.
• Review KPIs and deliverables provided by back office or Global Delivery Teams (GCD) and challenge quality and timeliness where required.
• Support process improvements, standardisation, and automation initiatives within fund accounting

Team Support & Knowledge Sharing

• Act as a technical reference point for junior team members.
• Provide coaching, training, and on‑the‑job guidance on private equity and Luxembourg‑specific accounting topics.
• Support managers in maintaining high technical and quality standards across the team.

Required Experience / Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
• 4–6 years of experience in fund accounting within a private equity environment.
• Strong practical knowledge of Luxembourg GAAP and closed‑ended fund accounting.
• Solid understanding of Luxembourg fund structures and legal concepts (ring‑fencing, compartments/sub‑funds, master‑feeder structures).
• Experience dealing with auditors and client‑facing interactions.
• Professional qualification (ACCA or equivalent) is an advantage.
• Experience with fund accounting systems such as Investran is a strong asset.
• Fluent in English; French is an advantage.

Skills/Behavior

• Strong analytical and review skills with attention to detail.
• Ability to interpret fund documentation and translate it into accounting treatments.
• Comfortable handling complex and non‑standard transactions.
• Clear and confident communicator with internal teams and clients.
• Proactive, solutions‑oriented mindset.
• Ability to operate autonomously while collaborating effectively within a team.

jobs.title: Clinical Research Associate (m/f)
jobs.description:
The Clinical Research Associate works at LIH's Clinical and Epidemiological Investigation Center.

She/He will:

• Coordinate clinical research projects according to the protocol, budget and fixed timelines.
• Supervise and assist regulatory submissions to health authorities including the national research ethics committee.
• Support private sponsors, researchers and investigators from other research institutions or hospitals in the set up
and conduct of clinical research projects.
• Ensure compliance with the applicable legal, administrative and regulatory requirements.
• Provide specific expertise and know-how in clinical research.
• Provide support to safety reporting and adverse events reporting.
• Monitor clinical trials and guarantee the quality of the scientific data collected during the study.

Key Accountabilities

Site coordination & monitoring accountabilities:

• Be the interface between the various partners involved in clinical research projects including clinicians and researchers.
• Conduct the regulatory submissions according to the applicable laws and obtain approvals.
• Set-up financial contracts and manage financial aspects during the projects.
• Monitor and coordinate clinical research activities at different sites both at a national and international level including study design activities, initiation with all involved partners, monitoring, safety reporting and data management.
• Collect data, report it in the CRF and check that the data entered is consistent with the medical record of each patient.
• Participate in the quality procedure (evaluation process, drafting procedures, etc.), implementation of SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) and their validation process.
• Participate in European consortia and grant applications.
• Ensure on-site monitoring of clinical research projects at different sites, both nationally and internationally.

Data Management accountabilities:

• Contribute to the design, development, and review of eCRF forms, ensuring that fields, workflows, and edit checks are aligned with the study protocol and operational feasibility.
• Participate in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) of the electronic data capture (EDC) system by testing the eCRF, workflows, queries, and system functionalities before database go-live.
• Perform data review and data cleaning activities, including identifying data discrepancies, reviewing system-generated queries, and resolving issues in collaboration with investigators and Data Managers.
• Support database lock.

Key Skills, Experience and Qualifications

• Master's degree in the field of Medical/Health, Biomedical, or Life Sciences or Biology/Biotechnology related sciences.
• Certified clinical research training (DIU-FARC, DIU-TEC, etc.).
• At least 2 years of experience in the domain of clinical research (CRO, clinical trial unit or research centre, pharmaceutical industry) including a significant on-site monitoring experience.
• Experience in multi-center international clinical trials.
• Good understanding of EU and Luxembourg research regulation frameworks, including patient rights, data protection (GDPR), Clinical Trial Regulation (CTR), and procedures of the CA and EC.
• Familiarity with EU and international regulatory frameworks for clinical research, data protection, and the secondary use of data and samples (e.g. CTR, GDPR, ICH-GCP, MDR).
• Ability to interact positively with advisors and regulatory authorities.
• Independent and multidisciplinary team working abilities, meticulous, motivated, creative and scientifically innovative.
• Strong oral and written communication skills, be able of summarising ideas and prioritising.
• Language skills: Fluent in French and English. Any other commonly spoken language in Luxembourg such as Portuguese, German or Luxembourgish would be an added advantage.

Located in Luxembourg, LIH offers the opportunity to work in a dynamic, international and multilingual environment that values personal respect and professional achievement based on the highest intellectual and ethical standards. • Demonstrated experience engaging with commercial, institutional and governmental stakeholders across international markets, including the development of strategic partnerships, consortiums or collaborative business relationships.

• Experience working in dynamic, growth-oriented or entrepreneurial environments requiring a high degree of initiative, autonomy

• Strong negotiation, influencing and stakeholder management skills.
• Experience supporting proposal development, bid activities and contract negotiations.
