jobs.description:
Etsimme asiakkaallemme Lapua-ketjut Oy:lle tuoteryhmäpäällikköä Ketjumaailma -liiketoimintayksikön vetäjäksi Lapualle toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan työsuhteeseen. Työsuhde solmitaan valitun henkilön ja Lapua-ketjut Oy:n välille.

Tuoteryhmäpäällikön tehtävässä johdat yhtiön välitystuoteliiketoiminnan myyntiä, markkinointia ja hankintaa. Toimit myös välitysliiketoiminnan lähiesihenkilönä. Tehtävän hoitaminen edellyttää luontevaa toimintaa teollisuuden asiakkaiden ja toimittajien kanssa, kiinnostusta perehtyä uusiin tuotteisiin ja markkinointihenkistä asennetta.

Odotamme sinulta:

· kokemusta teollisesta myynnistä ja uusasiakashankinnasta
· ymmärrystä markkinointiviestinnästä
· kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä
· kykyä hallita ja nähdä kokonaisuuksia
· hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen englannin kielen osaaminen
· matkustusvalmius Suomessa ja ulkomailla
· B-kortin ja oman auton käyttömahdollisuuden



Tarjoamme sinulle:

· mahdollisuuden työskennellä kilpailukykyisten tuotteiden ja markkinan parissa
· mahdollisuuden nousta merkittävään rooliin suomalaisessa teollisuuden ketjuratkaisujen asiantuntijayrityksessä
· innostavan yhdistelmän myyntiä, tuoteryhmän kehittämistä ja kansainvälistä yhteistyötä
· nykyaikaiset työvälineet ja organisaation tuen onnistumiseesi
· työyhteisön, jossa ihmiset viihtyvät ja rakentavat pitkiä työuria
· aidon mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa omaan työhösi ja yrityksen kasvuun
· kehittymismahdollisuuksia sekä kotimaisessa, että kansainvälisessä liiketoimintaympäristössä
· kattavat henkilöstöedut; vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutus, liikunta- ja kulttuuriedut sekä aktiivista tyhy-toimintaa

Hakuprosessi:
Mikäli kiinnostuit, jätä hakemuksesi järjestelmäämme osoitteessa [www.bondata.fi](http://www.bondata.fi/). Haastattelut aloitamme jo hakuaikana ja paikkatäytetään sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Lisätietoja:
Bondata Seinäjoki-Vaasa
HR- ja asiakkuuspäällikkö
Anita Haapoja@bondata.fi
p.0400 182 668 (arkisin klo 8-16)

Ketjumaailma aloitti toimintansa vuonna 2015 Lapua-ketjujen aputoiminimenä. Ketjumaailman tavoite on tarjota asiakkailleen aina markkinoiden parhaat ja toimivimmat ketjuratkaisut. Huolella ja tarkkojen vaatimusten mukaan valitut tuotteet sekä kuljetinketjujen valmistuksen kautta kertynyt tieto ja osaaminen ovat Ketjumaailman perusta. Ketjumaailma tuo maahan ja tarjoaa kattavan valikoiman teollisuuden ketjuja, ketjupyöriä, sekä muita ketjuihin liittyviä tuotteita ja palveluja niin jälleenmyyjille kuin loppukäyttäjille.

Ketjumaailma tarjoaa myös tuotteiden jatkojalostusta ja räätälöintiä asiakkaan tarpeiden mukaan.

Ketjumaailman toimisto ja varasto sijaitsevat Etelä-Pohjanmaalla Lapualla, samoissa tiloissa Lapua-ketjujen kanssa. Teemme omassa tehtaassamme myös ketjujen kokoonpanoa, kolitusta, sekä ketjupyörien koneistusta. Varastotuotteet toimitamme nopeallakin aikataululla suoraan asiakkaalle.

Commercial Terrain - Indépendant (Freelance)
jobs.description:
Commercial(e) terrain indépendant(e) – SumUp

Vous avez une réelle expérience de la prospection à froid, sur le terrain ou par téléphone ? Rejoignez SumUp et accompagnez les commerçants avec des solutions de paiement simples et reconnues.

Vos missions

  • Prospecter les cafés, restaurants, boutiques, salons et entreprises de votre secteur ;
  • Identifier leurs besoins, présenter la solution adaptée et réaliser des démonstrations ;
  • Accompagner les commerçants jusqu'à l'activation et développer votre portefeuille.

La prospection est réalisée par vos soins : aucun portefeuille de leads n'est fourni.

Votre rémunération

Cette activité est rémunérée exclusivement à la commission, sans salaire fixe ni plafond :

  • 50 % de commission immédiate sur le matériel, les logiciels et les paiements générés par le commerçant au cours de son premier mois ;
  • 20 % de revenus récurrents sur l'activité de chaque commerçant signé, versés mensuellement pendant une durée pouvant aller jusqu'à 24 mois.

Exemple : un commerçant actif générant environ 15 000 € de volume de paiement mensuel peut vous permettre de percevoir plus de 1 000 € de commissions cumulées sur 24 mois.Ce montant indicatif varie selon les produits vendus, l'activation, le volume réel et le maintien de l'activité du commerçant. Aucun revenu minimum n'est garanti.

Vos outils et votre organisation

SumUp fournit une formation initiale, un terminal de démonstration et des supports commerciaux. Un référent de secteur reste disponible pour vous accompagner.

Votre zone est définie pendant le recrutement selon votre localisation et les secteurs ouverts. Vous organisez librement votre activité. Vos déplacements et les frais associés restent à votre charge ; aucun véhicule de fonction n'est fourni.

Votre profil

  • Au moins un an d'expérience en prospection à froid, terrain ou téléphonique, au cours des six dernières années ;
  • À l'aise dans une démarche commerciale proactive auprès de professionnels ;
  • Autonome, persévérant(e), fiable et orienté(e) résultats ;
  • Disponible au moins trois jours par semaine ;
  • Numéro SIRET valide au démarrage.

Processus de recrutement

  1. Échange téléphonique avec notre équipe recrutement ;
  2. Entretien avec le ou la référente de votre secteur ;
  3. Décision rapide fondée sur votre expérience et votre motivation.

Envie de développer votre activité avec une rémunération sans plafond et des revenus récurrents potentiels ? Postulez dès maintenant !

 

Job Application Tip

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

jobs.title: Sijaisvanhempi, perhehoitaja
jobs.description:
**Oletko pohtinut lastensuojelun perhehoitajaksi ryhtymistä?**

Etsimme sijaisvanhempina toimivia sekä sijaisvanhemmuudesta kiinnostuneita pariskuntia ja yksinasuvia mukaan toimintaamme. Pienten lasten sijaisperheiden ohella kaipaamme myös perhehoitoperheitä ja sijaisvanhemmuudesta kiinnostuneita, joilla olisi valmiutta tarjota koti nuoruusikäiselle tai monikulttuurisen taustan omaavalle lapselle tai nuorelle. Sinulla ei tarvitse olla sosiaalialan koulutusta vaan aito halu kulkea yhteistä matkaa sijaishuoltoa tarvitsevan lapsen/nuoren kanssa sekä elämäntilanne, jossa mahdollistuu tavallinen, turvallinen perhearki ja lastensuojelutyö.

Sijaisvanhemmuus edellyttää pitkäjänteisyyttä sekä sitoutumista lapseen, minkä vuoksi perhehoitajaksi ryhtyminen vaatii harkintaa, omaan elämäntilanteeseen ja itseen perehtymistä sekä riittävästi tietoa siitä, mitä sijaisvanhemmuus ja lastensuojelussa tehtävä työ tarkoittaa. Harkintaprosessin ja tiedonsaannin tueksi tarjoamme maksuttoman, ryhmämuotoisen Pride- valmennuksen tai perhekohtaisen valmennuksen.

Olemme toimineet lastensuojelun sijaishuollossa 15 vuoden ajan ja myös itse perhehoitajina, joten tunnemme perhehoitajuuden arjen ja sen erityisyyden myös omakohtaisesti. Haluammekin tarjota perhehoitajille heidän, ja heille sijoitettujen lasten/nuorten tarpeisiin räätälöidyn ammatillisen tuen sijoituksen alusta loppuun eivätkä perhehoitajat jää työssään yksin.

Lastensuojelupalvelut Nummenlinna Oy on pieni, perheomisteinen toimija, jossa ihmiset tuntevat toisensa. Perhehoitajalle tämä tarkoittaa henkilökohtaista yhteydenpitoa, tuttua työntekijää ja matalaa kynnystä ottaa yhteyttä myös silloin, kun asia ei ole suuri, mutta sitä on hyvä pohtia yhdessä. Toisinaan pienikin juttuhetki voi auttaa asiassa eteenpäin. Teemme tarvittaessa myös tiivistä yhteistyötä perhehoitajan tukena lapsen/nuoren asioissa toimivan viranomaisverkoston, eri toimijoiden ja läheisten kanssa.

Perhehoitajille tarjoamme:

- Ammatillinen, perhekohtaisesti räätälöity tuki koko sijoituksen ajan

- Vertaistuki ja yhteisöllisyys; mahdollisuus osallistua työyhteisön yhteisiin koulutuksiin ja työhyvinvointipäiviin sekä perhehoitajien vertaistoimintaan

- Tarvittaessa erityistyöntekijämme (psykologi) konsultointi ja tapaamiset

- Työnohjaus

- Säännölliset vapaat ja sijaishoidon järjestelyt

- Hoitopalkkio sekä käynnistämis- ja kulukorvaus

- Tukityömme ja ennakkovalmennus on mahdollista toteuttaa tarvittaessa myös englanniksi


**Ennakkovalmennukset**

Alkuvuodesta 2027 aloitamme PRIDE-valmennuksen perhehoitajuudesta kiinnostuneille. Valmennus tarjoaa mahdollisuuden tutustua rauhassa sijaisvanhemmuuteen ja saada tietoa siitä, mitä sijaisvanhemmuus käytännössä tarkoittaa. Valmennukseen osallistuminen ei tarkoita vielä päätöstä perhehoitajaksi ryhtymisestä vaan tarjoaa tietoa sekä tilaisuuden pysähtyä pohtimaan omia valmiuksia ja elämäntilannetta yksilöllisen harkintaprosessin tueksi. Valmennuksesta vastaavat yrityksemme perhehoidosta vastaava sosiaalityöntekijä sekä perhehoitaja työparina. Valmennus sisältää ryhmämuotoisia ja perhekohtaisia tapaamisia, ja on kestoltaan n. 4-6kk.

Jos perhehoitajuus on käynyt mielessäsi tai olet jo perhehoitajana toimiva, otathan yhteyttä ja jutellaan lisää! Voit myös halutessasi jättää soittopyynnön, niin olen yhteydessä pikimmiten!

Perhehoidon sosiaalityöntekijä: Annamari Jansen, p. 040-5166089, annamarijansen@nummenlinna.fi

jobs.title: General System Manager Control Plane
jobs.description:
Company description:

Ericsson AB

Job description:   Join our Team  

About this opportunity:



We are looking for a General System Manager Control Plane (BCSS CNE PDU PC S&T) to join our teams and help us develop 5Gc and soon adding 6G in a creative and collaborative environment.



Ericsson Packet Core (PC) delivers connectivity, security, mobility and data routing with terabyte-scale throughput, offering features like network slicing, multi-access and cloud-native automation to customers worldwide. Both teams are in Lindholmen in Gothenburg, Sweden, and have also extensive cooperation with colleagues mainly in Shanghai and Krakow/Lodz.



To meet todays and tomorrow’s challenges, we are looking for ambitious, curious and collaborative individuals who want to grow with us. We offer a stimulating and supportive environment where you can develop, make a real impact, and help inspire your colleagues.As part of a team in Packet Core System & Technology, you will help strengthen our 5G market leadership while contributing to robust and maintainable products in a highly competitive market. Key elements of our 5G strategy are the development of the Access and Mobility Management Function (AMF) and the Session Management Function (SMF).You will also contribute to exploring and applying AI-based tools and capabilities, both in future products and in our ways of working.







What you will do:



•    Drive the PDU’s view on product vision and technology roadmap, for example through system studies•    Act as an interface towards Product Management, business regions and System & Technology (S&T) for studies, standardization and pre-sales support•    Manage system requirements and artefacts, including compliance with relevant standards•    Lead and contribute to system studies, feature analysis and 3GPP change request analysis, and provide support to business regions•    Support feature development through the full development cycle in close collaboration with design teams, including feature analysis•    Identify and improve requirements within your competence area and take responsibility for selected system artefacts







The skills you bring:



•    Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant technical field•    Proven hands-on experience and solid knowledge in one or more of the following telecom domains: system management, 3GPP and Packet Core•    Strong business understanding•    Knowledge of product life cycle management•    Experience with requirement management•    Knowledge of AI- and data-driven approaches in engineering and product development•    Excellent problem-solving skills and strong attention to detail•    Ability to lead and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams•    Ability to explain complex technical information to non-technical stakeholders•    Strong relating and networking skills•    Ability to adapt and respond to change•    Willingness to share knowledge and support colleagues’ development•    Strong communication and presentation skills•    Fluent in English, both written and spoken







We look forward to your application with CV in English. Please note that we do not accept, proceed, or respond for applications sent via e-mail.

jobs.title: Solution Architect
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Architect to help shape the future of banking technology. You will lead the architecture of domain-oriented data products and APIs that enable critical business capabilities across the bank. Working at the intersection of business, technology and data, you will partner with architects, engineers, product managers and senior stakeholders to create scalable, secure and resilient solutions. You will provide end-to-end architectural leadership across multiple delivery streams, while enabling teams to make effective decisions within clear architectural guardrails.

Your impact:
You will establish reusable data and API capabilities that accelerate delivery, improve interoperability and create value for customers and business partners.

What youll be doing:
 Lead architecture across domains
 Define and evolve the architecture vision, principles and roadmap for Data Products and Domain APIs.
 Align business capabilities, data assets, APIs and technology platforms across multiple delivery streams.
 Oversee the end-to-end solution architecture and coordinate the work of software architects embedded in individual delivery streams.
 Identify interfaces, data flows and cross-domain dependencies, and guide teams in evaluating solution alternatives.

Drive data product excellence:
 Establish patterns and standards for domain-owned data products that are discoverable, trustworthy, reusable and governed.
 Clarify data ownership, product boundaries, quality expectations, metadata, lineage and lifecycle responsibilities.
 Partner with business and technology stakeholders to maximise the value and safe use of data across the organisation.
 Promote modern data architecture practices, including data product thinking and domain ownership.

Shape the domain API landscape:
 Define API-first architecture principles, design standards, governance and lifecycle management practices.
 Guide the definition of domain boundaries, API contracts, versioning, security and reusable integration patterns.
 Ensure APIs are secure, scalable, resilient, observable and easy for consumers to use.
 Support event-driven and service-oriented integration approaches where they provide clear business and technology value.

Build resilient, delivery-ready solutions:
 Define solution-level functional requirements and non-functional requirements for availability, performance, security, scalability, resilience and operability.
 Define subsystems and interfaces, allocate responsibilities and clarify interactions with the wider solution context.
 Build and maintain the architectural runway needed for sustainable delivery and future change.
 Enable Continuous Delivery and DevOps through pragmatic design guidelines, automation and investment advocacy.

Collaborate and influence:
 Work closely with Product and Solution Management, business stakeholders, engineering teams, Enterprise Architects and external suppliers.
 Contribute architectural expertise to planning, high-level design, solution demonstrations and continuous exploration.
 Help shape and realise architectural enablers, including appropriate capacity allocation for enablement work.
 Communicate complex architecture decisions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
 Mentor architects and engineering teams, foster collaboration and enable decentralised decision-making.

Requirements:
 Experience and domain knowledge
 Significant experience in Solution Architecture, Domain Architecture, Enterprise Architecture or a comparable senior architecture role.
 A proven track record of designing and delivering enterprise-scale data, API and integration solutions.
 Experience leading architecture across multiple teams, products or technology domains.
 A strong understanding of banking technology and business processes. 
 Experience with Core Banking platforms is highly desirable.
 Experience working in complex, regulated environments with demanding security, resilience and data governance requirements.

Answer these questions separately in a few sentences and attach them to your application! (Mandatory!)
- Do you have experience in design architecture for Data Products?*
- Do you have experience within banking sector? If yes, please elaborate.*

jobs.title: Receptionisten Dag & Nacht
jobs.description:
Ben je gepassioneerd door hospitality en vind je het leuk om gasten een warm welkom te geven?

Word dan onderdeel van het team van B&B HOTEL Brussels Airport als Receptionist(e) en wordt een van de eerste aanspreekpunten voor onze gasten.


Jouw verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Gasten op een vriendelijke, professionele en efficiënte manier verwelkomen.
  • Check-ins en check-outs verzorgen.
  • Gasten informeren over het hotel, de aangeboden diensten en de omgeving.
  • Reservaties en annuleringen beheren en verzoeken van gasten opvolgen.
  • Betalingen verwerken en zorgen voor een correcte kasadministratie.
  • Vragen van gasten beantwoorden persoonlijk, telefonisch en per e-mail.
  • Feedback en klachten van gasten professioneel behandelen en passende oplossingen zoeken.
  • Samenwerken met housekeeping en andere hotelafdelingen om een vlot verblijf voor de gasten te garanderen.
  • Zorgen voor een nette, georganiseerde en gastvrije receptie.
  • De procedures van het hotel volgen en bijdragen aan hoge kwaliteitsnormen op het gebied van service en gastentevredenheid.
  • Ervaring in de horeca, klantenservice of receptie is een pluspunt.
  • Je bent vriendelijk, professioneel en werkt graag met mensen.
  • Je beschikt over uitstekende communicatieve en sociale vaardigheden.
  • Je bent georganiseerd, betrouwbaar en kunt zelfstandig werken.
  • Je blijft rustig en oplossingsgericht in drukke situaties.
  • Je hebt een goede kennis van het Engels; kennis van het Frans en/of Nederlands is een sterke troef.
  • Je kunt vlot met computers en hotelreserveringssystemen werken.
  • Je bent flexibel en bereid om in shiften te werken, inclusief 's avonds, in het weekend en op feestdagen.
  • Je hebt een positieve ingesteldheid en een sterke klantgerichte mentaliteit

Vereiste vaardigheden:

  • Op een gepaste manier reageren op klachten of geschillen met gasten, bijvoorbeeld door een commerciële geste te doen.
  • Reservaties registreren en de bezettingsplanning van kamers, appartementen, bungalows, enz. bijwerken.
  • Gasten informeren over de diensten van het hotel en de reservatievoorwaarden.
  • Activiteiten opvolgen en registreren (reservaties, annuleringen, verkopen, enz.) en dagelijkse statistische rapporten opstellen (bezettingsgraad, gemiddelde kamerprijs, enz.).
  • Tijdens het verblijf reageren op vragen en verzoeken van gasten.

jobs.title: Jet Engin Inspector | Zaventem | Permanent Contract

jobs.title: Mobiele en ambulante begeleider (m,v,x)
jobs.description:
De Witte Mol is een zorgvoorziening die mobiele en ambulante begeleiding aanbiedt aan personen met een beperking en hun netwerk. Via rechtstreeks toegankelijke hulp (RTH), PAB-begeleiding en andere ondersteuningsvormen begeleiden we zorggebruikers en hun netwerk. We geloven in de kracht van verbinding en samenwerking en bouwen samen aan zorg op maat. Respect, dialoog en aandacht voor de individuele noden van elke zorggebruiker vormen daarbij de basis van onze werking.

Jouw taken worden …

Als mobiele en ambulante begeleider sta je, met de visie en de kaders van De Witte Mol als fundamenten, in voor een kwalitatieve ondersteuning van kinderen, jongeren en volwassenen met een beperking en hun netwerk. Je biedt een antwoord op zorgvragen en vertrekt hierbij steeds vanuit de unieke noden, mogelijkheden en interesses van elke zorggebruiker.

  • Je organiseert en begeleidt activiteiten op maat van zowel interne als ambulante zorggebruikers, zowel individueel als in groep. Hierbij bied je een passend antwoord op zorgvragen en ondersteun je zorggebruikers tijdens diverse activiteiten en vrijetijdsmomenten.
  • Je staat mee in voor de vakantieopvang van kinderen met een beperking en zorgt hierbij voor een veilige, gestructureerde en pedagogisch onderbouwde omgeving. Je neemt daarnaast ook praktische en huishoudelijke taken op die bijdragen aan een vlotte dagelijkse werking.
  • Je werkt nauw samen met familieleden en andere betrokkenen en zorgt voor een duidelijke, correcte en tijdige informatie-uitwisseling.
  • Je zorgt voor een correcte administratieve opvolging en registratie van de begeleidingen.

Daarnaast maak je deel uit van een zelfsturend team en neem je hierin verantwoordelijkheid. Samen met je collega’s draag je bij aan kwalitatieve zorg en werk je volgens de gemaakte afspraken en het beleid van De Witte Mol.

We verwachten van jou …

  • een bachelor in de menswetenschappen en gemotiveerd bent om personen met een beperking en hun netwerk te ondersteunen.
  • dat je beschikbaar bent om op 18 oktober 2026 op te starten
  • dat je beschikt over een rijbewijs B
  • een hart voor mensen met een beperking en respectvolle, open communicatie
  • kennis van ASS is een absoluut pluspunt;
  • je kan zelfstandig én in team werken
  • je bent sterk in plannen en organiseren
  • je bouwt vlot een vertrouwensband op met cliënten en hun netwerk
  • je bent creatief in het uitwerken van activiteiten

Sinds de oprichting in 1992 wenden we ons tot kinderen, jongeren en volwassenen met een beperking, en hun brede context. We bieden vrijetijdsbesteding op maat aanbieden voor de brede doelgroep én willen een plek zijn waar ouders met een kind met een beperking steun vinden bij elkaar en elkaar kunnen ontmoeten. Sinds 2018 behuizen we, ook in Tielt-Winge, dagcentrum de Kalebas waar (jong)volwassenen met een beperking terecht kunnen voor een zinvolle en kwalitatieve dagbesteding in ateliervorm. Sinds begin dit jaar behuizen we, in onze tweede vestiging te Diest, een wooncentrum voor (jong)volwassenen met een beperking en een aangrenzende inclusieve koffie- en lunchbar waar gebruikers van ons dag- en wooncentrum een actieve rol opnemen in het bedienen van klanten.

Villa84 is de naam van ons gloednieuw wooncentrum. 14 (jong)volwassenen met een beperking vinden hier een warme thuis. Zij nemen overdag deel aan zinvolle dagbesteding – bij dagcentrum De Kalebas of elders. ’s Ochtends, van zodra zij terugkeren naar het wooncentrum en in het weekend is begeleiding aanwezig; er is tevens een inslapende nachtbegeleider. Villa84 wil een veilige, inclusieve en huiselijke omgeving bieden waar bewoners zichzelf kunnen zijn en waar familie en netwerk altijd welkom zijn.

Om de werking van Villa84 mee vorm te geven, zoeken wij een coördinator die een sleutelrol zal spelen in de verdere uitbouw van dit nog nieuwe woonproject en in de ondersteuning van het begeleidend team.

Wat is jouw takenpakket?

  • Je staat in voor de operationele werking van het wooncentrum en tracht deze maximaal te optimaliseren.
  • Je bouwt de dagelijkse werking samen met het begeleidersteam verder uit en organiseert het wooncentrum praktisch en inhoudelijk.
  • Samen met de begeleiding sta je garant voor kwalitatieve ondersteuning van de doelgroep.
  • Je maakt samen met de coördinator van dagcentrum De Kalebas een vlotte, complementaire en nauwe samenwerking mogelijk tussen de pijlers van dag- en woonondersteuning.
  • Je maakt deel uit van het kernteam en bent dan ook beleidsmatig sterk. Je volgt wijzigende of nieuwe regelgeving en beleidselementen op en vertaalt deze naar de praktijk.
  • Je garandeert kwaliteitsvolle zorg, in lijn met de VAPH-regelgeving.
  • Je zorgt voor heldere en verbindende communicatie met alle betrokkenen. Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor bewoners, familie, je team en externe partners.
  • Je verzorgt het intakeproces bij nieuwe aanmeldingen, maakt individuele dienstverleningsovereenkomsten (IDO’s) op en beheert de cliëntendossiers (via ZorgOnline). Je stelt met je team handelingsplannen op per cliënt en volgt deze samen met de aandachtsbegeleider op.
  • Je bent een coachend leidinggevende die teamleden ondersteunt, motiveert en mee op sleeptouw neemt. Je verbindt en enthousiasmeert.
  • Je staat mee in voor het VTO-beleid en leidt je team toe naar relevante vormingen, trainingen en opleidingen.
  • Je bent logistiek en administratief sterk.
  • Je vindt het niet erg om in de groep te staan. Je hoofdrol is vanzelfsprekend deze van coördinator, maar je durft jezelf ook inschakelen in de groepswerking. Je kan je indien nodig flexibel opstellen om bij ziekte, afwezigheid of gedurende het weekend in te springen als begeleider.
  • Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de algemeen coördinator en de directeur van vzw Het Balanske en werkt nauw samen met de coördinator van dagcentrum de Kalebas.

Wie zoeken wij?

We zoeken een coördinator die meedenkt, meedoet én meebouwt.

Jij bent iemand die:

  • Een bachelor- of masterdiploma heeft, bij voorkeur in een orthopedagogische, sociale of menswetenschappelijke richting.
  • Ervaring heeft in de zorgsector en liefst ook in een leidinggevende of coördinerende functie. Kennis van en ervaring binnen een VAPH-voorziening is een belangrijke meerwaarde.
  • Beslissingsvaardig én toegankelijk is: je kan knopen doorhakken, maar luistert ook naar je team en betrekt hen.
  • Flexibel, stressbestendig en communicatief sterk is.
  • Orthopedagogisch inzicht heeft om onze bewoners samen met het team de juiste ondersteuning te bieden en handelingsplannen mee uit te werken en op te volgen.
  • Administratief en digitaal onderlegd is.
  • Een blanco uittreksel uit het strafregister kan voorleggen.

jobs.title: Verpleegkundige Donorcentrum Antwerpen, 24u
jobs.description:
Rode Kruis-Vlaanderen is dé werkgever voor gemotiveerde kandidaten die alles uit hun job willen halen met het oog op een bloeiende carrière. Van jobs in verpleegkunde en labo's, sociale hulpverlening, IT- HR- en managementfuncties, help ons helpen en maak er je job van!

Elke dag hebben mensen bloed nodig: na een operatie, een bevalling, een verkeersongeval... Daarom zamelt Rode Kruis-Vlaanderen jaarlijks ruim 400.000 bloed- en plasmagiften in.

Voor ons nieuw Donorcentrum in Antwerpen-centrum (opening verwacht in 2027), zijn we op zoek naar verpleegkundigen. Een job voor wie van afwisseling houdt en graag in team werkt.

Wil jij je mee inzetten en het verschil maken voor de patiënten die een bloedproduct nodig hebben?

Functiebeschrijving
  • Je wordt ingeschakeld in het nieuwe Donorcentrum in het centrum van Antwerpen;
  • Je staat samen met je collega's in voor het voorbereiden en/of afsluiten van de zaal;
  • Je begeleidt de donoren op een vlotte manier doorheen het donatieproces (inclusief de opstart en opvolging van de afname van bloed en plasma) en zorgt dat ze de nodige informatie krijgen;
  • Je registreert de donoren;
  • Je kleeft de etiketten op de nodige afnamesets;
  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het veilig en correct aanprikken van donoren;
  • Je verwijdert de naald nadat de bloedafname is afgerond;
  • Je legt het drukverband aan;
  • Je volgt strikte procedures gericht op kwaliteit en veiligheid;
  • Je bent ambassadeur van het Rode Kruis-Vlaanderen;
  • Je geeft donoren informatie omtrent hun donatie en je moedigt hen aan om een nieuwe afspraak te maken en/of eventueel voor een ander bloedproduct.
  • Je beschikt over een diploma verpleegkunde bachelor of HBO5;
  • Je bent een dynamisch iemand met verantwoordelijkheidszin. Je ziet werk en staat je collega's bij waar nodig;
  • Je werkt precies en volgt nauwgezet de procedures en veiligheidsnormen van Rode Kruis-Vlaanderen. Ervaring met het werken binnen een kwaliteitssysteem is een plus;
  • Je bent sociaal ingesteld en je past je gemakkelijk aan de steeds wisselende afnameteams aan;
  • Je bent donorgericht en beschikt over goede communicatieve vaardigheden;
  • Je bent digitaal vaardig zodat je snel ingewerkt bent in nieuwe (bedrijfs)applicaties. Kennis van MS Office is een pluspunt;
  • Je bent bereid om te werken in een variabel uurrooster. Dit houdt ook avondwerk en zaterdagwerk in.

jobs.title: Senior T24 Architect
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior T24 Architect to shape the evolution of a large and complex Core Banking environment. You will define and guide the architecture of the Temenos T24 landscape, making sure that business capabilities, technology platforms and long-term strategic goals stay aligned.

You will work with business stakeholders, engineers, architects and external partners across multiple markets, providing architectural leadership over several initiatives and delivery streams. Your goal is to protect the stability and resilience of business-critical banking services while enabling platform modernisation and simplification.

Key Responsibilities:
 Shape and evolve the architecture roadmap for Temenos T24 and surrounding Core Banking capabilities, defining target-state architecture, principles and standards in line with business and technology strategy
 Provide end-to-end architectural leadership across complex initiatives, ensuring consistency, scalability and sustainability of the Core Banking landscape
 Translate business requirements into robust, implementable solutions, including integrations between Core Banking and payments, digital channels, lending, deposits, customer management and data platforms
 Identify interfaces, data flows and dependencies across applications, infrastructure and external services
 Evaluate architectural alternatives and make clear trade-offs between business value, delivery risk and technical complexity
 Drive modernisation and simplification of the Core Banking ecosystem, promoting API-first, event-driven and cloud-enabled patterns where appropriate
 Improve platform maintainability, testability and operability, and identify opportunities for reuse, automation and standardisation across markets and delivery teams
 Define functional and non-functional requirements for availability, security, performance, scalability, resilience and operability
 Guide architecture reviews to ensure alignment with enterprise standards and regulatory expectations, and maintain the architectural runway for sustainable delivery
 Assess architectural risks, technical debt and lifecycle concerns, and guide proportionate remediation
 Act as a trusted advisor for strategic Core Banking initiatives and technology investment decisions, communicating complex topics clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
 Mentor architects and engineers, fostering collaboration and accountable decision-making within teams

Required Skills and Experience:
 Significant experience with Temenos T24 / Temenos Transact in architecture, solution design or senior engineering roles
 Deep understanding of Core Banking processes, platform capabilities and integration dependencies
 Proven record of leading architecture for large-scale transformation, migration or modernisation initiatives
 Experience working across multiple teams, products or markets in a complex enterprise environment
 Banking experience involving demanding availability, security, resilience and regulatory requirements

jobs.title: Linux System Administrator - 19618
jobs.description:
Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.

Role Summary

An experienced Linux System Administrator is needed for a consulting assignment focused on designing, building and maintaining a GPU-enabled remote desktop and virtual desktop infrastructure environment. The platform supports high-performance remote desktops for pre-processing and post-processing of High-Performance Computing (HPC) workloads, including simulation, visualization and rendering.

The environment is based on Rocky Linux and Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), with technologies including X11, Xfce4, NICE DCV, EnginFrame and SLURM. The assignment has a strong emphasis on automation, platform engineering, system architecture and long-term operational sustainability.

Key Responsibilities

    Design, deploy, operate and maintain a Linux-based GPU-enabled VDI and remote desktop environment.
    Develop and maintain automation and Infrastructure-as-Code solutions to enable consistent, repeatable platform deployments.
    Use Ansible primarily to automate configuration management, provisioning and operational workflows.
    Ensure that the platform remains secure, scalable, high-performing and maintainable over time.
    Support remote desktop use cases for HPC-related simulation, visualization and rendering workloads.
    Collaborate closely with HPC and infrastructure engineering teams on platform design, integration and operations.
    Document solution architecture, system configurations, deployment workflows and operational procedures.
    Contribute to monitoring, observability and troubleshooting of complex Linux infrastructure environments.

Technical Stack & Requirements

    Rocky Linux and/or Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL).
    Ansible and Infrastructure-as-Code practices for automated deployments and configuration management.
    Bash scripting; Python is advantageous.
    Git and GitLab, including experience working with CI/CD pipelines.
    X11 and Linux desktop environments, particularly Xfce4 and GNOME.
    Remote rendering, display and visualization technologies, including NICE DCV and EnginFrame.
    Networking, infrastructure security and monitoring capabilities.
    Prometheus-based monitoring and observability tooling.
    HPC environments and the SLURM workload manager are advantageous.
    Docker, Podman and Open OnDemand are beneficial.

Qualifications & Experience

The ideal consultant has solid hands-on experience as a Linux System Administrator, preferably in Rocky Linux or RHEL environments. Strong experience in automation and Infrastructure-as-Code is required, ideally with Ansible or comparable tooling. The role requires proficiency in Bash scripting, while Python experience is considered beneficial.

Experience with CI/CD practices, version control, Linux graphical environments, remote display technologies, networking, security and monitoring is expected. The consultant should be capable of designing scalable, maintainable technical platforms and independently taking ownership of complex infrastructure environments. Experience supporting HPC platforms, SLURM, remote visualization solutions and container technologies is considered advantageous.

The assignment focuses on early-phase development and concept work for emerging technologies, including electrification, hydrogen, and e-Mining applications. jobs.title: Frontend Engineer (H/F)
jobs.description:
L'app Hello Watt, c'est 3 millions de téléchargements et plus d'1 million de foyers connectés. C'est l'app pour piloter l'énergie dans son logement, réduire ses factures et participer à la stabilité du réseau électrique via les marchés de la flexibilité. Chez Hello Watt nous électrifions également les logements en installant des panneaux solaires ou des pompes à chaleur partout en France.
Nous recherchons un Frontend Engineer, aussi à l'aise dans une application React web/TypeScript que dans une page server-rendered avec HTMX et AlpineJS, supporté par notre design system basé sur TailwindCSS.
Chez Hello Watt, le frontend est un pilier de l'expérience utilisateur : courbes de consommation, pilotage d'appareils en temps réel, parcours de souscription, design system partagé entre React et Django, tu seras au cœur de l'expérience de centaines de milliers de foyers, sur le web comme sur iOS et Android.
Nous sommes convaincus que l'IA transforme en profondeur le métier de développeurs-euses. Nous cherchons à garder une qualité de code et une facilité de maintenance élevés, tout en embrassant les nouvelles pratiques et workflows IA.
Tes missions :
- Faire vivre et évoluer Firebolt, notre design system (Tailwind + composants React et Django) en facilitant l'intégration et l'adoption par les développeurs-euses full-stack.

- Veiller à des temps de chargements rapides pour tous sur l'app et le site hellowatt.fr (SEO, Core Web Vitals).

- Implémenter le frontend de nouvelles fonctionnalités sur l'application Hello Watt (web/iOS/Android).

- Définir les pratiques et les outils communs du frontend, faire converger l'existant : data-fetching, formulaires, state management, conventions de composants côté Django/htmx.

- Maintenir un haut niveau de qualité sur le code, qu'il soit écrit à la main ou généré par IA via des revues exigeantes et la mise en place d'outils pour améliorer les agents IA.

- Élargir la couverture et les outils de tests du frontend : tests de composants et de hooks (Vitest, Testing Library), scénarios end-to-end (Playwright), Storybook.

Profil recherché
Nous cherchons des ingénieurs qui ne se concentrent pas uniquement sur l'implémentation: poser les bons problèmes, comprendre les utilisateurs-ices, et tenir l'architecture sur le long terme.
Compétences clés recherchées :
- Passion frontend : forte curiosité et veille active de son écosystème: supports des nouvelles fonctionnalités navigateurs, frameworks, tooling, patterns

- Problem solving : capacité à décomposer des problèmes complexes, identifier les vrais enjeux métier et faire les bons compromis techniques

- User & UX focus : sensibilité forte à l'expérience utilisateur et à la valeur livrée

- Architecture système : capacité à concevoir et faire évoluer une architecture web modulaire, scalable et maintenable

Compétences techniques recherchées :
- Expérience confirmée en développement frontend avec React et TypeScript, dans un environnement produit exigeant sur l'expérience utilisateur.

- À l'aise avec le rendu côté serveur et l'approche hypermedia: Templates Django, htmx, Alpine.js ou similaires.

- Habitué à travailler et/ou définir un design system.

- Maîtrise des bonnes pratiques de développement : typage & lint de code, tests unitaires et fonctionnels, documentation, revues de code, composition, architecture modulaire par domaines métier.

jobs.title: Automotive Design & Development Engineer
jobs.description:
The Automotive Design & Development Engineer is responsible for the design, development, testing, and validation of automotive components and systems in accordance with international automotive standards and Swedish industry practices. The role involves technical responsibility from concept phase through series production.

The position requires advanced engineering competence and independent technical decision-making.

Main Duties and Responsibilities

The employee will perform the following tasks:

Design & Development

    •    Develop and design automotive components and subsystems using CAD software (e.g., CATIA, Siemens NX, Creo, SolidWorks).

    •    Prepare 2D drawings and 3D models including GD&T specifications.

    •    Conduct tolerance analysis and material selection.

    •    Lead concept design reviews and technical feasibility studies.

Engineering Analysis & Validation

    •    Perform engineering simulations such as FEA and CFD.

    •    Support prototype builds and validation testing.

    •    Prepare Design Verification Plan & Report (DVP&R).

    •    Conduct DFMEA and risk assessments.

Product Lifecycle Management

    •    Manage engineering change requests (ECR/ECN).

    •    Prepare technical documentation in compliance with automotive quality standards (IATF 16949, ISO standards).

    •    Coordinate with manufacturing for production readiness.

Supplier & Cross-Functional Coordination

    •    Interface with suppliers for component development and cost optimization.

    •    Support procurement and quality teams during APQP and PPAP processes.

    •    Provide technical support during vehicle launch and production ramp-up.

Qualification Requirements

The position requires:

    •    Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or equivalent.

    •    Minimum 3–5 years of relevant experience in automotive product design and development.

    •    Proficiency in advanced CAD tools (CATIA/NX/Creo/SolidWorks).

    •    Knowledge of automotive development processes (APQP, PPAP, DFMEA).

    •    Experience in engineering simulations (FEA/CFD preferred).

    •    Strong knowledge of automotive safety and regulatory standards.

    •    Fluent English (spoken and written).

The position requires independent problem-solving skills and the ability to work in cross-functional international teams.

Employment Terms

    •    Employment type: Full-time, Project based

    •    Working hours: 40 hours per week

    •    Salary: Salary in line with Swedish collective agreement and meeting the minimum salary requirement for work permit eligibility

    •    Benefits: Occupational pension, insurance, and employment conditions according to Swedish labor law and applicable collective agreement

5. Level of Responsibility

This role is classified as a qualified engineering position requiring higher education and specialized technical competence. The employee will independently manage assigned development projects and contribute to technical decision-making.

jobs.title: CNC Machinist
Software Engineer Intern (Summer 2027)
jobs.description:
Swarm Aero is redefining air power, building the largest swarming UAV and the most versatile swarming aircraft network in the world. The company is moving quickly to launch the first aircraft designed specifically for swarming, as well as the Command & Control software to mobilize swarms of thousands of heterogeneous autonomous assets and empower human operators to achieve superhuman results.

The team has created and exited multiple startups, negotiated defense deals worth billions of dollars, and designed and built 30+ novel aircraft, with aerospace experience from Scaled Composites, Airbus, Archer Aviation, Blue Origin, and Boom Supersonic.

READ THIS PART FIRST

Legion is not a normal web application. It is command and control software that has to present dense real-time information, coordinate distributed systems, and continue being useful when communications are imperfect.

WHAT WE DO

Swarm Aero is redefining air power. We are building autonomous aircraft and Legion, command and control software designed to coordinate large numbers of heterogeneous autonomous systems. Our team combines experience building novel aircraft, scaling startups, and delivering technology for national security.

THE INTERNSHIP

You will own a scoped project with a clear technical or business outcome, work directly with the people responsible for the system, and present what you built and learned at the end of the summer. The goal is not to give you practice work. It is to give you useful work with the support to do it well.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

· Build product features across frontend, backend, full-stack, real-time, or forward-deployed software

· Develop interfaces for telemetry, geospatial data, mission planning, scheduling, collaboration, or system health

· Build and operate backend services, APIs, event-driven systems, or data pipelines

· Write automated tests, improve developer tooling, and help ship production-quality software

· Support integration and test events, debug issues across services and networks, and turn what you learn into product improvements

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

· Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related field, with graduation and enrollment requirements to be confirmed.

· Strong programming fundamentals and experience building a substantial software project

· Experience with a modern frontend framework, backend language, systems language, or full-stack application

· Ability to explain technical tradeoffs, debug methodically, and write maintainable code

WHAT SETS YOU APART

· React, TypeScript, Go, Python, Rust, C++, or similar tools

· Distributed systems, networking, real-time applications, maps, games, simulation, or data visualization

· Linux, Docker, CI/CD, customer-facing engineering, or deployed project experience

WHAT YOU DO NOT NEED

Aerospace experience, a perfect GPA, or a previous internship at a famous company. Show us what you have built, analyzed, tested, organized, or improved, and be ready to explain your contribution clearly.

THE HONEST VERSION

The pace is fast, the problems will not arrive fully defined, and you may spend part of the summer learning why your first approach was wrong. We will expect you to ask questions, test your assumptions, document your work, and leave the project better than you found it.

ITAR requirement

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

Swarm Aero is an equal opportunity employer. We value diverse backgrounds and experiences and make employment decisions without regard to race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, or disability.

What We Offer

  • Meaningful equity in a high-growth defense technology company

  • Competitive base salary commensurate with experience

  • Medical, dental, vision, and 401k

  • PTO and paid sick leave

  • Monthly wellness stipend

  • Daily catered lunch (office)

  • Paid parental leave

  • Direct impact on a critical national security mission

  • A world-class team of engineers and operators solving genuinely hard problems

Compensation: $35 per hour

jobs.title: Senior Asset Pipeline Engineer, Sim-Ready Content
jobs.description:
About Genesis AI

Genesis AI builds the simulation platform powering the next generation of robotics and embodied AI. Our flagship product, Genesis World, is a unified multi-physics simulation engine paired with Nyx, our in-house GPU-accelerated, path-traced photorealistic renderer. Together they provide a platform for training robotics and embodied AI at scale; letting teams simulate complex physical worlds with high fidelity and speed, from a laptop to datacenter-grade GPUs, and close the gap between simulation and the real world.

About the Role

A simulator is only as useful as the content that runs inside it. Training embodied agents at scale means large volumes of assets that are simultaneously physically valid and visually convincing and that is a pipeline problem before it is an art problem.

We're hiring a Senior Engineer to build the path from raw input to sim-ready asset: geometry from a range of sources going in; clean meshes, correct collision proxies, plausible physical properties, materials that hold up under a path tracer, and reliable metadata coming out.

The bar is throughput and repeatability. An asset that needs a human pass to be usable doesn't scale, so the pipeline has to make good decisions on its own and flag the cases where it can't.

Part of that autonomy comes from agents embedded in the graph itself. Nodes can call models to produce input content, drive generation, pick parameters, interpret a mesh before deciding how to treat it, or judge whether a result is acceptable. Making that reliable is its own engineering problem: agents are non-deterministic, they fail in ways a mesh operator doesn't, and they need guardrails, structured outputs, retries and verification around them. You'll be building that as a first-class part of the pipeline rather than bolting it on.

You'll work closely with the stakeholders, who set direction and priorities. You own the technical design and the implementation and you're expected to bring enough pipeline experience to challenge the plan where it needs challenging.

jobs.title: Quadrants: Compiler Lead
jobs.description:
What Quadrants is

Quadrants is an open-source translation layer that turns ordinary Python into optimized machine code at runtime, across CPU (Arm64, x86) and GPU (AMDGPU, CUDA, Metal, Vulkan) backends. CUDA is the primary target, with x86 the strong runner-up, especially for real-time simulation. The others drive adoption and support fast prototyping for research.

The ambition is explicit: build the best “Python compiler” in the world for physics and performance-critical numerical computing. We are fully committed to it, and we intend to beat leading alternatives like Nvidia Warp, Numba, or Triton.

It’s a standalone project with its own roadmap, built in the open. Genesis, our physics simulator, is its first and top-priority user, the source of its hardest workloads and its benchmarks. But Quadrants is general-purpose infrastructure for anyone writing performance-critical numerical Python, not an internal tool that happens to be public.

The bet: high-performance code should feel natural to write. Engineers write plain Python in a NumPy or PyTorch style, and Quadrants makes it fast.

The role

You own Quadrants end to end: the API, the IR and lowering, the optimization passes, the numerical primitives, and the roadmap.

Our ultimate objective: engineers write for readability and maintainability, never for performance. They write the version of an algorithm they are most comfortable with, and Quadrants rebuilds it into kernels that run as if an expert had hand-tuned them. Performance is the compiler’s job, not theirs. Getting there is a frontier problem, part research and part engineering, and we intend to define the state of the art on it, relentlessly pushing the limit further.

It calls for two things at once: the low-level GPU and compiler skill to make a single kernel optimal, and the ability to keep the whole system coherent as it grows.

The core tradeoff is settled: usability comes first. When usability and performance collide, usability wins, unless the cost is severe. We will limit what the system supports to go fast (static shapes and fixed-size allocation baked into kernels, say), but never the convenience of the API itself. Experts who want maximum performance and full control over the generated code get lower-level escape hatches, down to inline assembly, C, or PTX.

Your mandate is to build the best open-source Python compiler for physics simulation out there. No limit on what that takes. If it means replacing the entire engine, your call. Either way, you keep Quadrants healthy and unblocking the company in the meantime.

What you’ll own

  • API & authoring experience. The surface that physics and numerical-computing engineers write against, and, as an open-source library, the product’s face to the world. Idiomatic, natural to Python users, never a separate language bolted onto Python. Clean decorators, legible constraints, sharp errors, real escape hatches.

  • IR, lowering & backends. A stable IR that lowers to multiple backends, with room to grow and the door kept open for differentiable simulation. Today the computation graph is expressed through Quadrants’ own constructs. Recovering it automatically from ordinary Python is hard, and a long-term goal rather than today’s reality.

  • Optimization. Turn naive code into strong execution plans: vectorization, register and shared-memory usage, barriers and atomics, cooperative threading, dead-buffer and redundant-traffic elimination, dropping needless synchronization. Move low-level optimization off users and into the platform.

  • Primitives. Cholesky, eigendecomposition, matmul, reductions, solver kernels. Each owned with its correctness, benchmarks, and regression tracking.

  • Watching Genesis and the compiler together. Hunt for performance wins on both sides, in Genesis and in Quadrants itself. Propose API changes that cut duplication, improve readability, and reduce platform-specific special-casing. Less to maintain, more that simply works.

  • The project as a product. Benchmark real workloads, track performance over time, catch regressions early. Stay close to users (Genesis first), find friction and missing abstractions, drive adoption, set direction.

Who you are

You reason about whole systems and have taste for where complexity should live. You measure before you optimize, and you reach for memory traffic and launch overhead before FLOPs. You have opinions about API design. You write tests and benchmarks as you go, not afterward.

The ground that judgment stands on:

  • GPU. What optimal looks like and why: access patterns, registers, shared memory, barriers, atomics, threading. CPU intuition a plus.

  • Python & API taste. Idiomatic Python. A feel for what’s natural to Python users. APIs that free users rather than constrain them.

  • Compilers. The path from authoring to kernels (IR, lowering, optimization), weighed against maintainability.

And how you work: proactive and largely self-directed. You fetch context across the company instead of waiting for it. You’re comfortable talking to the engineers who use what you build, and at ease designing in the open for users you’ll never meet. Ready to grow into leading a small team (a couple of people, near term).

What great looks like

People adopt Quadrants from outside Genesis. Engineers write clearer code with less boilerplate. Kernels keep getting faster. Performance is tracked, not guessed. The architecture gets easier to extend, not harder.

What we’re uncompromising about

How you work is up to you. What matters is that your ownership grows over time: blind spots shrink, the parts you can vouch for expand, technical debt goes down, the core stays sound.

That takes treating understanding as real work, not overhead. You read and challenge the codebase instead of just stacking features on it. You take nothing you did not write for granted. You watch the competition and what’s coming next, and you bring it in and ship it.

Use AI agents if they help. They are productivity tools, not code owners. You are.

jobs.title: Genesis-World: Core Physics Engineer
jobs.description:
What we're building

Robots will learn in simulation before they hit the factory. Genesis-World is our bet on that future.

Genesis-World is an open-source, general-purpose simulation platform for physical AI from Genesis AI. One unified multi-physics engine: rigid bodies, FEM, MPM, particles, cloth, fluids. A robot arm can pour water onto sand, grasp a deformable object, or cut a soft body, all in the same simulation. Nyx, our in-house renderer, may be the most promising renderer for robotics out there: real-time photo-realistic rendering, advanced features like depth of field, and state-of-the-art techniques never seen before. Sensors of every kind: cameras, lidar, IMU, contact forces, temperature, plus arguably the most advanced tactile simulation available (paper). And the engine keeps growing: we are developing internally the most comprehensive and fastest Incremental Potential Contact (paper) solver for deformable body dynamics we know of, soon to be open-sourced. It powers real business applications, from full-fledged box packaging with labelling machine and all, to wire harnessing and lab automation, without any physics hack or compromise.

Everything is Python-first and runs anywhere. Kernels are written once, and Quadrants, our in-house JIT compiler, lowers them to CUDA, AMD ROCm, Apple Metal, Vulkan, x86, and ARM64. A single laptop or a datacenter. Massively batched GPU simulation for learning at scale, and complex non-batched scenes where CPU wins outright.

This is at the core of Genesis AI's strategy. Evaluation is the bottleneck of scalable robotics: real hardware caps iteration at wall-clock time, but simulation turns it into a compute problem. Ours already runs two orders of magnitude faster than hardware (tens of thousands of episodes in half an hour instead of 200+ hours), while correlating with on-hardware rollouts at 89%. The north star: physical AI that improves at the speed of compute.

The role

You push the physics of Genesis-World forward. The mandate is clear: ship production-ready simulation capabilities that matter for the company's internal needs. Research applied end-to-end, from algorithm to merged, tested, documented code that real robot-learning pipelines depend on. Occasional groundbreaking research happens, notably through academic collaborations. But the core of the job is making the engine measurably better along five axes:

  • Speed. Algorithms that are not only faster but also smart enough to spend compute only where it matters across both time and space: larger stable timesteps, selective fidelity (adaptive across scales or simply hand-set), structure-aware solvers.

  • Completeness. No physics off limits: water, human animation, air flow, gravel, tendons, even body organs. Whatever the next use-case needs, the engine grows to cover it.

  • Fidelity. More realistic models: contact, friction, deformation, energy, actuation, materials…

  • Versatility. Extensible multi-physics without compromise on realism: all solvers in the scene coupled together at once, two-way and constraint-based. Write your own solver and it joins the scene like a native one, growing into an open solver ecosystem.

  • Scalability. From workstation to factory scale, and one day, city scale: thousands of interacting entities, batched across environments, without losing physical soundness.

Our ambition is to establish Genesis-World as the go-to simulator for physical AI, from companies and research labs to individuals.

The problems waiting for you

  • Every fidelity for every physics. The same physics at every point of the speed-accuracy spectrum, from heavily batched training with XPBD or VBD to final validation with IPC. Same scene, same API, pick your tradeoff.

  • Invent physics level-of-detail (LOD). Rendering has had LOD for decades, physics is still waiting. Simulate at full fidelity what agents interact with and see, coarsely what they do not.

  • Heterogeneous environments. Every parallel world can hold a completely different model: different bodies, joints, and collision geometries.

  • Adaptive timesteps per island. Error-based control with Runge-Kutta Dopri5, and Time-of-Impact stepping during collision detection, as done in Jiminy.

  • Couple everything, exactly. Efficient and accurate two-way constraint-based coupling between heterogeneous grey-box solvers, using state-of-the-art methods like ADMM. Owning every solver in the stack is what makes it possible.

  • More scalable constraint solvers. Push rigid constraint solving beyond its current scalability ceiling (reference).

  • Unify contact resolution. Hydro-elastic compliance, unilateral constraints, and sequential impulses in the same framework, ideally under one generic formulation.

  • Closed kinematic loops without constraints. Handle loops intrinsically for numerical stability and speed, in the spirit of Kamino.

Day to day: you write your physics in plain Python and Quadrants makes it fast on every backend. And you validate it the hard way: analytical closed forms, other engines, real-world data.

Who you are

You are a physicist and an engineer at once. You judge a method by whether it holds up in production at real scale, and you do not stop until it does. No blind spots: you relentlessly hunt down even the defect that looks insignificant, because it never is.

  • A strong background in physics-based simulation, preferably related to robotics: RBD, FEM, MPM, SPH, IPC, XPBD, VBD, ABD, plus constrained optimization and numerical integration of stiff systems.

  • A track record of shipping simulation code that others rely on, in an engine, in industry, or in a research codebase used beyond its authors.

  • Solid HPC programming (CPU and/or GPU), and an instinct for what makes a numerical method fast in practice, beyond complexity classes.

  • Rigor in validation: analytical closed forms, cross-engine consistency, real-world data.

Bonus points: publications in simulation, graphics, or robotics venues (SIGGRAPH, ICRA, IROS, CoRL, RSS). Contributions to an open-source physics engine.

The north star: physical AI that improves at the speed of compute.

The role

Simulation is still a hard sell in robotics. Outside a few success stories, like reinforcement learning for locomotion, most teams skip it, and friction is a big part of why: painful to use, painful to debug. We live that pain ourselves: debugging a failing experiment during policy evaluation takes 30 minutes, and there is no way to automatically generate a standalone reproduction script. That blocks adoption, even internally.

Your job is to kill that friction. You build the software engineering backbone of Genesis-World: everything that makes a large, fast-moving simulation codebase reliable, maintainable, frictionless. And it all ships in the open. Every hour of pain you remove, you remove for every roboticist who comes after you.

You join as core maintainer of Genesis-World, with shared stewardship of the whole platform from day one. Our physics team develops the algorithms, but just as importantly, you work to make everything around them excellent: infrastructure, tooling, APIs, architecture.

The problems waiting for you

  • Make testing of a JIT-compiled engine scalable. Running our full suite is already taking hours because the ratio between compile time and runtime can be as bad as x10. Getting rid of this bottleneck is a serious challenge that will require a joint effort from the Genesis-World and the compiler teams.

  • Make any bug reproducible. Dump and reload simulations bit-exactly, across machines, across backends, even when a single timestep of a batched simulation can already max out VRAM. Turn any failing run into a standalone reproduction script, automatically.

  • Make autodiff first-class. Genesis-World is differentiable today, but partially: memory-hungry, slower than it could be, and hard to maintain due to manual operation recording. The project spans the engine and the compiler: you drive the requirements on Quadrants and iterate in a tight loop with the compiler team until the integration is solid.

  • Edit scenes at frozen time. See the scene, move entities and robots around, iterate on layout, all without building the scene or compiling the engine. Authoring today means a full build cycle. Make it instant.

  • Make the simulator extensible. First-class plugins for physics solvers and interactive viewer backends, including Nyx. Sensors already work this way. Generalize it, and Genesis-World becomes a platform others build on.

  • Give robots real actuation. Motors and MIMO transmissions, cleanly abstracted at the interface between users and the physics engine.

  • Make time a local variable. Today the clock and the timestep are global to the engine, which forbids whole classes of speedups: environments cannot step independently, the timestep cannot adapt to the state, and individual solvers cannot advance at their own rate. Free the clock down to the sub-scene level and let the simulation fly.

  • Make scenes come alive. Events triggered by physics: press the button and the microwave door pops open, squeeze the trigger and the drill spins.

  • Keep the core sharp. Refactoring legacy subsystems, stronger typing, consistent coding style, less Python overhead on hot paths, full scene serialization, telemetry and replay.

The team:

You’ll join the Security Operations team, responsible for protecting Ledger’s corporate, cloud, SaaS, and data center environments. Its mission: to anticipate, detect, investigate, and respond to cyber threats—including monitoring, alert triage, incident response, detection, visibility, automation, exposure tracking, and continuous process improvement. The scope is distinct from that of the Donjon (product security): SecOps covers the operational security of internal environments, the cloud, endpoints, workloads, identities, and infrastructure.

As a close-knit and experienced team—technically demanding and committed to knowledge sharing—we’re also continuously building the SOC itself: integrating new log sources, ensuring data quality, expanding detection coverage, and developing reliable dashboards and operational workflows.

Our technical stack includes:

  • Splunk for SIEM, investigations, and dashboards;

  • CrowdStrike for EDR and endpoint/workload security;

  • Wiz for cloud security and exposure management;

  • Torq for SOAR and automation;

  • AWS, including modern environments such as EKS/Kubernetes;

  • An in-house developed Agentic SOC for alert enrichment, correlation, investigation support, reporting, and automation.

AI is at the heart of how we work: investing in AI applied to security is a strategic priority for Ledger this year. We’ve built our own in-house Agentic SOC, which autonomously investigates weak signals—the large volume of unreliable alerts that a human team couldn’t sort through manually—and enriches them, so our engineers can focus on what matters most and resolve incidents faster: high-quality detection, noise reduction, and accelerated investigations.

What you’ll be doing:

As a Staff Security Operations Engineer, you are the SecOps team’s top technical expert and our go-to authority on incident management. You lead the response to the most critical and complex incidents (CSIRT), spearhead proactive threat hunting, and define the detection and response strategy that the entire team relies on. Beyond day-to-day operations, you shape the architecture of our detection pipeline, SIEM, and automation—including the management of our internal Agentic SOC—and you establish the standards, playbooks, and methodologies that raise the technical bar for the entire team. Above all, you’re a builder: beyond design, you’ll build and actively evolve our systems—the Agentic SOC, the log pipeline, and automation—with a solid understanding of the underlying infrastructure. This is an expert role (individual contributor): your impact stems from your expertise, your judgment under pressure, and your influence.

Critical Incident Response (CSIRT)

  • Serve as the primary point of contact and coordinator for the most complex incidents across the cloud, corporate systems, endpoints, identities, and the data center.

  • Conduct end-to-end investigations: root cause analysis, forensics, timeline reconstruction, and remediation recommendations to prevent recurrence.

  • Serve as the team’s go-to expert in incident management, ensuring a rigorous and consistent approach to handling, escalating, and documenting incidents.

Detection Strategy & Threat Hunting

  • Define the team’s detection strategy, architecture, and methodology.

  • Lead proactive threat hunting by leveraging CTI and OSINT to identify and neutralize risks before they impact Ledger.

  • Address the most challenging and emerging detection issues, and translate threat intelligence into concrete improvements in security posture.

Architecture & Agentic SOC

  • Design and optimize the SIEM (Splunk) architecture and SOAR (Torq) workflows that underpin effective detection, triage, and response.

  • Bring our Splunk environment up to standard and state-of-the-art: data quality and standardization (CIM), data models, search performance, and detection governance.

  • Build, evolve, and own the architecture of our internal Agentic SOC and our log/data pipeline, and lead the automation of reporting for the SecOps team.

  • Apply deep expertise in cloud security (AWS, EKS/Kubernetes) and Wiz (CSPM/CNAPP) to harden the cloud and prioritize large-scale exposure.

Technical Leadership & Mentoring

  • Establish the standards, playbooks, and runbooks that the team relies on.

  • Mentor and foster the technical growth of senior and junior engineers, and act as a force multiplier within SecOps.

  • Work with the Engineering, Infrastructure, IT, and Cloud teams to align operational security with the organization’s objectives.

What we’re looking for:

  • 9+ years of experience in security operations, incident response, and CSIRT.

  • A strong track record as a technical expert in incident management, threat hunting, and detection engineering.

  • Comfortable working both as an individual contributor and as a team player in a fast-paced cloud and SaaS environment.

  • In-depth expertise in SIEM (ideally Splunk) and SOAR platforms, as well as CTI/OSINT methodologies.

  • Solid knowledge of AWS security (IAM, audit logs, network configurations, workloads, containers, Kubernetes) and cloud security tools (ideally Wiz, CSPM/CNAPP); experience with an EDR (ideally CrowdStrike).

  • Strong incident response and forensics skills, with the ability to conduct complex end-to-end investigations.

  • The ability to automate tasks and reporting using Python, Bash, APIs, GitHub Actions, a SOAR platform, or equivalent.

  • A solid understanding of infrastructure (cloud, networking, containers, CI/CD) and the ability to build and scale: log/data pipelines, integrations, and internal services.

jobs.title: Scientific Communication Manager
jobs.description:
Our Mission

Prose is truly custom hair and skin care made-to-order—just for you. Our line of custom products are made by an in-house, Paris-based R&D team of gifted chemists who combine natural ingredients in innovative ways alongside dermatologists, giving consumers clean skin care, hair care and impeccable results.

At the heart of Prose’s success is Singular, its proprietary AI-powered beauty-tech platform, which has revolutionized personalized beauty at scale. Marrying a technology-driven approach with an apothecary-style concept, all Prose hair and skin care products are personalized to your one-of-a-kind hair, skin, goals and environment.

We’re a company that wants to change beauty practices, so we’re changing the way beauty companies practice. As a certified B Corporation, a Public Benefit Corporation and Climate Neutral, we’re proving that good business is always sustainable. With Prose, there’s nothing sacrificed to bring you great products—not trees, materials, wages, or performance.

Prose & Singular in Numbers

  • Founded in 2017, with hubs in Paris, New York, and Los Angeles

  • 10M+ consultations completed

  • 2M customers and 350K active subscribers

  • 21M custom products made, with 1M+ unique formulas

  • 350+ team members across disciplines

  • $600M+ in lifetime sales, with $165M+ revenue in 2024

  • Profitable since 2024

Discover our Company Culture on Welcome to the Jungle here

Discover our Company Mission & Vision in video here

ABOUT THE ROLE

Prose is looking for a Scientific Communication Manager to shape the brand's scientific storytelling and claims strategy. Sitting at the intersection of R&D, Brand, Innovation and Digital Product, this person will be the driving force behind a stronger, sharper scientific culture at Prose - translating complex research into compelling, credible, and differentiating content, while ensuring every claim we make is substantiated.

This is a hands-on, high-visibility role for someone who is equal parts scientist, storyteller, and strategist. The role reports to the Director of Scientific Affairs & Sustainability within the Prose Science Team.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

SCIENTIFIC COMMUNICATION STRATEGY

  • Shape Prose's global scientific communication strategy, aligned with brand positioning and priorities.

  • Establish the narrative structure and tone of voice that define our scientific authority across the key communication territories and ingredients that set us apart

  • Translate ingredient information and product testing data into clear, engaging narratives and claims

  • Act as a creative catalyst on new ingredients, technology, and testing communication opportunities.

TECHNICAL & CLAIMS DOSSIERS

  • Review and approve final test results, providing technical interpretation in collaboration with partner teams.

  • Build and maintain robust technical and scientific dossiers for new product launches and renovations (literature reviews, scientific territories, active ingredients, performance test results).

  • Support the preparation of oral presentations, posters, and peer-reviewed articles when relevant.

SCIENTIFIC & COMPETITIVE INTELLIGENCE

  • Maintain active scientific and competitive watch to identify new technology, ingredients, communication territories (longevity, exposome, microbiome…) and claims opportunities.

  • Prospect new raw materials, biological targets, and technologies through supplier relationships (in partnership with the R&D team) and competitive/technical intelligence.

  • Stay at the forefront of cosmetic trends, both from a marketing and a scientific standpoint, to provide marketing teams with structuring and differentiating strategic input.

SCIENTIFIC CULTURE & CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION

  • Infuse a strong scientific culture across the organization - building dialogue and proximity between science and non-scientific teams.

  • Partner closely with R&D, Marketing, CX and Digital Product to ensure product claims and launch concepts are scientifically accurate and consistent, review all the communications assets and supports and answer ad hoc scientific and technical questions to support their day-to-day work

  • Work closely with the Evaluation team to coordinate clinical, instrumental, and consumer testing, and help design differentiating, creative claims approaches.

  • Partner with regulatory affairs to ensure substantiation needs are met and test platforms address all product claims.

  • Effectively articulate highly technical or complex scientific concepts to audiences with varying levels of scientific literacy.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Strong scientific/technical background (cosmetic science, dermatology, biology, or related field), with the ability to move fluidly between deep science and brand storytelling.

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in scientific communication, claims substantiation, or R&D-marketing liaison roles, ideally in beauty/cosmetics or a related regulated industry.

  • Strong appetite for AI tools and agentic AI, with a genuine curiosity for experimenting with several AI-amplified projects

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English (French a plus, given cross-team collaboration).

  • A creative thinker who challenges the status quo and looks for differentiating angles, not just correct ones.

  • Solution- and business-oriented mindset - resourceful in finding answers when data isn't readily available.

  • Comfortable as both a strategic thinker and a hands-on doer; flexible and able to adapt to shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • A natural team player and cross-functional leader, able to build trust with scientific and non-scientific stakeholders alike.

  • Rigorous, tenacious, results-oriented, with strong project management skills.

Prose Values

Intentional Inclusivity

  • We know the best ideas come from open minds and willingness to listen. While our products cater to the individual, an invitation into our process is always open to our community.

  • We value our differences and diverse backgrounds by communicating openly, managing with transparency and striving to understand one another’s perspective. It’s a key ingredient to our innovation.

Connected Collaboration

  • Our strength as a group will outlast our efforts as individual contributors. With offices across countries, staying inventive and agile deepens our clear vision and consistent communication.

  • We stay in a spirit of entrepreneurial collaboration: We do not have consensus at all times, but we trust one another to work toward our common goals. Our success is an expression and result of our progressive and gratifying teamwork.

Driven, Together

  • We value ownership and coaching that encourages employees to think constructively and creatively about the business. We view employees as leaders and individuals who are accountable, resourceful and responsible. Anyone and everyone is encouraged to lead.

  • We recognize that in order to continue thinking one step ahead, we will need to try new things. We strive to provide an open environment that accepts this truth, making space for new ideas to emerge.

Humanity Always

  • We assume good intentions in every interaction, keeping ourselves accountable for the climate we create. We seek to understand our co-workers through this lens of conscious benevolence, authenticity and fellowship.

  • We operate with the intention of preserving resources, creating an environment we can all live in – for our business and the world. Sustainable care is essential to our ethos as an organization. We take a mindful approach to how we think about our people (employees) and our planet.

Compensation: €50K – €70K
