jobs.title: Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
KEY ACCOUNT MANAGER

Vald. BIRN A/S in Holstebro is looking for a technically qualified and commercially focused Key Account Manager for its sales of high quality cast iron solutions.

THE POSITION

In order to consolidate and expand our sales activities, we need to strengthen our sales team by recruiting a qualified Key Account Manager.

You will be given responsibility for strategically important customers, all of which are market-leading OEMs or system providers, including those in the truck sector. Your role will be to expand and enhance the sales turnover among existing customers, while at the same time cultivating new customer relationships. A significant part of the role also involves making sustained efforts to secure up-to-date framework agreements and contracts in addition to communicating customer requirements and expectations.

The sales process consists of offering to produce the customers’ cast iron components. Once the items are being produced, the sales work will involve continuously negotiating and adjusting the sales prices of the individual components, as well as negotiating and maintaining other commercial conditions. These conditions include packaging, logistics solutions, framework agreements for quality and delivery, and aftermarket terms.

Your normal working day will vary from administrative tasks at the office in Holstebro, where you will work closely with Production, the Production Engineering Department (PED), Business Controlling and other company stakeholders. You will also be responsible for planning and conducting your external customer visits, primarily in Europe where you can expect up to around 50 days’ travelling per year. You will also help with and prepare data and presentations for sales meetings and trade fair attendance, as well as continuously reporting to Sales Management.

As part of a cross-organisational partnership, you will familiarise yourself with the customers’ projects and thus become the most important link of the contact between the customer and your colleagues across the entire organisation.

When out visiting customers with a view to sales, you will always have a ‘One Stop Shop’ cast iron solution to call upon. By this, we mean that BIRN is able to cast, machine, assemble and surface-treat the products so that they can be delivered directly to the customer’s production line or application without further processing. This is both efficient and sustainable.

Are you looking to combine your technical curiosity and skills with a strategic responsibility for sales and long-term customer relationships in an international industrial group? If so, you may be the person we are looking for as a Key Account Manager.

YOUR DUTIES

You will be given a central role in the sales organisation, with your work including the following:

  • Responsibility for and the continued development of a portfolio of four to six major strategic customers in Europe, primarily in Scandinavia. You will be responsible for a turnover of at least € 25 million
  • Building up long-term relationships with the customers’ stakeholders in the fields of purchasing, development, quality and logistics
  • Technical and commercial advice during the customers’ development and project phases
  • Planning and conducting customer visits, contract and price negotiations and major framework agreements
  • Ongoing budget monitoring, forecasts and sales reports at customer level
  • Searching for, analysing and developing new customer potentials and market segments
  • Close internal collaboration with production engineering, quality, controlling and finance
  • Participation in sales and strategy activities across the organisation

The position involves some travel, primarily in Europe.

QUALIFICATIONS

We expect you to have the following:

  • Extensive advanced technical training/experience, ideally supplemented with commercial skills, e.g. engineer, marine engineer or equivalent. A skilled trade background, supplemented by commercial training or experience, is another option
  • Experience of technical sales, project sales or Key Account Management; alternatively, you will have been recently trained and have the right level of drive. The start date will be adapted to suit the right candidate
  • The ability to thrive in an outward-facing role with extensive customer contact, and to plan your day-to-day work independently
  • The ability to work in a structured manner on CRM, budgets, documentation and monitoring. You will need to be skilled in using digital tools, for processing both text and numbers
  • The ability to communicate without difficulty in English and, preferably, also in Danish – and, ideally, in the other Scandinavian languages
  • The technical flair and ability to get to grips with the customers’ business and applications
  • A passenger car driving licence and a valid passport with no travel restrictions

At a personal level, you will be skilled in relationships, persistent and curious, with the motivation to create value through collaboration based on trust and a high level of professionalism.

WHAT WE OFFER

You will become part of Vald. BIRN A/S, a solid and internationally represented industrial enterprise with strong values and a high degree of professionalism. In addition, you will receive:

  • A central, independent role with a high level of influence on customers, sales and commercial development
  • A strong professional environment with close collaboration across the Group
  • Thorough on-boarding and training in products, markets and the organisation
  • Good opportunities for both professional and personal development
  • Attractive terms and conditions of employment, including a pension scheme and health insurance
  • A good canteen scheme and active staff association
  • An informal work environment that focuses on well-being, responsibility and sustainability

ABOUT THE BIRN GROUP

Vald. BIRN A/S in Holstebro is the Group Headquarters of one of Northern Europe’s largest foundry Groups. We supply highly processed cast iron components to the truck industry and others, as well as industrial hydraulics and machine components. Sustainability, the circular economy and responsibility are integral parts of our DNA. The Group employs around 750 staff, of which around 480 are in Holstebro.

APPLICATIONS

If you have any questions about the position or the BIRN Group, please feel free to contact Group CSO Peter Frost Jepsen on tel. +45 3016 0160 or Group HR Manager Morten Madsen on tel. +45 3016 0115.

Please note that we are processing applications on a continuous basis and will close the position once we have found the right candidate. As mentioned above, the start date can be adjusted to suit the right candidate. Please submit your application via our recruitment system, which you will find at [insert link]. Candidates who proceed to a second interview can expect to complete a personality profile as part of the process.

We would encourage all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity or age, to apply for the position.

jobs.title: Car Registration Specialist
jobs.description:
Car Registration Specialist

Location: Stockholm

About the us

Green SM is a leading electric vehicle (EV) and sustainable mobility solutions provider headquartered in Vietnam. With a commitment to transforming urban transportation, we have successfully expanded into the Global Market and are now preparing to launch operations in the EU Market. Join us in driving the future of sustainable mobility.



Website: Green SM - Electric Mobility Service, 5-Star Quality | Green SM



Position Overview

The Car Registration Specialist is responsible for supporting the end-to-end vehicle registration process to ensure GSM Europe’s EV fleet is legally ready for operation in the local market. This role will coordinate documentation, registration applications, insurance confirmation, license plates, and related administrative procedures to ensure vehicles are ready for deployment on time.

Key Responsibilities

    Support vehicle registration processes for GSM Denmark EV fleet across assigned markets
    Prepare and manage registration documents including CoC, vehicle titles, customs, insurance, and compliance paperwork
    Coordinate with transport authorities, registration offices, and external agencies to ensure legal compliance
    Monitor local EV regulations, registration requirements, tax incentives, and subsidy policies
    Execute and track bulk vehicle registrations to support operational launch timelines
    Follow vehicle status from delivery through license plate issuance and road readiness
    Coordinate with insurance providers and external partners to resolve registration issues and documentation gaps
    Manage license plate distribution, vehicle records, and fleet administration processes including deregistration and ownership transfer
    Collaborate closely with Logistics, Fleet Operations, Insurance, and local teams to ensure timely “Ready-to-Drive” vehicle deployment



Requirements

    Bachelor's degree in business administration, Logistics, Automotive, or related fields.
    2–4 years of experience in vehicle registration, fleet administration, leasing operations, logistics administration, or related fields.
    Understanding local vehicle registration processes and administrative requirements.
    Familiarity with electric vehicles, vehicle imports, or EV-related documentation is an advantage.
    Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple documents and cases at the same time.
    Good coordination skills with authorities, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
    Professional fluency in the local language and English.

Why Join GSM

    Be part of the founding European setup team and grow with us as we expand
    Backed by Vietnam's largest company, with the growth trajectory of a fast-scaling European startup
    Real decision-making authority with tangible, visible impact
    Learn alongside counterparts across other markets

jobs.title: Apulaispäällikkö, Prisma Iisalmi
jobs.description:
Primary location:
IISALMI

Haemme apulaispäällikköä Iisalmen Prismaan
Kiinnostaako sinua käytännönläheinen apulaispäällikön tehtävä käyttötavarakaupan arjessa? Tässä tehtävässä pääset tukemaan osaston päivittäistä tekemistä, hyvää asiakaskokemusta ja tiimin onnistumista yhdessä päällikön kanssa.

Työsuhde on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen. Aloitus mahdollisimman pian.

Prisma Iisalmi palvelee asiakkaita monipuolisesti arjen ostoksissa ja käyttötavaroissa. Käyttötavaraosastolla onnistuminen syntyy hyvästä asiakaspalvelusta, houkuttelevista esillepanoista, sujuvasta tekemisestä ja hyvästä yhteistyöstä.

Apulaispäällikkönä toimit päällikön tukena käyttötavaraosaston päivittäisessä johtamisessa. Varmistat osaltasi, että asiakaspalvelu, hyllyt, esillepanot ja myynnillinen tekeminen toimivat arjessa sujuvasti. Työhösi kuuluu myös käytännön tekemistä osastolla, tiimin perehdyttämistä, ohjaamista ja valmentamista, palautteen antamista sekä tavoitteiden seuraamista ja toiminnan kehittämistä. Toimit aktiivisena viestijänä tiimin, vuorojen ja päällikön välillä sekä päällikön sijaisena tämän poissa ollessa. Näin viet PeeÄssän arvoja ja Parhaan Elämän Edelläkävijä Savossa -tavoitetta käytäntöön hyvän asiakaskokemuksen ja tiimin onnistumisen kautta.

Tämä tehtävä sopii sinulle, jos sinulla on:
- valmius tehdä töitä eri kellonaikoihin asiakasvirtojen mukaan, myös juhlapyhinä
- toimeenpanokykyä, rohkeutta ja ratkaisukeskeistä otetta
- kokemusta vähittäis- ja käyttötavarakaupasta – S-ryhmän järjestelmien tuntemus katsotaan eduksi
- kiinnostusta myynnilliseen tekemiseen, arjen sujuvoittamiseen ja toiminnan kehittämiseen
- sujuva suomen kielen taito, hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot sekä halua innostaa, ohjata ja tehdä yhteistyötä tiimin kanssa
- aktiivista otetta oman osaamisen ja yksikön toiminnan kehittämiseen
- halua toimia arvojemme #tunteella, #toimeliaasti, #ylpeästi ja #yhdessä mukaisesti sekä viedä asiakaslupauksiamme käytäntöön arjen tekemisessä.

Miksi hakea tätä tehtävää?
- pääset tekemään monipuolista ja käytännönläheistä työtä Iisalmen Prisman käyttötavaraosastolla
- työssä yhdistyvät asiakaspalvelu, myynnillinen tekeminen, esillepanot ja osaston päivittäinen sujuvuus
- saat tehdä merkityksellistä työtä, jossa oma kädenjälkesi näkyy asiakkaiden arjessa ja tiimin onnistumisessa
- saat tueksesi päällikön, tiimin ja selkeät toimintamallit, joiden avulla pääset hyvin kiinni apulaispäällikön tehtävään
- käytössäsi ovat monipuoliset, koko Suomen kattavat henkilöstöedut sekä liikunnan ja hyvinvoinnin Epassi-edut. Voit tutustua PeeÄssän henkilöstöetuihin tarkemmin tästä.

Palkkaus
Tehtävän palkkaus määräytyy Kaupan työehtosopimuksen C-palkkaluokan mukaan. Palkka on aiemmasta työkokemuksesta riippuen 2 233–2 572 €/kk. Lisäksi maksetaan työryhmän kokoon perustuvaa lisää kulloinkin voimassa olevan maksuperusteen mukaisesti. Työryhmän nykyisen koon perusteella lisä on tällä hetkellä 2 %. Tehtävässä maksetaan myös TES:n mukaiset lisät toteutuneiden työtuntien mukaan.

Tämän lisäksi sinulla on mahdollisuus ansaita vuosittaista tulospalkkaa Osuuskauppa PeeÄssässä kulloinkin voimassa olevan tulospalkkausjärjestelmän mukaisesti.

Työtä kuvataan usein korulauseilla, mutta meidän mielestämme tavallisuudessa ei ole mitään pahaa. Me Osuuskauppa PeeÄssällä sanomme olevamme ihan tavallisissa töissä - eikä se tarkoita tylsää porukkaa, päinvastoin. Työ on hyvää ja sujuvaa arkea, jossa teemme myös muiden arjesta - ja välillä juhlastakin - vähän parempaa. Ja joskus juhlitaan itsekin. Jos työpaikkailmoitusten kliseet kyllästyttävät, tule meille ihan tavallisiin töihin.

Jos ihan tavallinen työ hyvässä porukassa kuulostaa sinun jutultasi, hae mukaan jo tänään!

Hakuaikaa on 4.10.2026 saakka, mutta laitathan hakemuksesi tulemaan jo hyvissä ajoin. Aloitamme haastattelut hakuaikana ja täytämme paikan sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Prisma Iisalmen palvelu- ja myyntipäällikkö Asta Kalanti, asta.kalanti@sok.fi, puh. 044 719 7305 arkisin klo 8–16.

Osuuskauppa PeeÄssä on yli 134 000 asiakasomistajan omistama palvelualan yritys Pohjois-Savossa. Tavoitteenamme on olla Parhaan Elämän Edelläkävijä Savossa. Meille se tarkoittaa merkityksellistä työtä, reilua työnantajuutta ja arjen sujuvuutta. Olemme ylpeitä siitä, että voimme tuottaa osuustoiminnallista hyötyä ja kehittää sitä jatkuvasti arvojemme mukaisesti: #tunteella, #toimeliaasti, #ylpeästi ja #yhdessä.

jobs.title: Tiler
jobs.description:
The duties of a waterproofer and tiler include a wide range of wet-room and tiling work in both new-build and renovation projects. Work areas include bathrooms, toilets, saunas, utility rooms, kitchens, and other interior and exterior spaces requiring tiling.

The duties include:

- Reviewing construction drawings and work instructions

- Protecting the work area and inspecting the condition of the substrate

- Removing old tiles, waterproofing membranes, and other surface materials when necessary

- Cleaning, sanding, levelling, and straightening wall and floor surfaces

- Checking floor slopes and correcting them when necessary

- Applying primers and preparing surfaces

- Waterproofing wet rooms in accordance with the system manufacturers instructions

- Carefully sealing corners, penetrations, joints, and floor drains

- Measuring, planning, setting out, and installing wall and floor tiles

- Cutting, drilling, and fitting tiles

- Preparing and applying tile adhesive

- Grouting tiled surfaces and applying silicone sealant

- Epoxy grouting and other specialist grouting when required

- Cleaning, finishing, and protecting completed surfaces


The work involves handling various types of tiles, including ceramic tiles, clinker tiles, mosaics, and natural-stone tiles. The employee must be able to use the materials, machinery, tools, and equipment required for waterproofing and tiling work.

The position requires care, precision, high-quality workmanship, and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team. The employee must be able to read construction drawings, take the necessary measurements, follow site schedules, and comply with material manufacturers installation instructions.

Haemme innostunutta ja osaavaa sairaanhoitajaa liittymään iloiseen joukkoomme.

Työpaikkanasi toimii viihtyisä Iltalan hoivakoti Espoon Viherlaaksossa hyvien kulkuyhteyksien varrella. Meillä on 60-asiakaspaikkaa ja tarjoamme ympärivuorokautista tehostettua palveluasumista kodinomaisessa ympäristössä.

Työkulttuurissamme korostuvat avoimuus ja positiivisuus sekä elämänmakuinen arki. Haluamme tarjota asiakkaillemme turvallisen ja hyvän hoidon rauhallisessa ilmapiirissä huomioimalla heidän fyysiset, psyykkiset, sosiaaliset ja hengelliset perustarpeensa. Tuemme asiakkaidemme omatoimisuutta sekä kunnioitamme heidän yksilöllisyyttään ja itsemääräämisoikeuttaan. Laadukkaan perushoivan lisäksi tarjoamme heille monipuolista aktiviteettia sisällä ja ulkona.

Sairaanhoitajien lisäksi Iltalassa työskentelee fysioterapeutti, lähihoitajia, hoiva-avustajia, keittiötyöntekijöitä, laitoshuoltajia ja pesulatyöntekijä, jolloin voimme tarjota sinulle mahdollisuuden keskittyä hoitotyöhön. Iltalassa panostamme työhyvinvointiin ja työssäjaksamiseen.

Sairaanhoitajanamme työskentelet osana vastaavan sairaanhoitajan luotsaamaa tiimiä. Työpäiväsi koostuvat asiakkaidemme tarvitsemasta perushoivasta, lääkehoidosta ja tarvittaessa myös sairaanhoidollisista tehtävistä huolehtimisesta sekä osaston mielekkään arjen kehittämisestä ja toteuttamisesta. Sairaanhoitaja toimii myös omahoitajana, jonka vastuualueisiin kuuluvat RAI-toimintakykyarvioinneista, asiakassuunnitelmista sekä läheisyhteistyöstä huolehtiminen. Loma-aikoina ja tarvittaessa sijaistat myös osaston vastaavaa sairaanhoitajaa.

**Odotamme sinulta:**

- sairaanhoitajan tutkintoa

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager, Embedded Solutions
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Project Manager to join Etteplan!

In this role, you will lead large embedded systems projects for our industrial customers. We help our customers succeed in their R&D, productization and in every phase of their projects from requirements to final delivery. Our diverse range of clients and projects across different industries lets you build broad experience and grow your career. You will work at the center of multidisciplinary teams, balancing technical scope, schedule, and budget while keeping the customer relationship strong throughout the project.

As a Senior Project Manager at Etteplan your work includes:

·leading large, complex embedded systems projects across their full lifecycle

·planning and managing scope, schedule, budget and risk

·building and coordinating multidisciplinary project teams

·acting as the primary point of contact for customer stakeholders

·reporting project status and escalating risks to internal and customer management

·contributing to presales and proposal work for new embedded projects

The position is based in Finland, the location preferably being Espoo or Tampere.



Who are we looking for?

·You have several years of experience managing large embedded system projects, ideally in an industrial or product-development context

·You have strong interpersonal and leadership skills and can guide multidisciplinary technical teams towards a shared goal

·You are familiar with embedded systems development practices and can speak credibly with both engineers and customer executives

·You have a solid grasp of project management methods (agile, stage-gate, or hybrid) and tools

·You are comfortable owning schedule, budget and risk on projects of significant scale

·You have an applicable educational background, such as a degree in engineering or a related technical field

·Good written and spoken Finnish and English skills are required



Interested?

Please send your application through our recruitment system as soon as possible. We review applications already during the application period.

At Etteplan we ensure that your compensation is fair and transparent. Your salary reflects your competencies and contributions, in line with our way of working. For this role, the typical monthly salary is 5400-6600€/month, depending on your background.

We encourage applications from all qualified candidates who have the legal right to work in the EU. Please note that Etteplan does not currently provide visa sponsorship or work permit sponsorship for this role.

Aaltovoima Lapland Chef Academy

17–18 October 2026 | Helsinki | 10:00–17:00

Aaltovoima Pohjoinen is organising the Aaltovoima Lapland Chef Academy – a free, two-day intensive training programme where you can develop your professional skills under the guidance of top-level professionals and build a concrete pathway towards seasonal work in Lapland.

Top-level trainers

jobs.title: Lille selvejende institution søger pædagog
jobs.description:
Har du lyst til at arbejde et sted, hvor du ikke bare er medarbejder, men en vigtig del af huset?

Så kom til Børnehuset Bellis.

Vi er et lille, hyggeligt og selvejende børnehus i København NV med en grøn legeplads, masser af god stemning og en hverdag, hvor der er kort fra idé til handling og stor mulighed for indflydelse. Her kender vi hinanden, ledelsen er tæt på, og der er plads til, at du kan være dig selv og til, at dine idéer kan blive til virkelighed.

Vi søger en pædagog på 37 timer om ugen til et barselsvikariat med mulighed for fastansættelse. Stillingen ønskes besat 1. oktober 2026 eller snarest derefter. Vi søger også en fast pædagog fra 1. november 2026.

Et lille hus med store muligheder
Som selvejende institution har vi stor mulighed for selv at forme vores hverdag, pædagogik og traditioner. Vi har en aktiv forældrebestyrelse, som har reel indflydelse på børnehusets udvikling.

Det betyder blandt andet:
  • Kort vej fra idé til beslutning.
  • Stor medindflydelse på institutionens hverdag og udvikling.
  • Tæt samarbejde mellem medarbejdere, ledelse og bestyrelse.
  • Sundhedsforsikring til alle ansatte.
  • Større indflydelse på ferieplanlægningen.
  • Mulighed for at præge pædagogikken og skabe nye idéer.
  • En tæt og nærværende ledelse.

Hvem er vi?
Børnehuset Bellis er et hyggeligt hus med en dejlig grøn legeplads. Vi ligger tæt på skolehaverne, gode legepladser og grønne områder, som vi ofte bruger i hverdagen.

Vi har én vuggestuegruppe og to børnehavegrupper, normeret til 52 børn og fordi vi er et lille hus, kender børn og voksne hinanden på tværs.

Vi er optagede af at følge børnenes spor, skabe tryghed og gode rammer for leg, læring, udvikling og dannelse. Vi lægger vægt på en hverdag præget af nærvær, humor, omsorg og et stærkt kollegaskab.

Du skal søge hos os, hvis du:
  • Får energi af at arbejde med en mangfoldig børnegruppe.
  • Er nysgerrig og har lyst til at nytænke og udvikle.
  • Gerne vil arbejde i en selvejende institution med ledelsen tæt på.
  • Har lyst til at være en del af et engageret arbejdsfællesskab med fokus på børnenes trivsel, udvikling og dannelse.
  • Er god til struktur og organisering.
  • Værdsætter et godt og tæt forældresamarbejde.
  • Kan udarbejde handleplaner og omsætte dem til praksis.
  • Er mødestabil og tager ansvar for fællesskabet.

Måske har du flere års erfaring og masser af idéer med i bagagen. Måske er du nyuddannet og kommer med friske øjne, gåpåmod og lyst til at prøve dig selv af.

Begge dele er vi interesserede i.

Det vigtigste for os er, at du har lyst til at være en aktiv del af et lille hus, hvor vi løfter i fællesskab.

Kom gerne på besøg
Du er meget velkommen til at ringe og aftale et besøg – også inden du sender din ansøgning. Vi vil gerne møde dig og vise dig, hvem vi er.

Kontakt leder, Marlene på tlf. 5210 2120.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Controller Financial Planning and Analysis
jobs.description:
Company description:

At NKT in Karlskrona, we develop and manufacture high voltage power cables that enable the transition to renewable energy. Here, you will be part of an international engineering centre with advanced high voltage test halls, modern cable production and the cable laying vessel NKT Victoria. As Connectors, we collaborate to develop innovative technology that connects a greener and more sustainable world. NKT is headquartered in Denmark and operates in more than 30 countries.NKT - We connect a greener world. www.NKT.com.

Job description:

Support financial performance in a growing global business



Do you want to play a key role in supporting strategic decision-making and financial performance in a global organization contributing to the energy transition? As Controller Financial Planning and Analysis, you will join a Finance Controlling team in Karlskrona, supporting the global Grid Solutions business line.







This is an exciting opportunity to work close to management, contribute to business decisions through financial insights, and contribute to a growing international organization delivering solutions that enable the expansion of renewable energy infrastructure worldwide.







Support strategic decisions through financial insight



As Controller Financial Planning and Analysis, you will be part of a global FP & A team supporting financial planning, performance management and reporting across the Grid Solutions hubs. Working closely with management, Shared Service Center teams and stakeholders across the organization, you will provide financial transparency and valuable insights that support both strategic and operational decisions.







Key responsibilities include:




    Contribute to strategic and operational financial planning activities
    Forecasting, budgeting, month-end closing and reporting processes
    Analyze financial performance and provide recommendations to management
    Ensure compliance with IFRS, internal controls and group standards
    Support financial statements, audits and tax-related activities







The position is based in Karlskrona and is part of the FP & A and Finance Controlling organization supporting the global Grid Solutions business line. Collaboration with international stakeholders is an important part of the role.







Controller who brings a business perspective



You are a collaborative and structured professional who thrives in an international environment. Curious and engaged, you combine solid analytical and communication skills with a genuine interest in the business. You navigate complexity with ease, build trusted relationships and turn insights into practical improvements.







Key qualifications




    Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration or a related field
    Minimum five years of FP & A or controlling experience in a corporate environment
    Knowledge of planning, forecasting, budgeting and financial reporting processes
    Proficiency in SAP, OneStream, BI tools and advanced Excel
    Fluent Swedish and English skills, both written and spoken







Shape business performance in a global growth journey



NKT is committed to creating a diverse workplace and an environment where individuals from many backgrounds can thrive and bring their best work forward. We believe that a diverse organization enables sustainable performance, and that an inclusive and welcoming culture makes for a better place to work.





At NKT, you can advance your career in an international team-oriented environment where your efforts contribute to important outcomes. You will collaborate closely with business and finance leaders across several countries, gain wide-ranging exposure to strategic and operational finance, and expand your capabilities in financial planning, controlling, and business partnering. As part of a company supporting the expansion of renewable energy infrastructure, you will contribute to projects that help shape a more sustainable future.







"As a leader, I believe in empowering people through trust, collaboration and continuous development. In this role, you will have the opportunity to help shape important business decisions, work with skilled colleagues around the world and develop both professionally and personally," says Hiring Manager, Lotta Bergman.







Read more about our offer and listen to some voices of NKT Connectors here!







We will review applications continuously, but we recommend you apply no later than 2026-10-13. Be aware that personality and cognitive tests might be included in the recruitment process.  







Be a Connector of the green tomorrow!

jobs.title: Ingénieur Commercial IT - Cloud, Infrastructure & Cybersécurité (H/F)
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Consultant Senior Cybersecurity Governance - Cloud & IT Resilience (H/F)
jobs.description:
act digital est un groupe international de conseil et d'ingénierie qui accompagne ses clients dans leurs projets de transformation numérique.

Présent dans 12 pays et fort de plus de 5 600 collaborateurs, nous mettons nos expertises au service de leurs enjeux en développement logiciel, cybersécurité, data, cloud et IA.

Notre ambition : devenir le partenaire technologique de confiance des entreprises les plus innovantes, en concevant et sécurisant des systèmes qui renforcent leur performance et leur résilience.

Rejoindre act digital France, c'est intégrer une organisation agile et engagée, qui fait avancer les projets avec ses clients pour transformer les idées en résultats concrets, avec pragmatisme et exigence.

Le poste :

Vous intégrerez, au sein de notre Pôle Cybersécurité, une équipe dédiée à l'accompagnement de nos clients sur des missions de gouvernance, de gestion des risques et de définition de cadres de référence SSI. Vous serez détaché(e) auprès d'un acteur majeur du secteur bancaire, au sein d'une organisation internationale en charge de définir et de faire évoluer les exigences cybersécurité applicables aux différentes entités du Groupe. Dans ce contexte, nous recherchons un profil expérimenté en gouvernance cybersécurité, disposant de solides connaissances sur les sujets IT Continuity, IT Resilience, Backup & Restore et Cloud Security, capable de contribuer à la formalisation et à l'évolution des exigences et procédures Groupe.

Vos missions seront les suivantes :
- Contribuer à la rédaction, à la révision et à la structuration des exigences cybersécurité et procédures Groupe sur les sujets IT Continuity, IT Resilience, Backup & Restore et Cloud Security
- Accompagner les travaux de Cloud Security et contribuer à l'interprétation ainsi qu'à l'application des exigences de sécurité et de continuité dans les environnements Cloud
- Prendre en compte les différents modèles de services Cloud (IaaS, PaaS, CaaS et SaaS) ainsi que les modèles de responsabilités partagées entre le Groupe et les Cloud Service Providers
- Contribuer à la définition des exigences relatives aux enjeux de continuité, de résilience, de sauvegarde, de restauration, de due diligence et de réversibilité dans les environnements Cloud
- Participer aux travaux de gouvernance cybersécurité : analyse des besoins, formalisation des livrables, préparation des supports de décision et suivi des actions
- Animer et faciliter des workshops en anglais avec les différentes entités et fonctions du Groupe afin de cadrer les attendus, partager les livrables et recueillir les retours opérationnels
- Contribuer à l'alignement des exigences avec les cadres de référence cybersécurité, les bonnes pratiques de continuité et de résilience IT ainsi que les exigences réglementaires applicables

Profil recherché :

Quel profil pour ce poste :
- Vous êtes issu(e) d'une formation Bac+5 (École d'ingénieur, Université ou équivalent) en informatique, cybersécurité ou gestion des risques
- Vous justifiez d'une expérience confirmée dans des fonctions de gouvernance cybersécurité, de définition d'exigences, de standards ou de procédures SSI
- Vous disposez d'une expérience significative sur les problématiques de continuité et de résilience des systèmes d'information, idéalement complétée par une connaissance des environnements Cloud
- Vous avez déjà évolué dans un environnement complexe et transverse, impliquant de nombreux interlocuteurs techniques, cybersécurité, risques et métiers
- Vous accordez de l'importance à la rigueur, à la qualité rédactionnelle et à la structuration des livrables
- Vous disposez d'une bonne capacité de synthèse, d'autonomie et êtes à l'aise dans l'animation de workshops avec des interlocuteurs internationaux

Quelles compétences/connaissances pour ce poste :
- Solides connaissances des problématiques IT Continuity, IT Resilience, PRA/PCA et des principes de continuité des systèmes d'information
- Bonne compréhension des stratégies de Backup & Restore, incluant les principes de sauvegarde, restauration, tests et exigences associées
- Connaissance des environnements Cloud et des modèles de services IaaS, PaaS, CaaS et SaaS
- Compréhension des modèles de responsabilités partagées entre les organisations et les Cloud Service Providers
- Expérience dans la rédaction d'exigences cybersécurité, standards, politiques et procédures SSI
- Connaissance des problématiques de sécurité, de continuité, de réversibilité et de gestion des risques dans les environnements Cloud
- Bonne compréhension des cadres de référence et bonnes pratiques cybersécurité
- Anglais courant impératif

jobs.title: Rengøringsplanlægger med stærke data- og analysekompetencer til Rigshospitalets Rengøringsafdeling
jobs.description:
Vil du være med til at sikre datadrevet planlægning i en af Danmarks største og mest komplekse rengøringsorganisationer?

Rengøringsafdelingen på Rigshospitalet søger en engageret og analytisk stærk rengøringsplanlægger til en tidsbegrænset stilling frem til 31. december 2027.

Du får en central rolle i arbejdet med at kvalitetssikre og udvikle afdelingens planlægningsgrundlag gennem anvendelse af Data Know How (DKH). Dine analyser og planlægningsopgaver skal understøtte vigtige strategiske beslutninger om bemanding, økonomi og arbejdsmetoder i afdelingen.

Om stillingen

Som rengøringsplanlægger bliver du en vigtig del af afdelingens udviklingsarbejde. Du skal opbygge og vedligeholde rengøringsplaner og, i tæt samarbejde med dine kolleger, sikre valide data som bidrag til et solidt beslutningsgrundlag for ledelsen.

Du skal være opmærksom på at oprydning af eksisterende planer og i DKH, kan forekomme.

Stillingen har særlig betydning i forbindelse med:

  • Planlægning og prissætning af rengøringsopgaver
  • Sammenholde instruktioner med tider i DKH
  • Understøttelse af afdelingens økonomiske prioriteringer
  • Implementering og anvendelse af CSL
  • Medvirke til at CSL og DKH bygger på samme logikker
  • Udvikling af arbejdsplaner og normeringer i forbindelse med ændringer i hospitalets fysiske rammer og byggeprojekter, sammen med ledere og medarbejdere
Du refererer til Souschef Anette Melkjorsen og arbejder tæt sammen med afdelingens ledere og administrative medarbejdere på begge matrikler (Østerbro og Glostrup), og du vil primært have base på Østerbro.

Dine primære opgaver

  • Vedligeholde, analysere og kvalitetssikre data i DKH
  • Udarbejde og optimere rengøringsplaner og normeringer
  • Sikre sammenhæng mellem datagrundlag, normering og drift
  • Udarbejde analyser, rapporter og beslutningsoplæg til ledelsen
  • Bidrage til implementering af nye planlægningsværktøjer og arbejdsgange
  • Sparre med ledergruppen omkring opgaveplanlægning, normering og data fra DKH
  • Medvirke til udviklingsprojekter og organisationsforandringer
  • Oplære og vejlede ledere og medarbejdere i anvendelsen af planlægningsværktøjer
Vi søger dig, som

  • Har indgående kendskab til Data Know How (DKH)
  • Har erfaring med planlægning og ressourceoptimering
  • Har stærke analytiske kompetencer og arbejder datadrevet
  • Er fortrolig med Excel
  • Kan omsætte komplekse data til praktiske løsninger
  • Arbejder struktureret og har fokus på kvalitet og detaljer
  • Trives i samarbejde med mange forskellige faggrupper og kulturer
  • Kommunikerer tydeligt både mundtligt og skriftligt
  • Har forståelse for økonomi, budgetter og normering
Erfaring fra rengøringsområdet, hospitalsdrift eller anden større serviceorganisation vil være en fordel.

Vi tilbyder

  • En central funktion i en afdeling med stor betydning for hospitalets drift og patientsikkerhed
  • Mulighed for at præge udviklingen af fremtidens rengøringsplanlægning
  • Tæt samarbejde med meget engagerede ledere og kolleger
  • Alsidige arbejdsopgaver med stor selvstændighed
  • En arbejdsplads præget af faglighed, udvikling og samarbejde
Ansættelsesvilkår

Stillingen er på 37 timer ugentligt, med ansættelse snarest og tidsbegrænset frem til 31. december 2027. Ansættelse sker i henhold til gældende overenskomst og aftaler i Region Hovedstaden.

Ansøgning

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning og CV via Region Hovedstadens rekrutteringssystem senest den 2. oktober 2026 og vi afholder samtaler med kvalificerede kandidater løbende .

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte:

Souschef Anette Melkjorsen
Telefon: 24 27 98 56
E-mail: anette.melkjorsen@regionh.dk

jobs.title: HR Specialist
jobs.description:
Be part of Clavister’s journey to secure the digital world! We are looking for an HR Specialist who wants to take an active role across the employee lifecycle and help us deliver effective, people-focused and scalable HR practices.

We apply Agile HR principles, working closely with the organisation, learning through feedback and data, and continuously adapting our people practices as our needs evolve. This is a broad and hands-on HR role for someone who enjoys combining people interaction with structure, independent responsibility and continuous improvement.

About Clavister

Clavister is a leading European cybersecurity company founded in 1997, headquartered in Örnsköldsvik, offering a wide range of cybersecurity solutions, including network firewalls, identity management, cloud security, machine learning and AI.

Today, we focus on four main customer segments: the Public Sector, Critical Infrastructure, Defence and Telecommunications. Together with our partners and distributors, Clavister’s hardware and software are widely deployed and used by customers in more than 100 countries.

The Role

As HR Specialist, you will work closely with our Head of HR. You will independently manage and coordinate defined HR processes and support employees and leaders throughout the employee lifecycle.

You will have a broad role spanning recruitment, onboarding and offboarding, HR administration and data, work environment activities and day-to-day HR support. You will be responsible for ensuring that the processes within your area are well structured, professionally delivered and continuously improved.

This is a role for someone who enjoys taking ownership, creating structure and making sure things get done, while providing a professional and positive experience for candidates, employees and People Leads.

Key areas of responsibility

    

Manage recruitment processes, including candidate communication, interview coordination and recruitment administration

    

Coordinate and continuously improve onboarding and offboarding processes

    

Coordinate activities, documentation and follow-up related to Systematic Work Environment (SAM) Management and the Safety Committee

    

Maintain accurate employee information, HR systems, documentation and records

You will also contribute to

    

Provide HR support to employees and People Leads, handling routine matters and working together with the Head of HR on more complex questions

    

Prepare and validate employee and compensation data for reporting, analysis and recurring HR processes

    

Support recurring HR activities related to engagement, communication, performance and employee development

    

Support personnel security activities throughout the employee lifecycle

    

Work closely with employees and People Leads to understand needs, gather feedback and improve HR practices

Across all these areas, you will work with an Agile HR mindset, staying close to the organisation, learning from feedback and continuously improving our processes, tools and ways of working.

The person we are looking for

Trust is our foundation, and how you work with people matters to us. We are looking for someone who combines a genuine interest in people with the structure and drive to take ownership and get things done.

You have experience working with HR and independently managing defined HR activities or processes. You understand the employee lifecycle, are comfortable managing several priorities at once, and communicate confidently in both Swedish and English.

We believe you will thrive at Clavister if you:

    

Care about people and take pride in creating a positive and professional experience for others

    

Collaborate openly, build strong relationships and enjoy working closely with employees and leaders

    

Show bravery by taking initiative, asking questions and challenging ways of working when you see an opportunity to improve

    

Innovate by being curious and looking for smarter ways of working, including how technology can improve everyday HR

    

Keep growing by seeking feedback, learning and adapting as the needs of our people and organisation evolve

    

Take ownership of your work while having the judgement to recognise when something should be discussed or escalated

You are structured and reliable and comfortable working iteratively, learning from feedback and adjusting along the way. You understand when consistency and structure are important and when a simpler, more flexible approach creates greater value.

Extra points for

Experience in one or more of the following is an advantage:

    

Recruitment and onboarding

    

Swedish work environment processes and employment practices

    

HR systems, employee data or HR reporting

    

HR analytics

    

Agile HR or working in an agile organisation

    

Technology, international or regulated organisations

We will continuously review and interview qualified applicants.

jobs.title: Le Metier - Sous Chef to work in our new French Brasserie
jobs.description:
Le Metier is looking for a Sous Chef to work in our new French Brasserie

About the position

Le Metier is looking for a Sous Chef to join us and help take the next step in the development of our kitchen.

Le Metier is an independent restaurant located on Christianshavn, Copenhagen, built around the philosophy: good food, genuine hospitality, strong personalities and a restaurant that feel alive.

Le Métier is a new French restaurant on Strandgade 98 in Christianshavn, created by the people behind Lalala, Ma Cuisine and La Propina. The restaurant draws inspiration from the best classic French brasseries and restaurants and celebrates craftsmanship, technique, good ingredients and personal service. The expected opening is October/November 2026.

We are now looking for an ambitious Sous Chef who can work across both restaurants and become an important part of the next stage of our development.

The role

This position is about more than cooking good food. We are looking for someone who wants to help us build a stronger, more structured and more consistent kitchen while protecting the personality and energy of the restaurant.

Working closely with our head chef and management team, you will help us develop the way our kitchens operate every day.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Maintaining a consistently high standard of food and execution.

• Supporting and leading the kitchen teams during service.

• Making sure recipes, preparation and plating are clear and consistent.

• Improving mise en place, organisation and communication.

• Maintaining high standards of cleanliness, hygiene and kitchen maintenance.

• Supporting ordering, stock management and food-cost awareness.

• Training and developing younger members of the kitchen team.

• Helping create systems that make the kitchens more efficient and less dependent on individual people.

• Contributing ideas and feedback to the development of our menus.

• Creating a kitchen culture based on professionalism, respect, responsibility and pride in the craft.

Who we are looking for

• Has solid professional kitchen experience, ideally with experience in French and/or Mediterranean cuisine.

• Has strong technical foundations and genuinely cares about cooking.

• Understands that consistency is as important as creativity.

• Is organised and comfortable working with systems, recipes, prep lists and checklists.

• Can lead by example rather than simply giving instructions.

• Enjoys teaching and developing others.

• Takes responsibility for the kitchen, even when nobody is watching.

• Understands food cost, ordering, waste and the operational side of running a restaurant.

• Cares about cleanliness and organisation as much as what leaves the pass.

• Can remain calm, structured and positive during busy services.

• Wants to contribute ideas and challenge the way we currently work when something can be improved.

Most importantly, we are looking for someone with ambition and personality. We don’t want to create a kitchen without soul. We want a professional kitchen with strong systems behind it, giving talented people the freedom to focus on hospitality, creativity and great food.

What we offer

You will join a restaurant that are currently evolving and help professionalizing our operations. This means you will have the opportunity to make a real impact on how our kitchen is structured and how it will develop in the future.

• The opportunity to influence kitchen systems, organisation and culture.

• Space to contribute creatively to in the restaurant.

• A close relationship with the management and kitchen team.

• Opportunity to grow as the restaurant and our hospitality group develop.

• Salary based on experience and qualifications.

We believe great restaurants are built when good food, strong systems, genuine hospitality and great people work together. If you love your craft, enjoy responsibility and want to help us build something stronger, we would love to meet you.

Acting as a finance business partner and trusted advisor to project managers and management teams, you will ensure transparency, financial control, and informed decision-making throughout the project lifecycle.

You combine a solid financial foundation with a genuine interest in business operations and project management. You are comfortable challenging assumptions, asking the right questions, and supporting decision-makers with both strategic perspectives and attention to detail.

Qualifications:

    Experience in controlling, financial analysis, project controlling, business controlling, or project management support
    Strong analytical capabilities and the ability to understand technical, commercial, and financial drivers
    Experience working with budgets, forecasts, business cases, and financial reporting

    A collaborative mindset and the ability to build strong relationships across functions and organizational levels
    Professional proficiency in English

Advantageous:

    Fluency in Swedish

Full-time consulting assignment until 2028-09-21. Start asap.

Let us help you take the next step in your career

Our vision is to ensure that everyone thrives and feels engaged at work. With us, you will find a wide variety of assignments, where you can either be employed directly by a company or work as a consultant through Perido. We are one of Sweden’s largest consulting firms for professionals, which gives you many opportunities. As a consultant, you become an important part of our organization and contribute your expertise within our clients’ organizations. Read more about us at Perido: https://perido.se/om-oss/

You can find answers to most questions or concerns at perido.se/vanliga-fragor/. If you still cannot find what you are looking for, you are welcome to contact us at fraga@perido.se. As part of the VARD value chain, we work closely with shipowners, designers, and shipyards to create functional, sustainable, and high-quality onboard environments. With a strong focus on innovation, craftsmanship, and customer value, we help bring some of the industry’s most advanced vessels to life.

We are currently looking for a Bid Manager to join our team. In this role, you will have the opportunity to apply your expertise, collaborate with skilled colleagues, and contribute to exciting projects across the VARD value chain.

Ready to make an impact at VARD?


Duties and responsibilities

  • Maintain and improve cost estimation tools, routines and databases.
  • Conduct cost analyses and identify opportunities for cost optimization.
  • Perform risk assessments and maintain risk registers throughout the sales process.
  • Collaborate with customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders to clarify project scope and requirements.
  • Facilitate project handover from Sales to Project Execution.
  • Support the continuous development of estimating methodologies and best practices
Qualifications
  • Relevant higher education, or equivalent experience.
  • Good written and spoken English and Norwegian skills.
  • Knowledge of vessel interiors, HVAC and piping systems.
  • Understanding of shipbuilding processes and the maritime industry.
  • Experience with cost estimation, commercial analysis or bid management is an advantage.
  • Proven experience in securing contracts and delivering successful bids is considered a plus.

 

VARD works systematically for inclusion and diversity and encourage everyone to apply, even if your competence does not match 100% the above. 

This employment may require a background check, or security clearance by the Norwegian National Security Authority.

Personal qualities
  • Strong communication, negotiation and presentation skills.
  • Commercially minded with a strong business understanding.
  • Analytical and detail-oriented, with excellent problem-solving abilities.
  • Proactive and solution-oriented in your approach to work.
  • Able to manage multiple priorities and deliver under tight deadlines.
  • Adaptable and comfortable working in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.
  • Resilient, focused and able to perform effectively under pressure
  • Identify yourself with the VARD values Craftmanship, Salesmanship and Fellowship.
Our commitment to you

The social offer varies throughout the year and includes activities like 'walk and talk' during lunch hours, fjord cruises, cooking lessons, go karting, football practices and wine tasting, just to name a few.

jobs.description:
We are looking for DESTINATION GUIDE for our client, Lapland Hotels SnowVillage, for the winter season 2026-2027.

The role of a Destination Guide is international and diverse. The work includes, among other duties, leading guided tours for groups in the snow and ice world. Employment begins on November 23, 2026, and is expected to continue until April 4, 2027. Full-time work is available at 112.5 hours per three-week period. The employment contract will be concluded between the employee and Staffpoint.

We hope you have

- Previous experience in customer service and strong group management skills

- A positive attitude reflected in the way you work

- Readiness to work in a busy and international environment

- Motivation to work in a dynamic and versatile role

- In addition to English, proficiency in German, French, or Spanish is considered an advantage

We offer you

- Interesting and varied work in a pleasant, active, and enjoyable work environment

- A fantastic and close-knit team that many employees return to season after season

- Comprehensive employee benefits across three business areas (Lapland Hotels, Lapland Safaris, and Lapland Ski Resorts)

- Accommodation arranged by the client

- Salary negotiable based on experience, but at minimum according to the collective agreement for the hospitality industry (Marava TES) plus applicable supplements


Lapland Hotels SnowVillage uniquely combines the magical worlds of snow and ice. Every year in November, a one-of-a-kind icy attraction covering approximately two hectares is built in Lainio, featuring ice sculptures, an ice restaurant, and an ice bar. Reception and restaurant facilities, however, are comfortably located within warm log-built surroundings.

Smiling customer service and creating memorable experiences are the core values of SnowVillage. Lapland Hotels SnowVillage welcomes approximately 80,000 visitors annually, and the theme changes every year. Its location near the Levi and Ylläs ski resorts ensures a busy winter season. SnowVillage is approximately 45 km from Levi, 30 km from Äkäslompolo, and 15 km from Ylläsjärvi.

The accommodation is located approximately 15 km from the workplace, so a car or a driving licence is essential.

Please note that we process applications throughout the application period. The position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found. Submit your job application and we'll see you in magical Lapland! Please note that we do not accept applications via email due to GDPR regulations. All applications should be submitted through our website.


Lapland Hotels

Lapland Hotels & Safaris Oy offers northern experiences for all senses. It consists of Finland's largest private hotel chain Lapland Hotels, the Nordic region's largest program service company Lapland Safaris, and Lapland Ski Resorts. The entire group employs a total of about 1,950 people.

Lapland Hotels includes 20 hotels, over 2,600 rooms and apartments, and more than 11,000 restaurant seats throughout Finland: in Ylläs, Levi, Saariselkä, Rovaniemi, Olos, Luosto, Kilpisjärvi, Pallas, and Hetta, as well as in Helsinki, Tampere, Oulu, Kuopio, and Kartano & Spa Hotel Haikko in Porvoo.

Lapland Safaris offers unique nature activities in Lapland's five locations: Rovaniemi, Ylläs, Saariselkä, Levi, and Luosto. An essential part of the safari selection is dog sledding experiences, which are provided by Lapland Husky Safaris, a member of the same tourism group. The company is the largest operator in its field in Finland and has four kennels in Rovaniemi, Luosto, Saariselkä, and Muonio. Lapland Ski Resorts consists of five ski resorts located in Ylläs, Luosto, Olos, Pallas, and Rovaniemi

jobs.title: Mekanisk prosjektleder/teknisk ingeniør
jobs.description:
Som mekanisk prosjektleder/teknisk ingeniør vil du ha en sentral rolle i utvikling, prosjektering og forbedring av mekaniske løsninger og produksjonsutstyr. Du vil være en del av prosjektstaben og jobbe tett med produksjonen, leverandører og interne fagmiljøer. Du vil være med å bidra til å sikre robuste, effektive og kvalitetssikrede tekniske leveranser.

Rollen kombinerer:

  • Prosjektering og teknisk utvikling
  • Mekanisk design og dokumentasjon
  • Prosjektledelse og koordinering
  • Løsningsutvikling og kontinuerlig forbedring

Du får mulighet til å påvirke hele livsløpet – fra idé og design til installasjon, testing og videre optimalisering!


Arbeidsoppgaver

Hva skal du jobbe med?

  • Prosjektering, dimensjonering og utvikling av mekaniske løsninger
  • Design, konstruksjon og utarbeidelse av tekniske tegninger (2D/3D – Autodesk Inventor)
  • Utarbeidelse og oppfølging av maskindokumentasjon, CE-merking og interne dokumentasjonskrav
  • Lede og koordinere tekniske leveranser i prosjekter
  • Kontakt og oppfølging av leverandører, rådgivere og underleverandører
  • Kalkulasjon og teknisk støtte i interne prosjekter
  • Bidra til forbedringsarbeid, kvalitetssystemer og dokumentstyring
  • Delta i utviklingsarbeid knyttet til mekaniske systemer, tekniske løsninger og arbeidsmetoder
  • Støtte prototyping, testing, verifikasjon og teknisk kvalifisering
Kvalifikasjoner (overskrift)

Hva ønsker vi at du har av kvalifikasjoner?

  • Høyere utdanning innen relevante mekaniske fag
  • Erfaring fra prosjektering, mekanisk design, løsningsutvikling eller prosjektledelse
  • Erfaring med Autodesk Inventor / AutoCAD
  • God teknisk forståelse og evne til å omsette krav til praktiske løsninger
  • Erfaring med tekniske beregninger, dimensjonering og dokumentasjon
  • Gode norsk- og engelskkunnskaper, muntlig og skriftlig

Hvem er du?

  • Praktisk, teknisk og nysgjerrig!
  • Jobber strukturert og er tydelig i kommunikasjonen
  • Tar ansvar, viser initiativ og trives med selvstendig arbeid
  • Er løsningsorientert og kvalitetsbevisst
  • Motiveres av å utvikle gode tekniske løsninger og bidra til kontinuerlig forbedring
  • Er en lagspiller som trives i tverrfaglige miljøer

Hva får du hos oss?

  • En nøkkelrolle i utviklingen av avanserte mekaniske løsninger
  • Mulighet til å påvirke hele prosjektets livsløp – fra idé til ferdig teknisk løsning
  • Et sterkt fagmiljø med erfarne ingeniører og tekniske spesialister
  • Et arbeidsmiljø preget av tillit, korte beslutningsveier og høy trivsel
  • En arbeidsplass som satser på kvalitet, utvikling og bærekraftige løsninger

jobs.title: Data Scientist for Department of Biology
jobs.description:
We are Earth scientists who accumulate large data sets on the composition of sedimentary rocks in geologic time on modern sediments from throughout the world. Our ambition is to generate coupled interactive data sets, where data can be easily extracted, and compared with other literature data sets. What we need is a data scientist to help us organize and curate our data, to extract data from the literature and to generate computational platforms for data analysis. A GIS framework will be important for some of the data organization analyses.

Overall, we need someone who is motivated, with good ideas as to how data bases can be organized and manipulated and with skills using GIS. To be considered for this position the applicants should have a PhD degree. 

The data scientist will be part of the Nordcee research group and specifically the Canfield Villum group exploring the relationship between the evolution of the Earth’s
chemical environment and the evolution of life. The position is based at the Department of Biology.

The position will run from February 1 2027 until June 30, 2029.

Salary and employment terms
Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.

SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary.

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Application must include cover letter, CV and certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

We recommend that you read how to apply before you apply.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

jobs.description:

Työtehtäviin kuuluvat henkilöautojen, pakettiautojen sekä asuntoautojen renkaiden vaihtojen lisäksi niiden peseminen. Työssä voi olla muitakin tehtäviä, mutta kaikkiin on hyvä perehdytys, joten aikaisempi kokemus vastaavista töistä ei ole pakollista. Työtä ei tehdä yksin vaan joko pareittain tai pienessä porukassa. Työ on fyysistä, joten reipas ja työtäpelkäämätön asenne ovat ehdottomasti eduksesi.

Nous recherchons un(e) Architecte Cybersécurité Senior pour rejoindre le pôle Expertise de l'équipe Cybersécurité de la DSI. Le pôle accompagne les équipes internes sur les sujets d'architecture, d'innovation et de sécurisation du SI. La mission consiste à accompagner les équipes agiles dans l'atteinte d'un niveau élevé de sécurité, à définir les exigences et doctrines de sécurité, à challenger les solutions existantes et à contribuer à l'amélioration continue de la cybersécurité.
Missions principales :
-        Accompagner les équipes agiles dans l'intégration des exigences de sécurité et leur mise en conformité.
-        Définir et faire évoluer les doctrines et requis non fonctionnels de sécurité.
-        Réaliser des missions d'architecture de sécurité technique sur les applications, socles et environnements Cloud.
-        Accompagner les équipes sur les pratiques DevSecOps et la sécurisation du cycle de développement logiciel.
-        Challenger les solutions techniques existantes et assurer une veille technologique régulière.
-        Analyser et challenger les résultats d'audits offensifs (pentest, red teaming) et accompagner la remédiation des vulnérabilités.
-        Accompagner l'exploitation et l'acculturation autour de solutions de cybersécurité : DLP, CNAPP, SSE, VOC, DMARC, Cloud souverain, etc.
-        Accompagner la mise en œuvre de solutions de chiffrement à l'état de l'art, notamment dans le cadre de la transition post-quantique.
-        Valider la conformité cybersécurité des nouveaux socles et applications du SI.
-        Contribuer à la sécurisation des applications à l'aide de l'IA et aux nouveaux usages autour des LLM, MCP et de l'agentique.
-        Contribuer à la stratégie et à l'amélioration continue des activités de l'équipe Cybersécurité.
-        Participer ponctuellement à d'autres sujets transverses de cybersécurité selon l'actualité et les besoins de la DSI.
Livrables attendus :
-        Doctrines et exigences de sécurité applicables aux équipes agiles.
-        Analyses et recommandations d'architecture cybersécurité.
-        Avis et validations de conformité cyber des applications et socles.
-        Analyses et plans de remédiation issus des audits offensifs.
-        Recommandations d'amélioration DevSecOps et SSDLC.
-        Documents de veille, études et recommandations technologiques.
-        Accompagnement au déploiement et à l'adoption des solutions de cybersécurité.
-        Recommandations et dispositifs liés au chiffrement, à la PKI, aux certificats et à la transition post-quantique.
-        Contributions à la stratégie et aux plans d'amélioration continue de la cybersécurité.
Profil recherché :
-        Expérience significative en architecture cybersécurité et en sécurité technique.
-        Solides compétences en sécurité des applications, des API, du Web, des systèmes, des réseaux et du Cloud.
-        Expérience pratique en développement et en DevSecOps : SSDLC, SAST, DAST, SCA, CNAPP, CSPM, etc.
-        Expérience en sécurité offensive : pentest et/ou red teaming.
-        Certification sur un ou plusieurs Cloud Service Providers : AWS, Azure et/ou GCP.
-        Maîtrise des environnements Cloud et infrastructures : AWS, Azure, GCP, VMware, Kubernetes.
-        Bonnes connaissances en gestion des identités et des accès : OIDC, SAML, SCIM.
-        Connaissances des architectures réseau et sécurité : ADN, SASE.
-        Solides connaissances en cryptographie, certificats/CLM, PKI, KMS/HSM.
-        Connaissances des méthodologies d'évaluation des risques : ISO, NIST, etc.
-        Bonne compréhension des technologies IA : LLM, MCP, agentique, ainsi que des solutions telles que Dust, Mistral et Copilot.
-        Maîtrise des environnements Linux, Windows et macOS.
-        Expérience en environnement Agile/Scrum ; certification SAFe appréciée.

jobs.title: Vil du forme fremtidens grønne og levende arbeidsplasser på Sunnmøre?
jobs.description:
Er du en relasjonsbygger som motiveres av å skape visuelle endringer og bedre trivsel for ansatte?

 

Har du lyst til å selge et produkt alle vil ha, og som beviselig forbedrer arbeidsmiljøet? Safari Planter AS opplever solid vekst, og nå søker vi deg som vil ta eierskap til B2B-markedet vårt i Ålesund og omegn.

 

Hvorfor er dette en unik mulighet?

De fleste selger software, forsikring eller kaffemaskiner. Hos Safari Planter selger du en opplevelse, bedre inneklima og estetiske arbeidsplasser. Grønne vegger, spektakulære atriumløsninger og skreddersydd planteinteriør er i vinden som aldri før. Bedrifter investerer tungt i å få de ansatte tilbake til kontoret – og her sitter du med nøkkelen.

 

Som B2B-selger hos oss får du en sjelden kombinasjon av kreativ rådgivning og rendyrket business-to-business-salg. Du blir vårt ansikt utad mot regionens mest spennende bedrifter, eiendomsutviklere og arkitekter.

 

 

Hva vil hverdagen din bestå i?

Du vil ha stor frihet til å legge opp din egen arbeidsdag, med base fra vårt kontor i Ålesund. Hovedfokus er å fylle egen portefølje og skape grønnere rom for næringsliv og offentlig sektor:

 

  • Oppsøkende salg og relasjonsbygging: Du identifiserer muligheter, booker møter og bygger langsiktige partnerskap med beslutningstakere.
  • Kreativ rådgivning: Du lytter til kundens behov og tegner ut helhetlige løsninger i grensesnittet mellom interiør, arkitektur og biophilia (menneskets behov for natur).
  • Anbud og prosjekter: Du driver prosessene fra første kontakt og tilbudsskriving til forhandlinger og avtaleinngåelse – inkludert offentlige anskaffelser.

  • Nettverksbygging: Du representerer Safari Planter på messer, bransjetreff og i samarbeid med lokale arkitekter og interiørarkitekter.

     

 

Hvem er du?

Vi ser etter deg som trigges av å lukke avtaler, men som forstår at et godt salg starter med tillit. Du har gjerne erfaring fra prosjektsalg, kapitalvaresalg eller interiørløsninger mot bedriftsmarkedet

 

  • Du er en jeger med rådgiverhatt: Du trives med oppsøkende aktivitet, men fremstår som en profesjonell og lyttende sparringspartner for kunden.
  • Du har kommersiell teft: Du forstår B2B-markedet, hvordan offentlige innkjøp fungerer, og hvordan du posisjonerer Safari Planter som den foretrukne leverandøren.
  • Du har nettverk på Sunnmøre: Det er en stor fordel om du allerede kjenner det lokale næringslivet i regionen.
  • Språk og logistikk: Du kommuniserer flytende på norsk (skriftlig og muntlig), har gode engelskkunnskaper, og førerkort klasse B er et krav da du vil være mye på farten.

 

 

Hva kan vi tilby deg?
  • En attraktiv lønnsmodell: Konkurransedyktig fastlønn i bunn, kombinert med en provisjonsmodell som belønner gode resultater.
  • Høy påvirkningskraft: Vi er en fremoverlent organisasjon der veien fra idé til beslutning er kort. Du får være med på å forme våre fremtidige konsepter og salgsstrategier.
  • Et sterkt fagmiljø: Du blir en del av et uformelt, engasjert og faglig sterkt team som brenner for det de leverer.
  • Et takknemlig produkt: Du selger løsninger som bidrar direkte til økt trivsel, lavere sykefravær og flottere visuelle rammer hos kundene dine.

jobs.title: Automation Control and Commissioning Manager
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Automation Control and Commissioning Manager to work for a 1 year project in Kotka starting from 8.10.2026 and ending on 7.10.2027

Job Description

1\. Responsible for on-site debugging of the PLC (Programmable Logic Controller) program for the post-processing system and configuration of the upper computer system.

2\. Responsible for data integration and communication protocol matching between the control system provided by the vendor side and the factory level DCS (Distributed Control System) in Finland.

3\. Guide the wiring inspection and signal testing of on-site sensors, actuators, and electrical cabinets to ensure control accuracy.

4\. Responsible for optimizing the fully automated operation logic and adjusting control algorithms based on the characteristics of local raw materials in Finland.

5\. Provide specialized training for local operators in Finland on system operation, fault diagnosis, and maintenance.

6\. Cooperate with the EU CE certification body to conduct on-site electrical safety and functional safety assessments.

Requirements

1.Proficient in mainstream PLC programming such as Siemens and Rockwell, as well as WinCC configuration software.

2\. Proficient in industrial field bus protocols such as Profibus, Profinet, and EtherCAT, with a fundamental understanding of industrial network security.

3\. Possess 3 to 5 years of experience in automation debugging within the chemical or lithium battery materials industry, capable of independently resolving complex communication failures.

4\. Master the source code and debugging passwords of the proprietary control logic for this project, serving as a core member in the development of the metering system control program.

jobs.description:
Job Description

We are looking for a Pneumatic Conveying System Installation and Commissioning Engineer to work for a 1 year project in Kotka starting from 8.10.2026 and ending on 7.10.2027

1.Responsible for providing on-site installation guidance for pneumatic conveying equipment (including rotary feeders, bin pumps, pipelines, valves, etc.) at the project site.

3\. Guide local labor in the assembly and positioning of key components such as wear-resistant elbows and diverter valves.

2. Proficient in on-site acceptance standards for pipeline welding, flange connections, and pressure testing.

3. Capable of on-site safety supervision for height work and confined space operations.

4. 1-5 years of work experience

jobs.description:
Emploi Pédodontiste H/F - Vauréal 95
Nous recrutons un pédodontiste H/F en salariat pour intégrer une structure dentaire moderne située à Vauréal (Val-d'Oise).
Description et missions
Vous exercerez en tant que pédodontiste exclusif ou en bénéficiant d'une formation approfondie en orthodontie, selon votre projet professionnel. Vous rejoindrez un environnement favorisant une prise en charge optimale des jeunes patients, avec un support clinique et administratif complet : assistante dentaire dédiée au fauteuil et équipe de secrétaires assurant la gestion des rendez-vous et du suivi administratif. La structure garantit un flux constant de nouveaux patients, assurant un agenda bien rempli.
ADN de la structure
La clinique bénéficie d'infrastructures modernes, récemment rénovées, et dotées de technologies de pointe : Invisalign Diamond Provider, scanners de dernière génération, panoramique, cone beam et céphalométrie. L'équipe est composée de 10 assistantes dentaires et 5 secrétaires, assurant une gestion fluide et efficace. Les praticiens bénéficient également d'un accompagnement personnalisé pour leur installation et leur évolution professionnelle.
Rémunération
Cette opportunité vous permettra de percevoir une rémunération attractive, définie selon le profil du candidat.
Avantages
- Huit semaines de congés payés
- Week-end de trois jours
- Mutuelle et contrat de prévoyance de qualité
- Remboursement des frais de transport à hauteur de 50 %
- Accompagnement personnalisé (inscription à l'Ordre, logement, véhicule, communication, etc.)
- Garantie et maintien du salaire pour une activité sans objectif de chiffre d'affaires
Profils recherchés : Pédodontiste diplômé(e) en France ou dans l'Union-Européenne, inscrit(e) ou inscriptible au Conseil national de l'ordre des chirurgiens-dentistes en France.
Candidats provenant de l'Union Européenne : Jober Group, leader de l'intégration des chirurgiens-dentistes en France, vous accompagne gratuitement jusqu'au démarrage de votre activité. Un de nos consultants vous aidera pour l'apprentissage de la langue, la mise en relation avec nos professeurs partenaires, l'inscription à l'ordre et votre recherche de logement.
Contactez-nous au : O6 67 76 6O 76
Référence de l'annonce : 9351
Retrouvez plus de 4000 offres d'emploi santé sur notre site et application mobile Jober Group. Profitez d'un réseau de 1000 partenaires sur toute la France, d'une équipe d'experts du recrutement à votre écoute et d'un service totalement gratuit dont 99% de nos candidats sont satisfaits.
Profil recherché:
Profils recherchés : Pédodontiste diplômé(e) en France ou dans l'Union-Européenne, inscrit(e) ou inscriptible au Conseil national de l'ordre des chirurgiens-dentistes en France.

jobs.title: Palvelupäällikkö taloushallinnon tiimiin Ouluun
jobs.description:
Johda tiimiä ja kehitä asiakkuuksia

Haluatko yhdistää tiimin ja asiakkuuksien johtamisen sekä kehittämistyön roolissa, jossa pääset oikeasti vaikuttamaan? Meillä pääset vetämään asiantuntevaa tiimiä ja rakentamaan sujuvaa arkea sekä asiakkaille että omalle porukallesi. Haemme taloushallinnon tiimiin palvelupäällikköä vakituiseen työsuhteeseen vahvistamaan ammattilaistemme joukkoa Oulussa ja lähipaikkakunnilla. Työntekopaikkana toimii Oulun seutu ja odotamme työskentelyä pääosin Oulun tai lähikuntien toimistollamme.



Mitä työ pitää sisällään?

- Tiimin toiminnan johtaminen annettujen tavoitteiden mukaisesti

- Töiden organisointi ja resursointi

- Asiakkuuksien johtaminen, kehittäminen ja asiakashuolenpito

- Asiantuntijoiden sparraus ja osaamisen kehittäminen

- Palvelun laadun varmistaminen

- Toimintatapojen ja palveluiden kehittäminen sekä muutosten jalkauttaminen omassa tiimissä



Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

- Vastuullisen ja monipuolisen roolin, jossa pääset vaikuttamaan

- Osaavan ja tukevan kollegaverkoston, esihenkilön ja hallinnon palvelutiimit

- Mahdollisuuden kehittää sekä omaa että tiimisi osaamista

- Kilpailukykyiset edut: laajennettu työterveys, suoritukseesi perustuva tulospalkkio sekä joustavat hyvinvointiedut (liikunta, kulttuuri, hyvinvointi, työmatkat...)



Tunnistatko itsesi tästä?

- Sinulla on kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä ja asiakkuuksien johtamisesta

- Osaat organisoida, priorisoida ja delegoida

- Johdat mielelläsi esimerkillä ja innostat muita onnistumaan

- Viestit selkeästi ja rakennat sujuvaa yhteistyötä

- Haluat kehittää toimintaa ja viedä asioita eteenpäin



Meillä pääset osaksi yhteisöä, jossa

- yhdessä tekeminen näkyy arjessa

- tukea saa aina, ja ilmapiiri on avoin ja kannustava

- arvostamme kehittämishalua, vastuullisuutta ja aitoa kiinnostusta ihmisten johtamiseen



Toimimme Aallon arvojen mukaisesti: Osaan, Palvelen, Huolehdin, Kehityn. Yhdessä muodostamme tilitoimiston – monimuotoisen työyhteisön, työpaikan ja asiantuntijaorganisaation, jossa jokainen meistä voi työskennellä ylpeyttä, tyytyväisyyttä ja turvallisuutta tuntien. Yhteistyö kanssamme perustuu molemminpuoliseen kunnioitukseen, luottamukseen ja rehellisyyteen. Uskomme menestyksen kumpuavan tyytyväisistä asiantuntijoista, jotka mahdollistavat tyytyväiset asiakkaat. Strategiamme ydinajatus kulminoituu Aallon sloganiin Tilitoimistoni.


Kiinnostuitko? Lähetäthän hakemuksesi ja CV:si mahdollisimman pian – käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana. Voit hakea helposti LinkedIn -profiililla tai CV:llä.

jobs.title: Wilderness Guide
jobs.description:
**Are you looking for meaningful work in the magical nature of Lapland? Do you want to provide guests with unforgettable experiences away from commercial mass tourism?**

**Flow Lapland Experiences Oy** is a Rovaniemi-based experience and activity service company offering high-quality, authentic, and personalized small-group tours. In our operations, we focus on high safety standards, genuine interactions, and unique nature experiences. We are now looking for a motivated and customer-oriented **Wilderness & Nature Guide**to join our team and create unforgettable moments for our international guests.

Your Versatile Responsibilities

As a guide, you will be the most important link between the customer and Laplands unique nature. Your workday will mainly consist of the following tasks:

- **Northern Lights Tours (Aurora Hunting):** Guiding groups and taking photography of the Northern Lights during evening and nighttime hours.

- **Winter Activities & Day Trips:** Leading diverse nature excursions, such as trips to the iconic Korouoma ice falls area and wildlife park visits.

- **Customer Service:** A warm, active, and attentive approach when interacting with guests from all over the world.

- **Responsibility & Safety:** Ensuring group safety, overall well-being, and tour schedules in arctic conditions.


What We Expect From You

**Requirements:**

- **Language Skills:** Excellent spoken English.

- **Driver's License:** A valid Category B driver's license and strong confidence driving in challenging arctic winter conditions.

- **Attitude:** A positive customer service mindset, flexibility, and strong teamwork skills.

- **Stress Tolerance:** Ability to act responsibly, calmly, and methodically, even in changing situations.


**Considered an Advantage:**

- Previous experience as a wilderness, nature, or activity guide.

- Valid first aid certification (e.g., EA1 / EA2 / Wilderness First Aid).

- Excellent photography skills (especially knowledge of Northern Lights and night photography).

- Proficiency in languages other than English.


What We Offer You

- **An Inspiring Work Community:** We are a close-knit and supportive team where we invest in everyones well-being through friendly competitions, social evenings, and team recreation days.

- **An Eventful Everyday Life:** A diverse and meaningful role in stunning surroundings—you get to experience Lapland's winter, snow-laden forests, and Northern Lights from the best seat in the house.

- **Training & Career Growth:** As a fresh and growing company, we aim to be an exemplary employer in the tourism industry. We offer comprehensive onboarding and genuine opportunities to develop and advance in your career.

- **Flat Hierarchy & Influence:** Our management is involved in daily operations, offering you the opportunity to significantly influence company development, participate in product development, and take on new responsibilities.

- **Remuneration:** We follow the collective agreement for the ski, tourism, restaurant, and leisure service sector (MaRaVa TES). Salary is determined according to the collective agreement or negotiable based on your experience.

ΧΡΗΣΗ ΧΕΙΡΟΚΙΝΗΤΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΗΛΕΚΤΡΙΚΩΝ ΕΡΓΑΛΕΙΩΝ ΣΥΜΦΩΝΑ ΜΕ ΤΙΣ ΟΔΗΓΙΕΣ ΤΟΥ ΥΠΕΥΘΥΝΟΥ ΤΕΧΝΙΤΗ. ΤΗΡΗΣΗ ΤΩΝ ΚΑΝΟΝΩΝ ΥΓΕΙΑΣ ΚΑΙ ΑΣΦΑΛΕΙΑΣ ΣΤΟΝ ΧΩΡΟ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΑΣ. ΔΙΑΤΗΡΗΣΗ ΚΑΘΑΡΙΟΤΗΤΑΣ ΚΑΙ ΟΡΓΑΝΩΣΗΣ ΤΟΥ ΕΡΓΑΣΤΗΡΙΟΥ Η ΤΟΥ ΕΡΓΟΤΑΞΙΟΥ. , ΚΑΛΗ ΦΥΣΙΚΗ ΚΑΤΑΣΤΑΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΔΥΝΑΤΟΤΗΤΑ ΧΕΙΡΩΝΑΚΤΙΚΗΣ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΑΣ. ΥΠΕΥΘΥΝΟΤΗΤΑ, ΣΥΝΕΠΕΙΑ ΚΑΙ ΔΙΑΘΕΣΗ ΓΙΑ ΜΑΘΗΣΗ. ΙΚΑΝΟΤΗΤΑ ΣΥΝΕΡΓΑΣΙΑΣ ΣΕ ΟΜΑΔΙΚΟ ΠΕΡΙΒΑΛΛΟΝ. ΠΡΟΗΓΟΥΜΕΝΗ ΕΜΠΕΙΡΙΑ ΣΕ ΜΕΤΑΛΛΙΚΕΣ ΚΑΤΑΣΚΕΥΕΣ Η ΣΥΝΑΦΕΙΣ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΕΣ ΘΑ ΘΕΩΡΗΘΕΙ ΕΠΙΠΡΟΣΘΕΤΟ ΠΡΟΣΟΝ. , Please note that copy of the letter and CV sent to the employer should also be sent to the (EURES ADVISOR , PRODROMOS CHRYSANTHOU , pchrysanthou@dl.mlsi.gov.cy). Please include the national vacancy reference number
