jobs.title: B2B-myyntikumppani – rakenna asiakaskantaa, joka tuottaa pitkään
jobs.description:
B2B-myyntikumppani – rakenna omaa asiakaskantaasi

**Entä jos yksi onnistunut asiakashankinta voisi tuoda sinulle provisiota vielä kuukausien tai jopa vuosien päästä?**

Duunex etsii motivoituneita B2B-myyntikumppaneita kasvavaan myyntiverkostoon.

Myyt yrityksille tuotteita, joita ne tarvitsevat toiminnassaan jatkuvasti – kuten paperi-, hygienia-, siivous- ja muita käyttötarvikkeita.

Ja juuri tässä tulee mallin kiinnostavin osa:

**Kun hankkimasi asiakas jatkaa tilaamista, saat provisiota myös asiakkaan myöhemmistä tilauksista.**

Eli tavoite ei ole tehdä yhtä kauppaa ja aloittaa ensi kuussa taas nollasta.

Tavoite on rakentaa omaa asiakaskantaa.

**AJATTELE LUMIPALLOA**

Hankit ensimmäisen asiakkaan.

Asiakas tilaa. saat provision.

Hankit seuraavan asiakkaan.

Uusi asiakas tilaa + ensimmäinen asiakas tilaa uudelleen.

Hankit lisää asiakkaita.

Asiakaskanta kasvaa jatkotilauksia tulee enemmän provisio kasvaa.

Paperi loppuu. Saippua loppuu. Käsipyyhkeet loppuvat. Jätesäkkejä tarvitaan lisää.

Yritykset joutuvat ostamaan näitä tuotteita uudelleen.

**Et rakenna joka kuukausi uutta lumipalloa. Kasvatat sitä, jonka olet jo aloittanut.**

**MITÄ ENEMMÄN SAAT AIKAAN, SITÄ ENEMMÄN SAAT**

Mitä suuremman aktiivisen asiakaskannan rakennat, sitä suuremmaksi myös aikaisemmin tekemäsi myyntityön arvo voi kasvaa.

Hyvän asiakaskannan rakentanut myyjä voi pääsee useiden tuhansien eurojen kuukausiansioihin.

Ansiot eivät ole taattuja, vaan riippuvat täysin omasta myyntituloksesta, asiakkaiden ostamisesta, katteesta ja asiakkuuksien kestosta.

**MITÄ TEET KÄYTÄNNÖSSÄ?**

Sun tehtäväsi on:

etsiä yrityksiä avata keskustelu selvittää tarve tehdä kauppa.

Voit esimerkiksi:

\- soittaa yrityksille - käydä paikan päällä - sopia tapaamisia - hyödyntää omia kontaktejasi - etsiä uusia potentiaalisia asiakkaita

Saat valmiiksi:

tuotteet, hinnat, myyntimateriaalit, perehdytyksen, myyntiohjeet ja tuen.

Kun asiakas on saatu sisään, me hoidamme normaalit jatkotilaukset, toimitukset, laskutuksen ja asiakaspalvelun.

Sinä voit keskittyä siihen, missä ansaintasi kasvaa: seuraavan hyvän asiakkaan hankkimiseen.

**TEE SILLOIN KUN SINULLE SOPII**

Ei työvuoroja.

Päätät itse milloin ja kuinka paljon teet.

Tätä voi tehdä esimerkiksi:

\- opiskelun ohella - muun työn ohella - yrittäjyyden rinnalla - tai tavoitteellisesti suuremmalla panoksella

Kyseessä on itsenäinen myyntikumppanuus, ei tavallinen työsuhde.

**KENELLE TÄMÄ SOPII?**

Et tarvitse valmiiksi vuosien myyntikokemusta.

Arvostamme enemmän sitä, että:

\- uskallat ottaa yrityksiin yhteyttä - olet oma-aloitteinen - haluat kehittyä myyjänä - et luovuta ensimmäisen ei:n jälkeen - haluat oikeasti rakentaa jotain ajan kanssa

Myyntikokemus on tietenkin plussaa.

Kyseessä ei ole tavallinen työsuhteinen työpaikka, vaan **itsenäinen myyntikumppanuus.**

Jos sait tätä lukiessa ajatuksen:

**Hetkinen, tämähän voisi oikeasti olla aika kova.**

Lähetä hakemuksesi, CV:si ja puhelinnumerosi sähköpostitse osoitteeseen: **info@duunex.fi** Myös mahdolliset kysymykset voit lähettää samaan osoitteeseen.

Käydään sen jälkeen homma henkilökohtaisesti läpi.

**Duunex**

_Hanki asiakkaita tänään. Rakenna tuloa myös huomiselle._

Palvelupäällikkönä vastaat palvelualueesi toiminnasta kokonaisvaltaisesti. Johdat arjen tekemistä tavoitteellisesti, kehität palvelun laatua ja toimintaa sekä varmistat asiakastyytyväisyyden ja toiminnan kannattavuuden. Samalla huolehdit siitä, että toiminta on sujuvaa, turvallista ja arvojemme mukaista.

Roolissasi toimit keskeisessä asemassa asiakkaiden, henkilöstön ja sisäisten sidosryhmien välillä. Vaikutat suoraan asiakaskokemukseen, henkilöstön onnistumiseen ja liiketoiminnan tuloksellisuuteen sekä ja johdat muutosta sekä kehität toimintaa pitkäjänteisesti.

Tehtävässä vastaat palvelualueesi toiminnan ja asiakassuhteiden johtamisesta sekä niiden kehittämisestä, laadun ja tehokkuuden varmistamisesta sekä myynnillisestä työotteesta ja uusien liiketoimintamahdollisuuksien tunnistamisesta. Arjessa johdat henkilöstöä ja tuet työkykyä sekä vastaat talouden, resurssien ja kannattavuuden kokonaisvaltaisesta hallinnasta.

**Odotamme sinulta**

Sinulla on tehtävään soveltuva koulutus, esimerkiksi korkeakoulututkinto. Kokemus esihenkilötehtävistä ja/tai palveluliiketoiminnasta on eduksi, mutta ei välttämätöntä.Ymmärrät talouden tunnuslukuja ja kannattavuuden johtamista. Työskentelet asiakaslähtöisesti ja myynnillisellä otteella, tunnistat asiakkaiden tarpeita ja osaat tarjota niihin toimivia ratkaisuja.

Olet vuorovaikutustaitoinen, oikeudenmukainen ja johdonmukainen esihenkilö, joka osaa motivoida, kehittää ja valmentaa tiimiään arjessa. Toiminnassasi korostuvat vastuullisuus, ratkaisukeskeisyys, liiketoimintalähtöinen ajattelu ja kyky johtaa kokonaisuuksia. Haluat myös aktiivisesti edistää yhdenvertaista ja arvostavaa työyhteisöä.

Tehtävä edellyttää voimassa olevaa ajokorttia sekä oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta, sillä työssä liikutaan asiakkaiden ja tiimin tarpeiden mukaisesti eri kohteiden välillä laajalla työskentelyalueella.

**Tarjoamme sinulle**

Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen ja vastuullisen roolin liiketoiminnan ytimessä sekä mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa ja kehittää toimintaa aidosti.

Lisäksi tarjoamme:

- kilpailukykyisen palkan n. 3400–3800 €/kk kokemuksesta riippuen

- kattavan perehdytyksen ja jatkuvan tuen tehtävässä onnistumiseen

- mahdollisuuden kehittyä ja rakentaa urapolkuasi kasvavassa organisaatiossa

- kansainvälisen ja kannustavan työyhteisön

- turvallisen ja arvostavan työympäristön reilut työehdot, turvallisen työympäristön ja työntekijöiden hyvinvoinnista huolehtimisen


Työskentelemme joustavasti hybridityömallilla ja työpäivät ovat vaihtelevia asiakkaiden ja oman alueen tarpeiden mukaan.

**Yhdenvertaisuus ja vastuullisuus**

Meille jokainen työntekijä on tärkeä. Johdamme työyhteisöä yhdenvertaisesti ja kohtelemme kaikkia kunnioittavasti – emme hyväksy syrjintää missään muodossa. Huolehdimme turvallisesta työympäristöstä ja työntekijöiden hyvinvoinnista sekä toimimme vastuullisesti kaikessa tekemisessä.

**Miksi meille kannattaa tulla töihin**

Meillä viihdytään – työntekijöidemme eNPS on huipputasolla ja arjessamme näkyy arvostus, luottamus ja yhdessä onnistuminen. Olemme saaneet myös tunnustusta työstämme: Vuonna 2024 meidät valittiin Suomen ihmisläheisimmäksi työpaikaksi Vuonna 2025 sijoituimme samassa kategoriassa kolmannelle sijalle Vuonna 2025 saavutimme 3. sijan Suomen ihmisläheisin työelämäteko -kategoriassa

jobs.title: Logistics Worker – Data Centre Project, Mikkeli
jobs.description:
Job description

Mono Rakennus Oy is looking for motivated Logistics Workers to join our team on a large-scale data centre construction project in Mikkeli, Finland.

As a Logistics Worker, you will be part of the site logistics team and support the daily movement, handling and organization of materials throughout the construction site. You will work under the coordination of our Logistics Coordinator and in cooperation with the client, subcontractors and other site personnel.

Your main duties will include:

- Receiving and handling incoming materials and deliveries

- Loading, unloading and moving materials within the construction site

- Transporting materials between storage areas and designated work areas

- Organising and maintaining storage and logistics areas

- Assisting telehandler operators during loading and unloading operations

- Supporting different subcontractors with material movements

- Keeping access routes, loading areas and logistics zones clear and organised

- Assisting with waste handling and movement of waste containers when required

- Following the instructions of the Logistics Coordinator and site management

- Ensuring safe working practices and compliance with site safety requirements

- Supporting other daily site logistics activities as required


We are looking for

Previous experience in construction, logistics, warehouse operations or material handling is an advantage, but the most important qualities are a good attitude, reliability and willingness to work as part of a team.

The position requires:

- Ability to perform physical work

- Good teamwork and communication skills

- Ability to follow instructions and safety procedures

- Responsible and reliable working attitude

- Valid Occupational Safety Card (Työturvallisuuskortti), or willingness to obtain one before starting

- Sufficient English language skills for working safely on an international construction site


Finnish language skills and previous experience from data centre or large construction projects are considered an advantage.

We offer

We offer a long-term opportunity to work on a major data centre construction project with an experienced and international site team. The work is full-time, and the employment can continue according to the needs and progress of the project.

Location: Mikkeli, Finland Project: Data Centre Construction Project Employment: Full-time Starting date: As soon as possible / according to agreement

Application instructions

Please send your CV and a short application by email to:

info@monorakennus.fi

Email subject: Logistics Worker – Mikkeli

Please include in your application your previous work experience, current location, availability and possible construction-site qualifications/cards.

Applications will be reviewed during the application period, and positions may be filled as soon as suitable candidates are found.

jobs.description:
Sociální pracovník/ice v Občanské poradně
STAŇTE SE ČLENEM NAŠEHO TÝMU
Do týmu Občanské poradny hledáme SOCIÁLNÍHO PRACOVNÍKA/PRACOVNICI
"    Chcete pracovat v malém, přátelském týmu a podílet se na řešení životních situací uživatelů služby?
"    Rádi byste vykonávali práci, která není stereotypní a vždy Vás dokáže něco překvapit?
"    Máte chuť se neustále vzdělávat?
"    Nebojíte se komunikovat i o těžkých tématech?
"    Umíte naslouchat?
JAK VYPADÁ PRÁCE U NÁS?
"    Základem práce je přímá práce s uživateli služby, kteří se ocitli v obtížné životní situaci.
"    Administrativa spojena s touto službou - psaní záznamů, sepisování dokumentů pro uživatele služby.
"    Hledáme kolegyni/kolegu, který bude poskytovat služby v kanceláři v Novém Městě na Moravě a v kanceláři ve Žďáře nad Sázavou, v případě individuální potřeby v terénu.
CO OČEKÁVÁME?
"    Vyšší odborné nebo vysokoškolské vzdělání v oblasti sociální práce.
"    Komunikativní a vstřícné jednání.
"    Schopnost a zájem pracovat se specifickými cílovými skupinami.
"    Ochotu učit se a dál se vzdělávat.
"    Spolupráci v týmu.
"    Schopnost samostatné práce, pečlivost, zodpovědnost, systematičnost a znalost českého jazyka.
"    Dobrá znalost práce na PC (MS Office - především Excel, Word, Outlook).
CO NABÍZÍME?
"    Zaměstnání v?respektované neziskové organizaci se sídlem v?Novém Městě na Moravě. Možnost nástupu: ihned.
"    Přívětivou pracovní atmosféru.
"    Smysluplnou práci na úvazek 1,00.
"    Odpovídající mzdové ohodnocení (27 000 - 42 000 Kč/měsíc).
"    Zaškolení, odborné vedení a pravidelnou supervizi.
"    Možnost dalšího odborného růstu.
"    5 týdnů dovolené, pružnou pracovní dobu.
MÁTE ZÁJEM?
Motivační dopis a životopis je možné zaslat elektronicky na adresu zamestnani@portimo.cz, (do předmětu napište VŘ - OP), osobně nebo poštou na adresu: Portimo, o.p.s. - k rukám Ing. Tomáše Pospíšila, Drobného 301, Nové Město na Moravě 592 31.
Vybraní uchazeči budou telefonicky kontaktováni a pozváni k osobnímu setkání (přepokládaný termín pro ústní pohovory bude upřesněn, o konkrétním čase budeme vybrané uchazeče informovat).
Kontaktní osoba pro více informací: Mgr. Martina Vodrážková, martina.vodrazkova@portimo.cz, tel.: 733 510 693.
Uchazeče budeme oslovovat průběžně, v případě oboustranného zájmu uzavřeme výběrové řízení ihned. Inzerát je platný do smazání.
Odesláním a doručením životopisu a motivačního dopisu Portimo, o.p.s. dává uchazeč souhlas se zpracováním svých poskytnutých dat obsažených v těchto materiálech pro účely a v rozsahu potřebném pro uskutečnění výběrového řízení (dle zákona č. 101/2000 Sb.). jobs.title: Frontend Engineer
jobs.description:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our application focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations

Our objective is to organise anyone's life.

Â 

Role

As a Web Frontend Engineer, you will build the core web experiences, including Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs and Sheets.

You will own complex, highly interactive product surfaces from architecture through implementation, working closely with product, design, backend and AI engineers to make AI a native part of how users communicate, write, organise and work.

Â 

What You'll Own

  • Build major web experiences across Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs, and Sheets.

  • Develop complex interactions including real-time messaging, collaborative editing, rich-text editing, scheduling, tables, and spreadsheets.

  • Build reusable frontend architecture and components that work consistently across ActAI applications.

  • Integrate streaming AI responses, proactive actions, and model-driven experiences directly into product workflows.

  • Own frontend performance, responsiveness, reliability and accessibility across browsers and devices.

  • Work closely with product and design to take ideas from prototype to production quickly.

Â 

What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience building complex, production web applications using React, TypeScript and modern frontend technologies.

  • Deep understanding of frontend architecture, state management, browser APIs, and performance.

  • Experience building highly interactive products such as chat, collaboration, productivity, document editing, calendars, or workspaces.

  • Experience with real-time systems, WebSockets, streaming APIs, or collaborative interfaces.

  • Strong product and UI judgment with attention to interaction details.

  • Able to independently own features from technical design through production.

Â 

Outcomes

  • Users can communicate, write, organise and collaborate seamlessly across Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs and Sheets.

  • Complex interactions such as group messaging, editing, scheduling and collaboration feel fast and reliable.

  • AI capabilities are integrated naturally into product workflows rather than added as separate chatbot experiences.

  • Frontend architecture remains fast, maintainable and reusable as ActAI expands into new applications and workflows.

Â 

Tech Stack

  • TypeScript

  • React.js / Next.js

  • HTML / CSS

  • WebSockets / streaming APIs

  • Node.js

  • REST / GraphQL APIs

Â 

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world-class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively and move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high-quality work and learning.

Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment and execute independently. Our goal is to put in the hands of our users a truly magical product.

Â 

Interview Process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us and help bring practical AI benefits to billions of users globally.

jobs.description:
AUTOMAALAREITA JA KORIPELTISEPPÄÄ

Etsimme tällä haulla ainoastaan valmiita ja itsenäiseen työhön kykeneviä alan asiantuntijoita. Jos sinulla ei ole alan ammatillista taustaa ja käytännön kokemusta korjaamo- tai maalaamotyöstä, ethän jätä hakemusta. Yrityskuvaus HS Kytkintien Automaalaamo Oy on vankalla ammattitaidolla toimiva, vakuutusyhtiöiden valtuuttama automaalaamo ja korikorjaamo. Palvelemme asiakkaitamme kattavasti kaikissa ajoneuvojen koritöissä, kolarikorjauksissa, hitsauksissa sekä vaativissa maalauspalveluissa. Henkilöautojen lisäksi erikoisosaamiseemme kuuluvat raskaan kaluston, veneiden sekä teollisuus- ja ratikkaosien kori- ja maalaustyöt. Työnkuvaus ja odotukset hakijalta Etsimme joukkoomme Automaalaria ja Koripeltiseppää (tai moniosaajaa, joka hallitsee molemmat osa-alueet) itsenäiseen ja vastuulliseen työhön. Odotamme sinulta: B-ajokortti (ehdottomasti välttämätön): Sinulla on oltava voimassa oleva ajokortti ajoneuvojen siirtoja, hallinhallintaa ja koeajoja varten. Vahvaa ammattitaitoa maalaamossa: Hallitset suvereenisti pohjatyöt (hionnat, kittaustyöt, suojaukset), pintamaalauksen, lakkauksen sekä haastavat häivytysmaalaukset. Väriosaamista: Kokemus digitaalisten väriskannerien käytöstä ja sävytarkkuudesta on välttämätöntä. Peltisepän ja kolarikorjauksen taitoja: Kokemusta peltiosien oikaisusta, korirakenteiden korjauksista, purku-/asennustöistä sekä varmasta hitsausosaamisesta (MIG/MAG). Cabas-osaaminen (suuri plussa): Kyky tehdä tai ymmärtää vakuutusyhtiöiden Cabas-vahinkotarkastuslaskelmia katsotaan merkittäväksi eduksi. Mitä tarjoamme? Vakituisen työpaikan vakaassa ja kasvavassa yrityksessä (työsopimukseen sovelletaan lakisääteistä 6 kk koeaikaa). Kilpailykykyisen, osaamisesi ja ammattitaitosi mukaisen palkan.(Palkka sovitaan kokemuksen mukaan) Laadukkaat materiaalit sekä nykyaikaiset laitteet ja olosuhteet työn tekemiseen. Miten haet? Täytämme paikat heti sopivien ammattilaisten löydyttyä, ja työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan nopeasti. Lähetä vapaamuotoinen hakemuksesi ja CV (ansioluettelosi) sähköpostitse liitteenä. jobs.title: DIPLOMIRANI INŽENJER/KA GRAĐEVINARSTVA-INŽENJER/KA GRAĐEVINARSTVA -PROJEKTANT
jobs.description:
PROJEKTANT HIDROTEHNIČKE STRUKE (m/ž) Želite raditi na projektima koji imaju stvaran utjecaj na razvoj gradova i infrastrukture? PRONING DHI d.o.o. traži diplomiranog inženjera građevinarstva / inženjera građevinarstva – projektanta (m/ž) koji želi svoje znanje razvijati kroz rad na složenim hidrotehničkim projektima u Hrvatskoj i regiji. Ako vas zanimaju hidrotehnika, projektiranje, modeliranje i suvremene tehnologije, a želite raditi u stručnom timu i sudjelovati u projektima od koncepcije do realizacije, voljeli bismo vas upoznati. TKO SMO MI? PRONING DHI je privatno projektno društvo iz Zagreba, osnovano 1994. godine. Više od 30 godina bavimo se projektiranjem i konzaltingom u području:
  • urbane hidrotehnike
  • hidrotehnike riječnih slivova
  • eko-inženjerstva.
Sudjelovali smo u izradi kompleksnih hidrotehničkih projekata u Hrvatskoj i regiji – od master planova kanalizacijskih sustava Zagreba, Ljubljane i Osijeka do projekta odvodnje EKO-Kaštelanskog zaljeva. Posebnu pažnju posvećujemo primjeni suvremenih tehnologija. U radu koristimo i razvijamo 1D i 2D matematičke simulacijske modele, a bavimo se i razvojem sustava za predviđanje poplava u realnom vremenu. ŠTO ĆETE RADITI? Kao član našeg projektnog tima sudjelovat ćete u:
  • izradi i vođenju tehničke dokumentacije u području komunalne hidrotehnike
  • razvoju koncepcijskih rješenja te izradi idejnih, glavnih i izvedbenih projekata
  • izradi studija izvodljivosti
  • ishođenju akata za građenje
  • koordinaciji i suradnji s različitim stručnjacima i sudionicima u procesu projektiranja
  • drugim stručnim poslovima iz područja hidrotehničkog projektiranja, ovisno o vašem iskustvu i stručnosti.
Drugim riječima, ne tražimo samo izvršitelja zadataka, već stručnjaka koji želi sudjelovati u razvoju kvalitetnih projektnih rješenja. KOGA TRAŽIMO? Tražimo osobu koja ima:
  • VSS – dipl. ing. građ. / mag. ing. aedif. ili VŠS – ing. građ.
  • iskustvo u izradi hidrotehničkih projekata
  • dobro poznavanje tehničke i zakonske regulative iz područja građevinarstva
  • napredno znanje rada u MS Officeu, AutoCAD-u i Urbanu
  • vozačku dozvolu B kategorije
  • znanje hrvatskog i engleskog jezika.
Prednost, ali ne i uvjet, predstavljaju:
  • najmanje 5 godina radnog iskustva
  • poznavanje SWMM-a i EPANET-a
  • poznavanje GIS alata poput ArcGIS-a i QGIS-a
  • ovlaštenje za inženjera i upis u imenik ovlaštenih inženjera strukovne komore s položenim stručnim ispitom.
Nemate sve navedene kvalifikacije? Ako ste građevinski tehničar s relevantnim radnim iskustvom, također ste dobrodošli prijaviti se. ZAŠTO PRONING DHI? Kod nas ćete imati priliku: RADITI NA SLOŽENIM PROJEKTIMA Sudjelovat ćete na domaćim i internacionalnim projektima u području hidrotehnike. KORISTITI SUVREMENE TEHNOLOGIJE Radit ćete s modernim alatima i tehnologijama, uključujući matematičko modeliranje hidrotehničkih sustava. RAZVIJATI SVOJE ZNANJE Omogućujemo stručno usavršavanje i razvoj kroz rad na različitim projektima. BITI DIO STRUČNOG TIMA Radit ćete u poticajnom i dinamičnom okruženju, uz suradnju s različitim stručnjacima. IMATI STABILNE UVJETE RADA Rad se uglavnom odvija u našem uredu u Zagrebu, uz povremene terenske obilaske i neradne vikende. Uz osnovna primanja nudimo i dodatke na plaću u skladu s ostvarenim rezultatima, božićnicu, uskrsnicu i potporu za godišnji odmor. MJESTO RADA Zagreb – ured PRONING DHI Povremeni terenski obilasci prema potrebama projekata. Vrsta zaposlenja: rad na određeno vrijeme, uz mogućnost stalnog zaposlenja nakon isteka probnog perioda. ZAINTRIGIRALO VAS JE? Ako želite svoje znanje iz građevinarstva i hidrotehnike usmjeriti prema složenim projektima, suvremenim tehnologijama i stručnom razvoju, pošaljite nam svoj životopis. Prijava treba sadržavati:
  • CV / životopis s kontakt podacima
  • motivacijsko pismo.

jobs.title: PROJEKTANT/PROJEKTANTICA
jobs.description:
PROJEKTANT (m/ž)

Za rad u projektantskom uredu tražimo motiviranu i odgovornu osobu za radno mjesto Projektant (m/ž).

Opis posla

Projektant sudjeluje u izradi arhitektonskih i građevinskih projekata kroz različite faze projektiranja, u suradnji s glavnim projektantom i ostalim članovima projektnog tima.

Glavne odgovornosti uključuju:

  • sudjelovanje u izradi idejnih, glavnih i izvedbenih projekata

  • izradu i razradu arhitektonske i građevinske projektne dokumentacije

  • izradu tehničkih nacrta, detalja i grafičkih priloga

  • sudjelovanje u razvoju projektnih rješenja

  • usklađivanje projektne dokumentacije s ostalim strukama

  • pripremu dokumentacije za ishođenje potrebnih dozvola i suglasnosti

  • komunikaciju i koordinaciju s kolegama, suradnicima i ostalim sudionicima u projektu

  • praćenje projekta i izvršavanje zadataka prema dogovorenim rokovima

  • sudjelovanje u obilascima lokacija i gradilišta prema potrebi

Uvjeti i očekivanja

Od kandidata očekujemo:

  • završeno odgovarajuće obrazovanje iz područja arhitekture, graditeljstva ili srodnog tehničkog područja

  • poznavanje rada u relevantnim programima za projektiranje i izradu tehničke dokumentacije

  • preciznost, odgovornost i organiziranost

  • sposobnost timskog rada i kvalitetne komunikacije

  • samostalnost u izvršavanju povjerenih zadataka u skladu s razinom iskustva

  • spremnost na učenje i profesionalni razvoj

Radno iskustvo na sličnim poslovima je prednost, ali razmotrit ćemo i kandidate s manje iskustva koji pokazuju znanje, motivaciju i želju za učenjem.

Mjesto i način rada

Rad se obavlja na licu mjesta, u prostorijama projektantskog ureda.

Tražimo osobu koja će biti svakodnevno prisutna u uredu i aktivno sudjelovati u radu projektnog tima. Ovo radno mjesto nije predviđeno za rad na daljinu (remote) niti isključivo online suradnju.

Što nudimo

  • rad na raznovrsnim arhitektonskim i projektantskim zadacima

  • rad u profesionalnom i suradničkom okruženju

  • mogućnost učenja i razvoja stručnih znanja

  • sudjelovanje u svim fazama razvoja projekta

  • stabilnu i dugoročnu suradnju

  • mogućnost profesionalnog napredovanja u skladu sa znanjem, iskustvom i rezultatima

Ako ste zainteresirani za rad u projektantskom uredu i želite biti dio tima koji zajednički razvija i realizira projekte, pozivamo vas da nam pošaljete svoj životopis i, ako je primjenjivo, portfolio dosadašnjih radova.

jobs.title: Software Deployment Engineer
jobs.description:
About KPI Solutions

KPI Solutions is a national supply chain consulting and warehouse automation systems integrator, helping some of the biggest names in e-commerce, retail, and distribution move product faster and smarter. Formed in 2021 through the combination of Kuecker Logistics Group, PULSE Integration, and QC Software, KPI brings together decades of material handling and systems integration experience â rooted in material handling integration dating back to 1971. From initial design through go-live and ongoing support, KPI delivers engineered solutions that blend automated technologies (MHE, robotics, conveyor, ASRS, AMR/AGV) with intelligent warehouse execution software to optimize productivity, increase fulfillment speed, and build operational resilience for clients.

Position SummaryÂ 

The Software Deployment Engineer I/II is an individual-contributor role responsible for the end-to-end delivery, configuration, installation, and support of Kommand warehouse execution/control systems and related material handling hardware (pick-to-light, overhead illuminators, AutoStore, and T-sort integrations). This role owns project-level system configuration, commissioning, installation, upgrade, and live troubleshooting work independently, with minimal oversight, across both on-site and remote/office phases of the project lifecycle. It combines software commissioning, hardware coordination, database scripting, environment configuration, and formal test/sign-off responsibilities that have historically been distributed across multiple roles and a dedicated installation team.Â 

This position carries broadened scope following the consolidation of hardware installation and commissioning functions previously performed by a dedicated Systems Integration & Commissioning (SI&C) team, which has since been dissolved. The Software Deployment Engineer I/II is expected to operate as the primary and, in several functions, sole point of ownership for the responsibilities outlined below.Â 

Key ResponsibilitiesÂ 

On-Site DeliveryÂ 

  • Lead software commissioning of Kommand and peripheral hardware systems at customer sites; serve as primary technical owner, with hardware-side support from junior/peer staff.Â 
  • Own full-scope installation of pick-to-light systems, including wiring, physical installation, configuration, and functional testing â a scope absorbed from the former SI&C team.Â 
  • Own full-scope installation of overhead illuminator systems, following the same end-to-end responsibility as above.Â 
  • Conduct IQ (Installation Qualification) and UAT (User Acceptance Testing) following installation, including preparation of formal test documentation and customer sign-off.Â 
  • Serve as the sole owner of Kommand and system-level troubleshooting for live, in-production issues during on-site engagements.Â 

Remote / Office DeliveryÂ 

  • Independently deliver new Kommand installations, including application pre-configuration, database scripting, and pre-deployment testing. Sole personnel on this workstream, currently managing 4 upcoming and 1 active installation.Â 
  • Independently deliver Kommand version upgrades, including SSDT (SQL Server Data Tools) schema comparisons, version control, local pre-install testing, and direct customer coordination. Sole personnel on this workstream, with approximately 22 major upgrades planned in the current year.Â 
  • Production upgrade execution is performed after standard business hours to minimize customer downtime.Â 
  • DEV, QA, and Sandbox environment work is performed during standard business hours.Â 
  • Validate, diagnose, and remediate reported defects; route confirmed fixes to QA prior to merge and deployment. Escalation to other engineering resources is rare.Â 
  • Participate in the on-call rotation covering Kommand, AutoStore, and T-sort system escalations.Â 
  • Provide post-go-live project support on an as-needed basis, including system migrations (e.g., bin/location migrations), integration testing with customer ERP/WMS platforms (e.g., SAP/WMS), and multi-site rollout support.Â 

Project Configuration & DeploymentÂ 

  • Gather all Kommand configurations and system parameters required for a given project.Â 
  • Translate the Business Requirements Document (BRD) and customer conversations into the Kommand system settings spreadsheet, network spreadsheet, and system parameters.Â 
  • Educate the client on use of the host interface.Â 
  • Not required for all projects â dependent on whether the customer's integration involves interface changes (e.g., AutoCase, Pack & Hold).Â 
  • Configure the client's Kommand sandbox environment to be project-specific for customer testing, and support the client through that testing.Â 
  • Configure the Kommand production environment ahead of go-live.Â 
  • Assist with training on any new features requiring customer or internal education.Â 

Scope & IndependenceÂ 

This role currently operates as the sole owner of several critical workstreams, including all new Kommand installations, all Kommand upgrade delivery, and all live Kommand/system troubleshooting. The role requires the judgment and technical depth to manage customer-facing delivery, testing, and sign-off without a dedicated support team, and to make sound decisions under time pressure during after-hours production changes and live escalations.Â 

  • Demonstrated experience commissioning warehouse execution/control software and associated hardware peripherals.Â 
  • Working knowledge of SQL Server-based application environments, including SSDT schema comparison and version control practices.Â 
  • Experience with formal software testing methodology (IQ/UAT), including documentation and customer sign-off processes.Â 
  • Ability to independently diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve live production issues under time pressure.Â 
  • Comfort with hands-on installation work (wiring, hardware configuration) for pick-to-light and overhead illumination systems, or willingness/ability to develop this competency.Â 
  • Willingness to work after hours and participate in an on-call rotation.Â 
  • Ability to translate business requirements documentation and customer conversations into structured system configuration (settings, network, and parameter specifications).Â 
  • Strong customer-facing communication skills; comfortable coordinating directly with customer stakeholders during upgrades, go-live support, and system/interface training.Â 

Preferred QualificationsÂ 

  • Prior experience with AutoStore and/or T-sort systems.Â 
  • Experience with ERP/WMS integration testing (e.g., SAP).Â 
  • Background in material handling, warehouse automation, or industrial controls environments.Â 

What we Offer:

    • Medical Insurance
    • Dental Insurance
    • Vision Insurance
    • Health Care Concierge Service
    • 401(k) Retirement Plan (Pre-tax & Roth)
    • Company paid Basic Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability & Long-Term Disability
    • Voluntary Life & AD&D Insurance
    • Voluntary Accident, Critical Illness & Hospital Indemnity Insurance
    • Pet Insurance
    • Milk Stork Program
    • Wellness Program with gift card redemption and wellness challenges
    • Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick & 10 Holidays)
    • Training & Development

Why KPI Solutions?

At KPI Solutions, youâll be part of a team that values innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement. This is more than a reporting roleâitâs an opportunity to make a measurable impact on project success and business performance.

KPI Solutions provides equal employment opportunity to all individuals regardless of their race, color, creed, religion, gender, age, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by states, federal, or local law.

jobs.title: Frontend Web Application Developer
jobs.description:
Location: Remote
Availability: 35-40 hours per week
Working hours: US East business hours
Reporting to: Lead developer

KoboToolbox has an immediate opening for a Frontend Web Application Developer to fill a full-time position of approximately 35-40 hours per week, for a commitment of at least 1 year. As a member of our team, you will share in the challenge and excitement of writing code used by over 32,000 organizations around the world. These organizations create data-driven change through the collection and analysis of more than 20 million surveys per month.

Only candidates who already have experience working on large web applications will be considered. Beyond technical acumen, we are seeking a team member who demonstrates curiosity, initiative, and a cooperative approach to problem solving and decision-making.

If you're passionate about leveraging technology to make a positive impact, we want to hear from you!

Responsibilities

  • Searching and reading an extensive, long-lived code base to understand existing behavior and conventions.
  • Recognizing when existing conventions may no longer be the best approach and suggesting improvements aligned with contemporary best practices.
  • Writing robust, concise, and reusable code with accompanying tests and documentation.
  • Reviewing other developers' code and providing constructive feedback.
  • Incorporating feedback from code reviews to improve your skills and align with team standards.
  • Using AI-assisted development tools effectively while maintaining responsibility for code quality and correctness.
  • Efficiently investigating bug reports from the support team, creating well-scoped fixes or actionable plans for resolution.
  • Scoping, prioritizing, estimating, and organizing work into manageably sized tasks.
  • Attending regular video-conference check-ins with other members of the technical team.
  • Communicating with the public in conjunction with our support staff or directly through forums, issue trackers, etc.
  • Contributing to discussions about design and architecture collaboratively with the larger team.
  • Performing other related duties as directed by the lead developer.



Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Professional experience writing, deploying, and maintaining client-side code for real-world, API-driven single-page applications.
  • Proficiency with TypeScript, React, and related technologies, including styling, state management, and efficient data exchange over HTTP.
  • Unflinching ability to work with legacy technologies such as Backbone and CoffeeScript.
  • Recent experience giving and receiving code reviews.
  • Ability to independently set up and troubleshoot a local development environment, knowing when to ask for help on genuine roadblocks.
  • Interest in data collection (surveying), particularly in humanitarian emergencies and other challenging contexts, and a desire to improve our platform for our users.
  • Proficiency with spoken and written English.
  • Fluency with Git.
  • Overlap with working hours in the Eastern time zone.
  • Average availability of at least 30 hours per week, preferably 35 hours or more.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with the following is preferred but not required to apply:

  • Using Docker and Docker Compose in a development environment.
  • Programming in Python, ideally with Django (and particularly Django REST Framework).
  • Building user-facing LLM integrations.
  • Surveying with XLSForm, ODK XForm, and OpenRosa.
  • Integrating with Stripe for payment processing.

An added note on qualifications... We know that people from underrepresented groups including women, people of color, LGBTQ+ individuals, people with disabilities, and others are less likely to apply for a role if they don't meet every qualification listed. We're more interested in your potential and growth mindset than a perfect checklist match. If this role excites you and you meet many, but not all, of the qualifications, we'd still love to hear from you.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Kobo is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.



Benefits

  • Genuine Impact: Contribute directly to projects that impact millions of people around the world globally, working alongside the largest international humanitarian organizations as well as thousands of national and small community based partners in 200 countries.
  • Meaningful Work Environment: Join a team that believes work should be meaningful as well as fun, tackling global challenges through innovative data collection and management tools with a proven impact for lasting change.
  • Diverse Team: Be part of an amazing, progressive, and globally diverse team that values diversity, equity, and inclusion across all spectrums.
  • Flexible Work Culture: Enjoy mutual flexibility supported by a culture that prioritizes work-life balance.
  • Professional Development: Benefit from generous professional development options.

 

Full Time Employee Benefits (U.S. candidates only):

  • Health & Wellness: 5 medical insurance options, dental, and vision (up to 80% premium covered), plus life insurance and Long Term Disability.
  • Financial Security: 401(k) retirement plan with 100% match up to 2%.
  • Work-Life Balance: 20 days paid time off, 12 floating holidays, unlimited sick days, and paid parental leave.

 

*Please note, if based in the US or Canada this is a full time employee position. In other locations full time employment or contractor positions are options depending on individual circumstances.

jobs.title: Senior Shopify Developer
jobs.description:
We are hiring a contract-based Senior Shopify Developer to contribute to our Design and Development Team.

Original Job posting link here

 

🌎About garden3d

We are worker owned creative collective, innovating on everything from brands and IRL communities to IoT devices and cross platform apps. We share profit, open source everything, spin out new businesses, and invest in exciting ideas through financial and/or in-kind contributions.

Our client roster includes Google, Stripe, Figma, Hinge, Black Socialists in America, ACLU, Pratt, Parsons, Mozilla, The Nobel Prize, MIT, Gnosis, Etsy & Gagosian.

We’re the software team behind innovative products like The Light Phone & Mill, and we operate a global, decentralized community space collective called Index Space.

We think of our garden3d as collective for creative people, prioritizing a happy, talented, and diverse studio culture. We work on projects that bring value to our world, and we balance deep care for the work we do with a genuine curiosity about life outside of our jobs.

Sanctuary Computer — Development At Sanctuary Computer we’re building a different type of technology shop – one that prioritizes close collaboration between the client and the craftsperson.

Our projects range from design-forward websites, to robust web apps, to native mobile development.

XXIX — Design When we started XXIX in 2013, we set out to create a different kind of design studio and we’ve thrived because we continually ask what a creative practice can be.

We’re building a radically different kind of organization that values autonomy, growth, transparency, and shared responsibility.

Plus, our partner organizations

  • Lightphone
  • Mill
  • IngredientAI

 

🔮 Who we’re looking for:

We're looking for a Senior Shopify Developer who balances deep e-commerce expertise with modern frontend engineering. You'll build pixel-perfect, hyper-performant storefronts ranging from custom Liquid themes to headless Hydrogen/Next.js implementations working alongside our design team to create world-class shopping experiences.

In this role, you’ll work across a variety of client projects to find cost-effective, high-quality, and pragmatic solutions to complex e-commerce challenges. Responsibilities will include:

  • Collaborating closely with Technical Leads and Designers to meet clients' custom e-commerce and technical needs.
  • Building and maintaining high-performance storefronts using both custom Liquid (Online Store 2.0) and modern headless architectures (Shopify Storefront API, GraphQL, Hydrogen/Remix, Next.js).
  • Implementing responsive, accessible, and pixel-perfect interfaces based on design specifications, with meticulous attention to product interaction details and motion design.
  • Integrating custom storefronts with headless CMS platforms (Sanity, Contentful), payment gateways, subscriptions, search, and third-party e-commerce APIs.
  • Optimizing e-commerce performance, focusing heavily on Core Web Vitals, image/video asset delivery, bundle size, and runtime efficiency across high-traffic collection and product pages.
  • Architecting scalable, reusable component libraries and design systems tailored for commercial platforms.
  • Writing clear documentation for store management, custom app integrations, and codebase maintenance.
  • Participating in project team rituals, including Sprint Planning, daily standups, code reviews, and retrospectives.

The person we’re looking for is happy, relaxed and easy to get along with. They’re flexible on anything except conceits that will lower their usually outstanding work quality. They work “smart”, by carefully managing their workflow and staggering features that have dependencies intelligently. They prefer deep work but are OK coming up to the surface now and then for top level / strategic conversations.

We believe people with backgrounds or interests in design, art, music, food or fashion tend to have a well rounded sense of design & quality, so a variety of hobbies or side projects is a big nice to have!

 

🔑 Must-Have Competencies:

We’re always pitching for new and exciting technology niches. Some of the areas below are relevant to us!

  • 8+ years writing highly performant frontend code with an obsession for 95+ Lighthouse scores and optimal Core Web Vitals.
  • Deep Shopify Ecosystem Mastery: Proven experience building custom Shopify themes (Liquid, JSON templates, Online Store 2.0) as well as headless storefronts using the Shopify Storefront API (GraphQL) and frameworks like Hydrogen/Remix or Next.js.
  • Modern Frontend Tech: Expert-level experience with TypeScript and modern CSS methodologies (Tailwind CSS, CSS Modules) alongside robust animation libraries (GSAP, Framer Motion).
  • Headless CMS & Integrations: Extensive experience merging Shopify with headless CMS platforms like Sanity, Contentful, or Prismic, as well as third-party services (Klaviyo, Recharge, Algolia/Searchspring, Stripe).
  • Platform & Hosting: Fluency in industry-standard PaaS platforms including Vercel, Netlify, and Shopify Oxygen.
  • Architecture & State Management: Experience with state management solutions (Zustand, Redux, Pinia) and API integration patterns for cart state, multi-currency, and checkout flows.
  • Quality & Accessibility: Experience building accessible (WCAG compliant), responsive interfaces with a strong commitment to SEO best practices, testing frameworks (Jest, Playwright, Cypress), and maintainable code.
  • Performance Optimization: Practical knowledge of WebSockets, caching strategies (Redis, CDN-level/Cloudflare), and advanced image delivery networks.

 

💪 Nice-to-Have Competencies:

  • Custom App Development: Building bespoke Shopify Apps using Node.js, Remix, GraphQL Admin API, and Shopify CLI.
  • Shopify Plus & Enterprise Features: Hands-on experience with Shopify Functions, Checkout Branding API, Shopify Scripts, and B2B configurations.
  • Tracking & Analytics: Setting up server-side tracking, GTM, Meta Pixel, and Customer Privacy APIs without hurting site load times.
  • WebGL, Canvas & 3D: Experience building interactive graphics, 3D product visualizers, or canvas animations using Three.js or ``.
  • Full-Stack & API Design: Experience across backend/database layers (PostgreSQL), REST/GraphQL API design, and authentication flows (OAuth, JWT).
  • Client-Facing & Management: Direct experience working with clients to clarify requirements, defining product roadmaps, or leading engineering teams.

 

💸 Compensation

Our pay scale ranges from $40/hr to $120/hr pending seniority (& team leadership experience), and our projects are rarely less than 8 full time weeks at 40 hours per week.

We prefer long standing relationships with highly accountable and communicative team members, so we encourage candidates to expect longer term engagements.

 
🎤 How we interview

After you submit your application, a member of our team will reach out. Our interview process starts with an intro call to answer any questions you have about the role and to learn a bit more about your experience and interests.

From there, we’ll follow up with a panel interview call where you get to meet a few members of our team, to openly discuss some of our challenges and ensure your skills and interests align with where we’re going as a business.

For qualified candidates, the process wraps with a reference call, and an offer to follow.

 
👩‍🏭 How we work:

We believe that there’s a better balance between the poles of freelancing & full time, and for that reason Sanctuary works differently to most shops:

  • Transparency & Ownership: We release out Profit & Loss statements to the community each year, open source our best ideas, and talk business & money with everyone in the company. We’re proud to run our business with integrity, and for that reason we share everything with our team & community.
  • 150% Carbon Negative: Our studio offsets 150% of the carbon we use to do business each year, dated back to our founding in 2015. We turn down work that is not in-line with our morals, and we encourage our peers to do the same. We have been certified climate neutral since 2021.
  • Strong Morals: Since our founding, we've turned down somewhere between $1mm - $2mm of work that didn't meet our moral standards. (Most of that was DTC brands that can't show a valid sustainability initiative).
  • Async & Decentralized: We use tools optimized for calm, thoughtful communication, and opt for async whenever possible. We fight hard to maintain our focus time.
  • Remote Friendly: Our company is fluent in remote work, making our workplace more decentralized, and democratized in the process.
  • Ideas & Products: In our spare studio time, we work to build our own open source or internal products to diversify & bolster our income. We create amazing technology products for our clients, so why not for the studio?

→ Read more on our Substack, over here, or our Medium, over there.

 
Important Reminders

Kindly submit a complete and thoughtful application, including relevant links that help verify your work experience and identity. Applications with missing or insufficient information will not move forward in the review process.

Our team carefully reviews every complete submission, and we truly appreciate the time and effort you put into applying! Thank you! :)

Key Responsibilities Process and issue invoices for all installations and services on a daily basis, ensuring billing is accurate, complete and issued in a timely manner. Design, build and maintain a SQL database mapping customer accounts to their installation dates, providing the data structure needed to automate identification of contracts due for a price increase. Design and maintain databases and analytics dashboards used to track customer accounts, installation dates, contractual pricing and billing activity, ensuring data integrity across the finance function. Act as an internal consultant to the automation project team on the design of an end-to-end system to automate the price-increase process, reducing manual effort and improving billing accuracy. Monitor customer contracts approaching the end of their fixed-price period and implement the applicable price increase in line with company policy and contractual terms. Review completed installation and service work on a monthly basis to confirm that all chargeable activity has been billed, identifying and resolving any billing gaps or discrepancies. Provide billing updates to the Financial Controller as required, escalating pricing or billing matters where necessary. Qualifications and Experience: Bachelor's Degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance, Business or a related discipline. SQL and database design skills, with the ability to model and work with customer and billing data. Demonstrated ability to analyse billing and customer account data, and to identify and resolve discrepancies. Experience designing or supporting automation and analytics dashboards within a billing or finance environment. Strong Excel skills and experience working with billing or invoicing systems. Sound understanding of data accuracy, billing controls, and contractual pricing terms. jobs.title: 🇩🇪 Kundenservice Mobilfunk Inbound - innerhalb der EU (ausgenommen: Deutschland)
jobs.description:
🇩🇪 This job ad is written in German. 🇩🇪
 
Kennst du schon die hey contact heroes?

Noch nicht? Dann wird’s Zeit!

Die hey contact heroes stehen für echte Innovationen im Kundenservice! Wir haben uns auf die Bereitstellung erstklassiger Kundenservice-Lösungen spezialisiert hat. Mit über 500 Agent/innen sind wir in mittlerweile 17 Ländern rund um die Uhr und rund um den Globus im Einsatz.

100 % Remote - innerhalb der EU (ausgenommen: Deutschland)

Die hey contact heroes starten für eine große und bekannte Mobilfunk-Marke ein neues, größeres Projekt im Bereich Prepaid-Kundenservice. Es handelt sich um einen Inbound-Service.

Dafür suchen wir zuverlässige, motivierte Freelancer innerhalb der EU, mit Wohnsitz außerhalb Deutschlands, die uns langfristig im Inbound-Customer-Service unterstützen.

Wenn du außerhalb von Deutschland lebst und arbeitest und als selbständiger Freelancer remote arbeiten möchtest, bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Deine Mission:
  • Bearbeitung von Inbound-Anrufen rund um Prepaid-Produkte, Tarife, SIM-Karten, Aufladungen und technische Basisanfragen
  • Professionelles Projektumfeld mit festen Ansprechpartnern
  • Flexible Einsatzzeiten im Rahmen des Projekts, Du bestimmst wann Du arbeitest
  • Vergütung pro Stunde oder pro Produktivminute (abhängig vom Projektmodell)
  • 100 % Remote - Arbeite von deinem Standort innerhalb der EU (außer Deutschland)
Dein Profil:

1. Rechtliche & formale Voraussetzungen:

  • Selbstständigkeit/Freelancer-Status im jeweiligen Wohnsitzland
  • Wohnsitz außerhalb von Deutschland, aber innerhalb der EU
  • Fähigkeit, ordnungsgemäße Rechnungen gemäß den gesetzlichen Vorgaben des eigenen Landes an internationale Auftraggeber (uns) auszustellen
  • Erfüllung der steuerlichen Pflichten im eigenen Land

2. Fachliche & persönliche Anforderungen:

  • Deutschkenntnisse auf C1/C2-Niveau
  • Erfahrung im telefonischen Kundenservice von Vorteil
  • Selbstständige Arbeitsweise & Organisation

About the Role

As a Sales Assistant at Østens Bazar, you will be involved in the daily operation of the store and help ensure that our customers receive good service and that the store is well organised.

Your daily responsibilities will include typical retail tasks such as:

  • Providing friendly and professional customer service

  • Operating the cash register

  • Restocking shelves and keeping the store organised

  • Receiving and handling deliveries

  • Ordering products and monitoring stock levels

You will use Excel to help check and compare purchase prices and sales prices and ensure that the information registered in our systems is correct. You will be responsible for identifying any errors or discrepancies and reporting them to the Store Manager.

You will not be responsible for deciding or setting sales prices. Sales prices are determined by the Store Manager. Your responsibility will be to check that the prices and information have been entered correctly.

We Are Looking for Someone Who

  • Has previous experience working in retail or a similar customer-facing position

  • Has experience using Microsoft Excel and is comfortable working with spreadsheets

  • Is organised, responsible and detail-oriented

  • Is comfortable working with numbers and checking prices

  • Can work independently as well as part of a team

  • Provides good customer service and communicates well with customers and colleagues

  • Is flexible and able to work in a busy retail environment

About Østens Bazar

Østens Bazar is a supermarket located at Frederikssundsvej 11 in Copenhagen NV. We offer a wide selection of products and serve customers from many different backgrounds.

We are looking for someone who wants to become a reliable part of our team and contribute to the smooth daily operation of the store.

Interested?

jobs.title: Forandringsstærk teamleder, der lykkes i fællesskab
jobs.description:
Vil du være med til at forme og understøtte Efter- og Videreuddannelsesområdet på Absalon? Vi søger en udviklingsorienteret teamleder, der kan omsætte ambitioner til resultater og skabe følgeskab i forandringer. Du skal kunne navigere mellem forskellige interesser og faglige perspektiver, være nysgerrig og lyttende – og samtidig have gennemslagskraft til at holde fast i retningen, når det er nødvendigt.

Du bliver en del af et tæt ledelsesmakkerskab, hvor du sammen med en erfaren teamlederkollega skal stå i spidsen for et nyt samlet team og skabe endnu stærkere sammenhæng mellem forretningsudvikling, administration og den samlede udvikling af vores efter- og videreuddannelsesområde.

Din profil
Vi søger dig, der kombinerer stærke ledelseskompetencer og en udviklingsorienteret tilgang. Området er komplekst, og derfor er der brug for god, sammenhængende ledelseskraft ind i området. Du skal sammen med en teamlederkollega lede EVU-teamet som et stærkt ledelsesmakkerskab, hvilket sætter store krav til samarbejde, stærke relationer og kommunikation. Sammen skal I skabe sammenhæng mellem de store ambitioner for området og hverdagens udfordringer. For at lykkes i dette er det væsentligt, at du kan genkende dig selv i følgende:

Dine relationelle kompetencer er helt i top. Til hverdag vil du få en bred samarbejdsflade med medarbejdere og ledere på tværs af Absalon. Din evne til at etablere relationer og samarbejde med mange forskellige kolleger er afgørende. Du har et stærkt strategisk perspektiv og med din gode gennemslagskraft, evner du at udvikle driften ud fra den strategiske linje.

Du har erfaring med styring af processer i en kompleks organisation. Det ligger dig naturligt at inddrage og samarbejde med relevante samarbejdspartnere i organisationen. Du er processtærk og har erfaring med at gennemføre udviklings- og forandringsprocesser i en kompleks organisation. Du har et helhedsblik og evner at procesplanlægge, optimere arbejdsgange, dataunderstøtte og udarbejde objektivt begrundede beslutningsoplæg. Du er optaget af både udvikling og implementering i hverdagspraksis.

Du har ledelseserfaring. Din ledelsesstil er inddragende, nysgerrig og dialogorienteret, og du formår at motivere samarbejdspartnere og medarbejdere mod fælles mål. Du har erfaring med at lede udviklingsprocesser, styre projekter og involvere de rette interessenter. Du spiller din lederkollega god, bringer egne perspektiver tydeligt i spil og kan stå på fælles beslutninger. Som personaleleder er du optaget af at styrke trivslen hos den enkelte medarbejder og teamet som helhed.

Derudover forventer vi os, at du:
  • har kendskab til eller interesse for uddannelsessektoren
  • kommunikerer enkelt og præcist på skrift
  • har en relevant uddannelse.

Dine arbejdsopgaver
Du skal forvente, at du vil have opgaver, der knytter sig til følgende ledelsesroller: strategisk ledelse, drifts – og faglig ledelse, personaleledelse og - udvikling samt udvikling af dig selv og din måde at lede på. Konkrete arbejdsopgaver der skal løses, vil bl.a. være:

Udvikling af EVU-området. Vi har høje ambitioner for Absalons efter- og videreuddannelse og vi står over for en spændende udvikling, hvor både samarbejdsformer, processer og opgaveløsning skal udvikles. Sammen med din lederkollega skal du være med til at professionalisere understøttelsen af det samlede EVU-område og skabe sammenhæng mellem forretningsudvikling, administration og organisationens strategiske ambitioner. Det indebærer bl.a. udvikling af tydelig governance, stærkere beslutningsgrundlag baseret på data og sikker implementering af nye løsninger.

Kvalitetssikring af leverancer. I den daglige drift er det vigtigt, at du mestrer at driftslede, prioritere opgaveløftet og sikre den løbende dialog med uddannelsernes konsulenter og ledere, samt følger konstruktivt og systematisk op på tilbagemeldinger m.v.

Personaleledelse. Som personaleleder er du tillidsfuld og sikre rammerne for god trivsel i teamet. Derudover har du fokus på at skabe højt engagement, hvor opgavernes og samarbejdets formål er klart defineret. Du skal skabe overblik og tydelige rammer for medarbejdernes arbejde samt for opgavefordelingen.

Dine kolleger
Du bliver en del af Uddannelsesservices EVU-team, hvor vi dataunderstøtter, udvikler og administrerer efter- og videreuddannelse. Teamet består af mange forskellige fagligheder, og vi er tilsammen 20 medarbejdere. Din lederkollega og du vil begge have personaleledelse for hver jeres medarbejdergruppe, og tilsammen vil I have fælles ansvar for teamets opgaveløft og det strategiske ledelsesansvar.

Uddannelsesservice har 5 teams. Vi håndterer også al optagelse, administration og vejledning af studerende på vores professionsbachelor- og ingeniøruddannelser. Tilsammen er vi 94 kolleger i Uddannelsesservice, som er en velfungerende og uhøjtidelig afdeling, hvor vi løfter i flok. Vores kontorer ligger side om side med undervisningslokaler, og vi arbejder tæt på de studerende og tæt med hinanden. Vi vægter kollegial trivsel højt og har brug for, at du også er en holdspiller. Vi har en uformel omgangstone og har mange bolde i luften, som vi gør os stor umage med at gribe.

Vi holder til på vores Campus i Slagelse, som er nemt at komme til, da det er placeret lige ved stationen. Absalon har en dejlig frokostordning, adgang til motionscenter og en aktiv personaleforening.

Sådan ansøger du
  • Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst på statens område.
  • Stillingen er på fuld tid med ansættelse hurtigst muligt
  • Du kan forvente et lønniveau på 700.000 kr. - 800.000 kr. årligt inkl. pension.
  • Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte Chef for Uddannelsesservice Randi Mølager på telefon 7248 1280.
  • Ansøgning og relevante bilag sendes via vores rekrutteringssystem her eller ved at klikke på ”Søg stillingen” til højre på denne side senest den 1. oktober 2026.
  • Vi forventer at afholde 1. ansættelsessamtale den 5.oktober og 2. samtale den 8. oktober 2026.

Vi ønsker, at medarbejderstaben afspejler det omgivende samfund, og vi opfordrer derfor alle interesserede uanset køn, kulturel og etnisk baggrund til at søge stillingen.

Om Absalon
Professionshøjskolen Absalon er Region Sjællands største uddannelsesinstitution, hvor vi med vores 14 uddannelser uddanner mennesker, der med høj faglighed og professionalisme skaber værdi i det samfund, de er en del af. Vores uddannelser går tæt på den enkelte studerendes drømme og potentialer, tæt på den praksis de skal virke i og på de mennesker og fællesskaber, de skal gøre en mærkbar forskel for.

I en ny sjællandsk storregion er det afgørende at have blik for både de store linjer, det lokale og det nære. De mennesker, der uddanner sig på Absalon, løfter andre mennesker og skaber muligheder og udvikling dér, hvor de bor og arbejder.

Det er vores ambition at skabe praksisnære uddannelser af høj kvalitet og give de studerende de bedste forudsætninger for at udvikle sig til kompetente professionelle. Og vi vil styrke mulighederne for, at de kan skabe en karriere, der til enhver tid matcher deres faglige interesser og ambitioner – og det ansvar de tager i vores samfund.

Vi er 850 medarbejdere, vi har 8.000 studerende på vores grunduddannelser og vi efter- og videreuddanner 3.500 kursister hvert år.

jobs.title: Assistant Professor in High Frequency Switch-Mode Power Supplies
jobs.description:
The Digital and High-Frequency Electronics (DHFE) section at the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, based at the university campus in Odense, seeks outstanding individuals for full-time Assistant Professor positions in Power Electronics, focusing on power management for electronic and computing devices and systems. Successful applicants are expected to contribute to the development of academic programs and the research community. Applicants should have a PhD in Power Electronics or a closely related field. 

The DHFE section focuses on conducting research in digital and high-frequency electronics, embedded systems, control, and communication, utilizing cutting-edge reconfigurable computing and sensors. The aim is to develop next-generation electronics and computing solutions that solve technology-related challenges in fields such as autonomous robots, drones, IoT, smart grid, and healthcare.

Applicants are expected to establish and maintain a research program in high-frequency power electronics and power management for computation, along with low-voltage electronic systems. The position emphasizes converter and power-management for computing platforms and resource-constrained applications, including battery-operated, energy-harvesting, mobile, autonomous, embedded, and sensor-based systems.

The section is a vital component of our Bachelor of Engineering, Bachelor of Science, and Master of Science programs in Electrical and Electronics Engineering in Odense. Currently, the section focuses on three research fields: 1) Drones for Infrastructure Inspections and Interactions, 2) High-Frequency SMPS and power management for low-power electronic systems, and 3) Telecommunication Systems. The section has 15 academics, including professors, postdoctoral fellows, PhD students, and engineers, to support research, industrial collaboration, and educational activities, and is growing steadily.

The SDU campus in Odense contains six faculties and soon a large university hospital, creating a great concentration of academics and students facilitating interdisciplinary research and rich student life. The city of Odense is culturally rich, surrounded by a vibrant and growing robotics community, and highly livable with a green-banked meandering river cutting through the centre and attractive residential areas.

 

Job Description

The position focuses on power management for resource-constrained autonomous, mobile, and embedded electronic systems. Relevant research areas include high-frequency power conversion, battery-operated systems, energy harvesting, power management architectures, embedded control, and analog/digital control of converters. The application domain spans from ultra-low-power electronics and sensors to mobile platforms, robotics, drones, IoT devices, and power management for embedded, compact, and high-performance computing systems.

The role strengthens DHFE’s research profile at the interface between power electronics, microelectronics, embedded systems, and intelligent electronic devices. It is expected to support shared research themes across SDU, including energy-efficient electronics, autonomous systems, battery-powered platforms, sensor networks, health technology, and miniaturized or distributed devices.

The successful candidate should work constructively both with colleagues within DHFE and also with colleagues from other research units, such as SDU Microelectronics, SDU Centre for Industrial Electronics, the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, Faculty of Health (specifically Health Tech), Mechanical Engineering, and other relevant environments, translating power electronics competence into system-level contributions for electronic devices and platforms.

 

Duties

As a faculty member, you will be responsible for developing and delivering undergraduate and graduate teaching in Electronic and Electrical Engineering, with particular attention to strengthening control and power electronics within the BSc portfolio. This includes supervising students at Bachelor and Master’s level, mentoring students, integrating with the student body, and participating in education and outreach activities. Research duties include establishing an externally funded research agenda, publishing in leading journals and conferences, supervising early-career researchers, and contributing to the development of DHFE’s research environment. The candidate is also expected to contribute to external collaboration and perform service at the section, department, university, and professional levels.

 

Qualifications Required

  • The applicant should hold a doctoral degree (PhD) in Power Electronics, Electronics, or a related subject area. 

  • Demonstrated potential for teaching undergraduate and graduate courses at the university level. 

  • The applicant must have relevant research expertise in areas related to efficient and high-frequency power converters, converter control, and power management for computing or embedded electronic systems.

  • The applicant must have teaching skills that align with the content and responsibilities of the position. This includes possessing both pedagogical and professional skills essential for carrying out the tasks associated with the role. 

  • A strong track record for research fundraising is required. 

 

For further information about the position, please contact Associate Professor Tim McRae (mcrae@sdu.dk)  or the Head of the Digital and High-frequency Electronics Section, Professor Emad Samuel Malki Ebeid, e-mail: esme@sdu.dk.  

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

  • Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must be in English and include:

  • A motivation letter that clearly explains the applicant's interest, qualifications, and motivation for the position (max. 2 pages). 

  • Detailed Curriculum Vitae, including personal contact information, describing the research, along with any other relevant information, e.g. teaching experience, computational skills, etc.

  • A research plan with a focus on the development of your research line and research team. 

  • List of funded projects. 

  • Teaching Portfolio documenting teaching, learning, and supervision qualifications and approach. Any format is acceptable; see the Faculty's teaching portfolio page for inspiration.

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).

  • List of publications with the most relevant publications highlighted. 

  • Publications most relevant to the position.

  • Up to three names and emails of researchers can provide an informed reference letter at short notice. (Reference letters and other relevant qualifications may also be included.) 

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected.

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file).

 

The application deadline is November 1, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST)

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

  

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period, and the preferred start date is from January 1, 2027. The final start date will be agreed with the successful applicant.

During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme. 

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor as described therein.

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Solutions Consultant Manager is the person who makes our GTM motion real on the ground. As an in-region leader directly managing a team of Solutions Consultants, you'll own your team's full commercial output—new logo, expansion, and renewals—and be accountable for both the results and the quality of execution that produces them.

This isn't a traditional pipeline-management role. The best SC Managers are coaches first: they know what a great first meeting looks like, can watch a live build and tell a rep exactly what to change, and build the operating rhythm and inspection cadence that makes consistent execution possible across the team. If you're a builder who loves developing people as much as winning deals—and you want to lead a regional team in a go-to-market model that's genuinely new—this is the role.

This role will be based in London, UK. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

 - Coach SCs on the GTM builder motion: what great looks like in a first meeting (workflow diagnosis, current → future architecture), a second meeting (live build in Notion + value narrative), and through the full cycle to adoption hand-off

 - Contribute to and participate in the regional operating cadence: weekly pipeline reviews, deal support sessions, call reviews against the motion quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership

 - Hire, onboard, and certify new SCs to the GTM builder motion—driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution, and managing performance with clarity when expectations aren't met

 - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Track record as a quota-carrying B2B seller with direct experience in workflow design, live demos, or technical sales—you can coach the builder motion because you've run it yourself

 - Frontline sales management experience: built an operating cadence, ran performance management, and developed talent from onboarding through consistent overperformance

 - Strong coaching orientation: you can watch a demo or deal review and identify specifically what to change—not just whether the outcome was good, but why, and what the rep should do differently next time

 - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read pipeline health, identify risk early, and drive urgency across a team without micromanaging individual deals

 - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience selling or managing in a consumption or usage-based business where adoption signals matter as much as closed ARR

 - Track record building high-performing regional teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, and performance management
